faqs.question: Is IIM Ahmedabad hard to get?
faqs.answer:
IIM Ahmedabad admissions is based on entrance. Therefore, candidates must qualify the eligibility criteria and secure valid scores in CAT entrance exams. Moreoever, candidates ae required to apply for admission through the official website of IIMA. The percentile of CAT for IIM Ahmedabad reached up to 99.6 in the past years which shows how rigorous it is for a student to get admission to this Institute. Candidates are shortlisted for these programmes based on course-specific entrance exams, followed by shortlisting processes which generally comprise a Personal Interview (PI) round.
To conclude, seeking admission to IIM Ahmedabad is challenging but not difficult.

faqs.question: What is the highest package offered during IIM Ahmedabad placements?
faqs.answer: The overall highest package recorded during IIM Ahmedabad PGP placements 2025 was INR 110 LPA. In PGP FABM and PGPX courses, the highest salary offered in 2025 was 41.83 LPA and 76.5 LPA.

faqs.question: Does IIM Ahmedabad have 100% placements?
faqs.answer: In PGP FABM courses, 100% placements was recorded during the placement drive 2025 and 2024 as well. In PGPX course, 1 student was unplaced in 2025 as per the audited report. During the PGP placements 2025, 395 students were placed and 11 students opted out from placements out of total 406 eligible students. PGP placement rate in 2025 was 100%.

faqs.question: Which sector hires the maximum number of students during IIM Ahmedabad placement drive?
faqs.answer: Consulting was the top recruiting sector during PGP, PGP FABM, PGPX placements 2025 at IIM Ahmedabad. The numbers of offers made by Consulting to the students of these courses were 156, 15 and 32.

college_info.intro:
MBA is the flagship programme offered by IIMA. MBA students are taught to make the right decisions in the face of difficult business challenges. They are trained through case method courses, FIELD projects, etc. MBA is taught by expert faculty members. The college provides global exposure to students through student exchange programmes.
The Institute offers an MBA on the basis of the CAT entrance exam and a minimum aggregate of 50% in graduation. For CAT 2025 eligibility, candidates must obtain a bachelor's degree with a professional degree in CA/ CS/ ICWA (CMA)/ FIAI with a minimum percentage.
IIMA offers 385 seats in total for PGP admissions through CAT. Furthermore, there is no age limit to appear for the CAT examination. Moreover, the cost of an MBA at IIM Ahmedabad includes tuition fees ranging from INR 12 Lakh to INR 25 Lakh, depending on the specialisation opted for.
The Institute offers an MBA for a duration of 16 months to 2 years. MBA students can plan their careers in Management Consulting and various other fields. IIM Ahmedabad's MBA students can become Marketing Managers, Business Analysts, and Investment Bankers, and can take up various other job roles.

overview_faqs.question: Is studying at IIM Ahmedabad expensive?
overview_faqs.answer: Yes, IIM Ahmedabad is certainly costly. IIM Ahmedabad total fees ranges between INR 64,000 and INR 33 lakh. The fees vary depending on the programme and specialisation selected by the students. The fee for certain programmes certainly falls in the higher end of the spectrum. Students need to pay INR 25 lakh as IIM Ahmedabad MBA fee. However, considering the fact that IIMA is one of the top-rate IIMs and limitless oppurtunities students can experience at the institute, it might be considered a worthwile investment. Further, the institute also offers financial aid to its students.

overview_faqs.question: Why do IIMs charge high fees even though it is a government institution?
overview_faqs.answer: Although IIMs are government institute, most IIMs are self reliant and do no depend on government for funding. Hence to attract quality professors they need to charge higher fee. Also, never in the history of IIMs any student has dropped out because of financial reasons. There are several scholarships available for students in need.

placement_data.title: IIM Ahmedabad Placement Overview 2025
paragraphs: 395 students were placed from the PGP batch of 406 eligible students during IIM Ahmedabad placements 2025. 11 PGP students opted out from the placement process. 178 companies visited the campus and offered around 261 roles during IIM A placement 2025 for the PGP course. BCG followed by Accenture Strategy, American Express Bain & Co and McKinsey & Company made the most number of offers . BCG and Accenture made 35 and 31 offers whereas Bain made 17 offers. Finance , General Management and Strategy functions witnessed increase of 13.7%, 5% and 33% in the number of net offers made. The highest and median package recorded during IIM Ahmedabad PGP placement 2025 was INR 110 LPA and 34.53 LPA (Maximum Earning Potential).

In PGP FABM program , out of 45 eligible students , 1 student opted out of the placement drive and 44 students were placed in 2025 . Placement rate recorded for PGP FABM was 100% . The batch received 12 PPOs and 3 lateral offers. The highest and median package received by PGP FABM students during the placement drive 2025 was INR 41.83 LPA and 20.04 LPA (Maximum Earning Potential).

PGPX placements were also good in 2025 . The highest and median salary received during PGPX placements 2025 was INR 76.5 LPA and 34.41 LPA . Out of 158 eligible students , 138 students opted for placements and 137 students were placed in 2025. 170 companies participated and made more than 150 offers to the PGPX batch. Out of the total companies participated, 80 were new recruiters .

overview.text: IIM Ahmedabad Campus is built in the heart of the city. It is spread over 102 acres and is tastefully designed with extensive green spaces. IIMA campus represents the institute’s educational philosophy – critical thinking, orientation to real life, and active intellectual self-reliance. Work on the IIM Ahmedabad campus began in 1962 and was carried out by renowned architect, Louis Kahn. He designed the campus with sustainability in mind. Moreover, the campus has something for everyone with gardens, trails, and playgrounds to sports facilities and meditation nooks and cafes. Read on to learn more about the IIMA campus, hostel, student life, and more.

hostel.description: IIM- A has 25 student dormitories with a total capacity to hold about 740 occupants. Apart from the dormitories, there are separate housing facilities available for married candidates. The dorms have ten single rooms on each floor arranged around a stairway and a tearoom. faqs.answer: The answer to this question of whether an average student can get into IIM can be both yes and no depending on the definition of an average student.Based on Academics (Class 10/ Class 12/ Graduation): While a student with average scores in Class 10, Class 12 and graduation with a good CAT score certainly has good chances of getting a call from IIM-A, chances are less for someone with an average CAT score.Based on student category (General or Reserved): While it is tough for a General category average student to grab a seat at IIM due to high score requirements, a reserved category student can get admission being at average scores as well.Based on past work experience, diversity and other factors: Gender and academic diversity is also a factor on which students are shortlisted at IIM. IIMs judge the past academic category based on the degree obtained by the students before MBA and then a weightage is allotted based on that. For Engineers, the percentage for scoring the highest marks is higher as compared with other streamsPerformance in selection rounds: Once you make it to the final selection rounds, i.e., AWT/PI process, it can be considered a fresh start. At this stage, students can forget their past average-ness but definitely require good grasp over the past subjects as academics-related questions are asked in the interview.Based on the above factors, it can be considered that while getting into top Management institutes, such as IIM is extremely tough, the past performance, CAT performance, student category and a lot of factors can be the reasons for a student to receive that final call.
faqs.question: Q: Can an average student get into an IIM?

faqs.answer: IIM Bangalore considers two kinds of CAT scores for MBA admission - Qualifying and Final score. Qualifying CAT score is the minimum sectional and overall CAT score used to shortlist students for the Analytical Writing Test (AWT) and Personal Interview (PI) rounds. Candidates above minimum cutoffs in the sectional percentile ranks, the overall percentile rank and having a positive (greater than zero) raw score in all sections of CAT are considered for the next stage. The final CAT score is cutoffs are the basis of which the candidates are called for final selection after the AWT and PI rounds are over.

IIM-B has 16 hostel blocks, one executive block, and executive accommodation at the Management Development Centre, popularly known as MDC. Twenty-four-hour Internet connectivity, fully automatic washing machines, a hair salon, a music room, a student-run library, a recreation room, and a store on the hostel premises are standard features. Laundry and ironing services, an intercom facility, and a guest room facility for visitors are also provided.

overview_faqs.question: What is the fee for MBA course at IIM Bangalore?
overview_faqs.answer: The IIM Bangalore fees for the MBA course is INR 12.5 Lacs - INR 24.5 lakh. The accepted entrance exam for admission to the IIM Bangalore is CAT. Candidates willing to get admission must first register for the CAT exam. Then, with valid scores apply on the official website of the college. Pay the fee in time to avoid late fee submission charges.

overview_faqs.question: Is it worth pursuing MBA at IIM Bangalore?
overview_faqs.answer: IIM Bangalore flagship course is MBA, which is available across 10 electives, including Decision Sciences, Economics and Social Sciences, and Entrepreneurship among others. The duration of the courses ranges from 2 years to 5 years. Pursuing this course means that students will have a secured future. MBA students can become Managers, or can go for various other job profiles.

admission_overview.title: IIM Bangalore Admission Overview 2026
admission_overview.description: Looking to enrol on a Master's programme in the field of Management? Then IIM Bangalore is the answer for you if you're someone on a search for experiencing and learning a great many things in addition to gaining a degree from a prestigious institute. IIM Bangalore admissions 2026 are completely entrance-based. The institute offers MBA, Executive MBA, and other courses at PG, doctoral and certificate level courses in the field of Management. Candidates seeking admission at IIM Bangalore need to appear for national-level or college-level entrance exams, according to the selected course. Admission to the flagship course, i.e.IIM Bangalore MBA is based on a valid score in the CAT exam, followed by a Personal Interview (PI) and Written Ability Test (WAT) round. Read the following article to learn more about the IIM Bangalore admission.

description: IIM Bangalore cutoff 2024 is available on this page for MBA/PGDM courses. Candidates can refer to the exam-wise sections below to view the IIM Bangalore CAT cutoff 2024 across different courses and categories. Further updates related to CAT 2025 are provided below:

The IIM Bangalore cut off 2024 for PG courses MBA/PGDM (4 courses) is based on CAT scores. The institute releases two types of CAT cutoffs, namely the qualifying CAT cutoff and the final CAT cutoff. Securing a minimum qualifying cutoff just means that the candidate will be eligible for the WAT-PI round of IIM Bangalore admission. Also, the IIM Bangalore final CAT cutoff is always higher than the qualifying cutoff. The qualifying cutoffs for IIMs mostly remain the same every year.

IIM Bangalore admission 2025 is a two-step process. In the first step, candidates with valid CAT 2024 are shortlisted for the Writing Ability Test (WAT) and Personal Interview (PI). Candidates above minimum cutoffs in the sectional percentile ranks, the overall percentile rank, and having a positive (greater than zero) raw score in all sections of CAT 2024 are to be considered for the next stage of IIM Bangalore admissions. Below is a detailed breakdown of the same:-
1.IIM Kozhikode Registration Process

Fill an online application form on the official website of IIM Kozhikode with all the relevant details around the personal and educational details. Candidates must appear and qualify for the respective entrance exam before applying for the course and submit their entrance scores during the filling of the application form. Further, aspirants also upload a set of documents comprising their age proof, education certificates, photographs, signatures, etc. They also have to pay a non-refundable amount of application fee.
2.  Personal Interviews of Shortlisted Students

The Management Institute shortlists students based on their academic records, CAT qualifying, and CAT final cutoff for further selection rounds. The shortlisted students have to appear for a Personal Interview. A commutative score is then calculated based on candidates' performance in the selection rounds. Further, for the other courses, candidates who meet the eligibility criteria are required to go through the institute-specific selection process and get shortlisted.
3. Final Merit List

IIM Kozhikode publishes a category-wise merit list after the selection rounds. Students who make it to the merit list become eligible for admission. The selected candidates can further confirm their seats by paying the course admission fee.

faqs.question: What entrance exams are accepted for PhD admission at IIM Kozhikode?
faqs.answer: IIM Kozhikode also accepts CAT, GATE, GRE, GMAT, UGC-NET, UGC-JRF and IIMB Test with valid score.The relevant exam will be based on the specialisation area of interest by the applicant.Aspirants who apply to study in Economics should also take a written test at IIMK.These scores on the tests should be less than three years to the deadline of the application.

faqs.question: Do PhD students need prior work experience to apply at IIM, Kozhikode?
faqs.answer: If a student has completed B.Tech or any four-year degree programme, they need to have a minimum work experience of three years to apply for Ph.D. programme. Additionally, the IIM Kozhikode Ph.D. fees is INR 1,000 (INR 2,000 for IIMB Test aspirants). The admission process include entrance exam score (at least 60 percentile), academic performance & research proposal followed by Personal Interview.

faqs.question: Is IIM Kozhikode worth joining?
faqs.answer: IIM Kozhikode offers a two-year Executive Post Graduate Programme in Executive Management (EPGP), which is also popular as E-MBA. Candidates with some experience can gain a lot of benefits by pursuing MBA from IIM Kozhikode. It is one of the top Management institutes of the country. Along with the experienced faculty, candidates also get great exposure by studying in an IIM. For the Management category courses, IIM Kozhikode has been ranked on number 3 under the top 100 colleges of Managemen in India by NIRF. At the completion of the course, candidates will receive a degee of MBA from reputed IIM Kozhikode. The institute has received Global recognition from AMBA, EQUIS and Business Incubator and Entrepreneurship Centre support through IIMK LIVE.Check below the more reasons to join the flagship programme (MBA) at IIM Kozhikode:

faqs.question: How can I get admission in IIM Kozhikode for MBA?
faqs.answer: Candidates seeking for admission to IIM Kozhikode must check the eligibility criteria for the course they want to apply at IIMK. Further, the second step is the application process. Candidates applying for Management courses must submit the scores of CAT/ GMAT/ GRE at the time of filling the application form. Further, the institute also conduct EMAT for admission to E-MBA course. Based on entrance exam scores, the shortlisted students are called for Written Ability Test (WAT)/ Personal Interview (PI). However, WAT/PI rounds are not conducted for all the courses. Later on, candidates are allocated seats as per their performance in the selection rounds.

faqs.question: How can I join MBA in IIM Kozhikode?
faqs.answer: For admission to a two-year MBA/ PGP course at IIM Kozhikode, candidates must fulfil the minimum eligibility criteria in the first place. Candidates who passed graduation with minimum 60% aggregate from a recognised university are eligible to apply for MBA course. However, there is a five percent relaxation for reserved category candidates and they must obtain a minimum of 55% aggregate in their final graduation. Further, candidates who do not hold any graduation degree must score minimum 50% aggregate in obtain CA/ICWA/CS to qualify for the eligibility.Find below the minimum eligibility requirements as per various parameters:CategoryCAT PercentileSectional PercentileClass 10 & 12 PercentageGeneral857560OBC/ EWS756560SC655555ST/ PwD554555

faqs.question: How much work experience is required for EMBA admission at IIM Kozhikode?
faqs.answer: IIM Kozhikode Executive MBA admission requires every candidates to have a minimum work experience of 3 years or 1095 days.However, IIM Kozhikode willl only consider work experience gained after graduation of the candidate.Work experience gained during or before graduation will not be considered for the EPGP eligibility criteria.

description: IIM Kozhikode cutoff 2024 is available on this page for MBA/PGDM courses. Candidates can refer to the exam-wise sections below to view the IIM Kozhikode CAT cutoff 2024 across different courses and categories. Further updates related to CAT 2025 are provided below:

IIM Kozhikode cut off for the PG course MBA/PGDM is based on CAT scores. The institute releases two types of CAT cutoffs, namely the Qualifying CAT cutoff and the Final CAT cutoff. Securing a minimum qualifying cutoff means that the candidate will be eligible to apply for the WAT/GD-PI round. Also, IIM Kozhikode's final CAT cutoff is always higher than the qualifying cutoff. The qualifying cutoffs for IIMs mostly remain the same every year.

IIM Kozhikode offers admission to Management courses based on valid CAT scores. For IIM Kozhikode admission to the MBA course, students need to meet both the overall CAT cut-off percentile and the sectional cut-off. IIM Kozhikode does not release CAT cutoffs in the public domain and is exclusively accessible only via account login to candidates who have appeared for the exam. paragraphs: DMS IIT Delhi admissions are open. Department of Management Studies popularly known as DMS IIT Delhi offers degrees at PG and PhD level in the field ofManagement. The flagship course ofDMS IIT Delhiis a 2-yearMBAcourse. The institute also offers anExecutive MBAcourse as a part-time, three-year programme for working professionals. Students can also pursue a short-term Management Development Programme at the institute. Admission to the full-time management course at DMS IIT Delhi is based on CAT scores while the Executive MBA admissions are based on a personal interview. For PhD, candidates should have a valid GATE/ UGC NET score along with fulfilling the respective eligibility criteria.

IIT Delhi MBA admission 2025is entrance-based. The institute offers MBA, MBA Telecom, Executive MBA, and PhD courses. The institute shortlists students on the basis of valid scores secured by them in the relevant entrance exam. DMS IIT Delhi admission 2025consists of various steps as a filteration process. Here is a detailed breakdown of theDMS IIT Delhi admission process:

Post application submission, candidates must appear for a screening process where the eligibility and selection criteria will be assessed. Applicants will then have to qualify for the respective entrance exam. Applicants must appear for the written test, where their verbal, analytical, quantitative/data interpretation and business awareness abilities will be tested.
After the screening round, applicants would be required to appear for a group discussion and personal interview. The interview is conducted through the video conferencing mode or in person.

After clearing all the rounds, the institution will notify the selected candidates of their admission status through email or other means. hostel_campus.college_name: DMS IIT Delhi Infrastructure Details & Reviews

hostel.description: IIT, Delhi has a total number of 14 hostel; 11 for boys and 3 for girls. The boys’ hostels are Nilgiri, Karakoram, Aravali, Jwalamukhi,Satpura, Zanskar, Kumaon, Vindyachal, Shivalik, Girnar and Udaigir. Kailiash and Himadri Hostels are for girls. Each hostel in the institute is self-contained with amenities such as a reading room, an indoor games room, a lounge and a dining hall with mess.All rooms have been provided with Internet facilities.Xeroxing facilities and STD/ISD/PCO facilities are available in all the Hostels.

library.description: The IIT Delhi Library System comprises of a Central Library and departmental libraries. The Library has subscribed to  journals and a rich collection of books, Bound Volumes of Journals, standards, microfilms, theses, video cassettes, CDs and online electronic journals.The Library provides photocopying facility within the premises of the Library through an external vendor on payment basis.Also facilitates internet service. The Departmental Library at the Vishwakarma Bhavan has an extensive collection of books, working papers, audiovisual resources, annual reports, and bound volumes of periodicals and literature related to the management sciences

reviews.review_heading: Master of Business Administration from DMS IIT Delhi.
reviews.review_text: DMS at IIT Delhi has excellent infrastructure for the MBA course. Our department has all necessary facilities such as a library, canteen, Wi-Fi, and other amenities. Sports facilities are also available for students, and the campus is quite spacious. Hostel facilities are provided to students as well.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Department of Management Studies, IIT Delhi.
reviews.review_text: The facilities available in my college were so super. Infrastructure of college was beautiful. Wi-Fi, classrooms, lab, and all things were available for the students. Library was not present in my college. The facility in my hostel canteen was so super. The food was very healthy and tasty. Medical facilities were also available. Sports and games were present in my college.

reviews.review_heading: Yes, you can take admission here.
reviews.review_text: The course is going to be tough; you have to be better in your studies. The course department is not as supportive as in a Ph.D.; you need to do a lot of research that requires a lot of time and effort but for this course, you do not have more resources, but you will have been given a high amount of pressure to publish a research paper.

reviews.review_heading: Reviews of Department of Management Studies, IIT Delhi.
reviews.review_text: Campus hostels had state-of-the-art facilities including labs and auditoriums and provided top facilities like Wi-Fi and library access. Food was above average in the mess and canteen and there were multiple food courts on campus. Campus had a 24X7 running hospital for medical emergencies.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Department of Management Studies, IIT Delhi.
reviews.review_text: The college has the best infrastructure compared to the other colleges in the city. Wi-Fi is available all around the campus. Our classrooms are very clean. The library has good books. We have clean washrooms. The hostel does not have good things. The food is the worst. Sports are good.

reviews.review_heading: Placements in our college aren't affected by Covid.
reviews.review_text: The campus life of the institute is students driven. It serves as a unique context of interaction among the students of different disciplines. SAC is the center of all the students' activities. The campus is equipped with a gymnasium, swimming pool, music room, etc. There are multiple hostels for boys and girls. We have a double sharing room in the 1st year and a single room in the 2nd year. Only vegetarian meals are served. The registration process is simple and the rent is affordable. The host...

reviews.review_heading: Review of Department of Management Studies, IIT Delhi.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, labs, library, and different things are generally great however one thing that annoys a lot is that they don't pay attention to your ideas or grievances commonly. Lodgings are all around great and perfect and different offices like wreck are additionally great, the culinary specialist prepares great food and is likewise well disposed of. There is a clinic where you get free examine as an understudy. Sports offices are simply great, practically every one of the games is there.

reviews.review_heading: Review of DMS IIT Delhi - Department of Management Studies.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is good. IIT hostels are built with students convenience. Quality of food, as well as variety, is great. In a typical week, we usually get all kinds of cuisines so that we don't get bored with the same food, and students get dishes from their native places.

reviews.review_heading: DMS, IIT Delhi is the best in terms of ROI.
reviews.review_text: Mostly IIT Delhi hostels are very old but are maintained well. There might be a feeling as it lacks space, but it is a delight to have a hostel life with your friends here. The food served in the mess isn't that bad, and there are separate mess committees in every hostel to take care of them.

reviews.review_heading: Really good faculty and infrastructure facilities.
reviews.review_text: DMS has all the facilities required for the students as being the finest institute if the research field is concerned. Institute has 24 hrs Wi-Fi facility, very well-equipped labs with all the facilities required and library with a lot of books. IIT Delhi being the well-known brand is very well-equipped with all the facilities regarding sports and games.

reviews.review_heading: Good college with good faculty members.

2. Except for the size of rooms of the hostels every thing is good. Size of room is a little bit small.

Beautiful campus with lots of greenery infrastructure was quite good air-conditioned labs, lecture halls, sports and recreation facilities, hostels as we used to share the campus with IIT students and it was a wonderful experience. Food of hostel is very good and Wi-Fi speed is ver...

reviews.review_heading: Good College with competent faculty members and students with a 100% placement record.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure and facilities provided by the college for our course are really good, and so much of support for the students from the faculty members side in enabling learning process. Hostel facilities and food are hygienic and good. Students are also given medical facility, and also sports and games facilities are also good.

reviews.review_heading: Superb and amazing time with good placements.

faqs.answer: The answer to this question of whether an average student can get into IIM can be both yes and no depending on the definition of an average student.Based on Academics (Class 10/ Class 12/ Graduation): While a student with average scores in Class 10, Class 12 and graduation with a good CAT score certainly has good chances of getting a call from IIM-A, chances are less for someone with an average CAT score.Based on student category (General or Reserved): While it is tough for a General category average student to grab a seat at IIM due to high score requirements, a reserved category student can get admission being at average scores as well.Based on past work experience, diversity and other factors: Gender and academic diversity is also a factor on which students are shortlisted at IIM. IIMs judge the past academic category based on the degree obtained by the students before MBA and then a weightage is allotted based on that. For Engineers, the percentage for scoring the highest marks is higher as compared with other streamsPerformance in selection rounds: Once you make it to the final selection rounds, i.e., AWT/PI process, it can be considered a fresh start. At this stage, students can forget their past average-ness but definitely require good grasp over the past subjects as academics-related questions are asked in the interview.Based on the above factors, it can be considered that while getting into top Management institutes, such as IIM is extremely tough, the past performance, CAT performance, student category and a lot of factors can be the reasons for a student to receive that final call.

paragraphs: IIM Lucknow admissionsare based on CAT scores for its flagship PGP programmes. The institute also considers scores in GMAT, XAT, GATE, etc. for admission to other courses.IIM Lucknowis one of the top IIMs with competitive admission process. The institute is ranked at '5' under the 'Management' category in NIRF 2025 rankings. Besides PGP, the institute offers Executive PGP, FPM and certificate programmes. Interested candidates have to fill out the application form for the preferred course.

People who intend to enroll to an IIM Lucknow course must be sure that they have verified the requirements before applying. In addition, the final seat distribution is done depending on the criteria of selection. The course-wise eligibility and selection is stated as under table:
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent with a minimum 50% aggregate
CAT+ WAT + PI
Download Test paper:FREECAT Mock Test
Executives with a Bachelor’s degree with a minimum 50% aggregate

In the case of the IIM Lucknow PGP, only those aspirants who have a valid CAT score that corresponds to the cutoff of admission in IIML are considered.Therefore, in the case of this flagship course, applicants will be required to go through the CAT application procedure and attend the examination.In case of other programs like Executive PGP, FPM or Certificate, the applications may be made directly through the official site of IIM Lucknow.In the case of the Executive PGP course, the accepted tests are GMAT/ CAT / XAT/ GATE/ PGP-WE Entrance Exam and in the case of FPM, the test would be CAT/ GATE/ GRE/ GMAT or JRF/ SRF (UGC/ CSIR/ ICAR).
STEP 1: IIM Lucknow Application Process 2025

The application process of Indian Institute of Management Lucknow is done online. For DPM course admission, after the online registration, candidates shall send a copy of the filled form along with all the documents through the post to the institute. For PGP, complete the CAT application process and for other courses, visit the institute's official website.
STEP 2: Written Ability Test (WAT)/Personal Interview Round

The applicants are shortlisted based on merit in the CAT entrance test and academic merit has to take the WAT/PI round. Further, a commutative score is calculated for final selections. For the other programmes, students who fulfil the minimum eligibility are shortlisted based on course-specific selection criteria.
STEP 3: Release of Merit List
Once all the selection rounds are completed, the selection list in terms of categories may be published on the official site.The candidates that get to the rank list become eligible to be admitted.
STEP 4: Confirmation
The selected candidates can confirm their seats by paying the required course admission fee.

faqs.question: What is the minimum eligibility criteria for admission to FPM?
faqs.answer: Candidates seeking admission to the IIM Lucknow FPM course must have a Masters's/ bachelor's degree or its equivalent in any discipline with a minimum of 55% aggregate. Also, applicants must not be more than 55 years old as of June 30 of the admission year. Apart from the minimum eligibility criteria, IIM Lucknow also accepts national-level entrance exams for admission to this course. For more details regarding IIM Lucknow University FPM eligibility and selection criteria,click here.

faqs.question: Can an average student get into an IIM?
faqs.answer: The answer to this question of whether an average student can get into IIM can be both yes and no depending on the definition of an average student.Based on Academics (Class 10/ Class 12/ Graduation):While a student with average scores in Class 10, Class 12 and graduation with a good CAT score certainly has good chances of getting a call from IIM-A, chances are less for someone with an average CAT score.Based on student category (General or Reserved):While it is tough for a General category average student to grab a seat at IIM due to high score requirements, a reserved category student can get admission being at average scores as well.Based on past work experience, diversity and other factors:Gender and academic diversity is also a factor on which students are shortlisted at IIM. placement_data.title: IIM Lucknow Placement Overview 2025
paragraphs: IIM Lucknow has concluded the placements for the Class of 2025. The students of the PGP and PGP - ABM batch 2025 secured 604 job offers in the academic year 2024-25. The highest and average package offered to the PGP and PGP - ABM students was INR 75 LPA and INR 32.3 LPA . The students secured offers from prominent recruiters of several domains like Consulting, Product, Tech, Sales & marketing, General Management, etc. C onsulting was the top recruiting domain with placement distribution of 38%. Accenture was the one of the top recruiters with 54 offers. Some of the top recruiters of IIM Lucknow in 2025 include Adobe, Deloitte, PwC, BCG, Ey, American Express, bain & Companiy, etc.

The highest and average package received by the 9th batch of PGP SM (2023-25) was INR 45.37 LPA and INR 22.66 LPA . The students secured 65% Sustainabilty roles and 35% General management Roles in the IIM Lucknow placement cycle 2025. IT sector emerged as the top recruiting sector with placement distribution of 32%.

IIM Lucknow has also published the 2025 placement report for the International Program in Management for Executives (IPMX). The average package for IPMX students in 2025 was INR 27.72 LPA while the median package was INR 27.19 LPA . 29 companies made placement offers and 38% of them were new recruiters.

The institute releases two types of CAT cutoffs, namely the Qualifying CAT cutoff and the Final CAT cutoff. Qualifying CAT cutoff is the minimum eligibility criteria for IIM Lucknow for the WAT-PI round. The final CAT cutoff is always higher than the qualifying cutoff.

faqs.answer: The answer to this question of whether an average student can get into IIM can be both yes and no depending on the definition of an average student.Based on Academics (Class 10/ Class 12/ Graduation): While a student with average scores in Class 10, Class 12 and graduation with a good CAT score certainly has good chances of getting a call from IIM-A, chances are less for someone with an average CAT score.Based on student category (General or Reserved): While it is tough for a General category average student to grab a seat at IIM due to high score requirements, a reserved category student can get admission being at average scores as well.Based on past work experience, diversity and other factors: Gender and academic diversity is also a factor on which students are shortlisted at IIM. IIMs judge the past academic category based on the degree obtained by the students before MBA and then a weightage is allotted based on that. For Engineers, the percentage for scoring the highest marks is higher as compared with other streamsPerformance in selection rounds: Once you make it to the final selection rounds, i.e., AWT/PI process, it can be considered a fresh start. placement_data.title: IIM Calcutta Placement Overview 2025
paragraphs: IIM Calcutta released the final placement details for MBA Class of 2025. 100% of the MBA batch 2025 received job offers from 196 participating recruiters . The placements were concluded in three clusters so that students achieved their desired job offers with choice of companies. The students were given Hold and Wait and Dream options in these clusters to improve their chances to get more offers from recruiters. The highest international and domestic packages offered to the MBA batch 2025 was INR 145 LPA and 91.45 LPA . Average package offered stood at INR 33.23 LPA . The top recruiters of Indian Institute of Management Calcutta in 2025 include Google, Microsoft, Capgemini, Adobe, Deloitte, BCG, Accenture, etc.

hostel.description: IIM Calcutta has 3 major hostels Old Hostel, White Hostel and New Hostel. While the Old Hostel is a co-ed hostel, with separate wings for girls, the White Hostel and New Hostel are both male hostels. All the hostels are equipped with all the facilities of a modern hostel. Facilities include common rooms, games rooms and courts for various sports in all hostels, where the students can relax and cool down after a hectic day of work.

library.description: IIM Calcutta has a well-stocked library with more than 1.6 lakhs volumes of books and bound journals. It subscribes to 500 journals and provides access to more than 40,000 online full text journals. It is equipped with modern facilities and the functions and services of the library are computerized, providing a lot of convenience. Overall, with its ambience of solidarity and magnificent facilities, it provides a rightful place to enlighten bright minds of the future.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with college.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure available for our course were extremely good. It provided world-class facilities. Library was available with a quality of reference books. The facilities in the hostel were also really good, like 5 5-star hotel. A large sports court was also present.

reviews.review_heading: Stable results in placement and academic performance.
reviews.review_text: The layout of the college was so amazing, and they are offering several courses at very low fees. Cameras are fixed at every main location of the campus, so unnecessary student behavior and movements in the campus area are not highly encouraged at any time.

reviews.review_heading: IIM Calcutta College review.
reviews.review_text: The college facilities like Wi-Fi in classrooms, huge central library, and all sports facilities for both indoor and outdoor are available on the campus and it is satisfactory. Hostel and mess are of average quality and acceptable. Overall, the infrastructure is very good, and it is value for money. Satisfied by the looks of this campus.

reviews.review_heading: MBA from one of the top management college.
reviews.review_text: IIM Calcutta has a very good infrastructure available for the MBA course. The college campus had all the facilities for the interactive and better learning of the students. Wi-Fi, labs, library, canteen, sports, hostel, medical, etc. facilities were available for the students at this college.

reviews.review_heading: Placements were excellent in 2019 batch.
reviews.review_text: The college has a great library and facilities. Students also enjoy paid subscription of some magazines. Sports facilities here are average. It is an old b-school and space allotted for games and sports is less. College has its own sports club and many talented students also. There are various clubs in this college. Hostels are decent, although the infrastructure is pretty old, but you still get AC facility. Other facilities in the hostel are also fine.

reviews.review_heading: Triple learning, Triple fun, Triple success.
reviews.review_text: ISI cal- Wi-Fi enabled campus, great library, and labs, classrooms have all modern amenities, food is a bit costly but very good. One and only Museum, great ambiance on campus, very supportive staff, very less students so peaceful.

reviews.review_heading: Best course for Business Analytics in India.
reviews.review_text: It is a tri-institute course. Facilities at IIM and IIT are really good and average in ISI Kolkata. Hostels at IIM Calcutta are really good with ACs attached, have Wi-Fi, sports complex and similar is the scenario at IIT KGP except hostels which are okayish. ISI hostels are also very good but campus has small classrooms. Food is good at IIM Calcutta, okayish in IIT KGP and ISI Kolkata.

reviews.review_heading: It has a fabulous return on investment.
reviews.review_text: The environment of the campus focuses on intellectual and personal growth as a close-knit community. Academic and administrative building rooms are different in size and seating capacity. There are group study areas, conference rooms, lounges, libraries, world-class hostels, etc. The hostel has single room accommodations with facilities like an air-conditioner, common washing machine, fridge, TV, and microwave. The allotment of family accommodation is limited and on request only.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is a perfect place for management studies.
reviews.review_text: All the basic facilities required for a student living in the management institutes are available. There's a well-equipped computer center, a finance lab, a huge library with a collection of online and offline collections of books, materials, journals, etc. The students-run committee at the institute organises various events and fests throughout the year. The best hostel facilities are provided to the students by our IIMC. All the rooms had all the basic necessities of the students. The mess foo...

reviews.review_heading: Campus placement opportunities are great.
reviews.review_text: IIM Calcutta has one of the best state-of-the-art infrastructures wherein all the facilities are provided for students. The institute has a very good campus atmosphere. There's a well-equipped computer center, a finance lab, a huge digital library, a sports arena, and an auditorium. The hostels provide a comfortable stay for the students. The rooms have twin-sharing beds which can be availed by the students as per their choice. The hostel blocks are enabled with a 24x7 Wi-Fi connection for the c...

reviews.review_heading: World class faculties with extra ordinary support for career development and job opportunities
reviews.review_text: There are around 7 hostels inside the IIM Calcutta campus. These are Ramanujan Hostel / Old Hostel, VLMP Hostel, Annexe Hostel, Tagore Hostel, New Hostel, Lake View Hostel & MDC. There is a guest house named Tata Hall which is used for visitors, guests, external faculty members. All hostels, guest houses are equipped with a 24x7 LAN internet facility along with Wi-Fi. The internet speed is pretty good here. Wi-Fi signal is available anywhere inside the campus. The library facility is one of the ...

reviews.review_heading: The oldest IIM, IIM Calcutta has top-notch pedagogy, infrastructure, and learning environment.
reviews.review_text: IIM Calcutta has a sprawling 135-acre campus, with its seven lakes and verdant beauty. The campus also has a post office, ATM facilities of both SBI and ICICI banks, a cafe coffee day outlet, and medical facilities. The library has a mammoth collection of more than 1.6 Lacs volumes of books and journals. It is equipped with modern facilities and the functions and services of the library are computerized, providing a lot of convenience. IIM Calcutta has state-of-the-art lab facilities and classro...

reviews.review_heading: Best MBA placements in India .
reviews.review_text: IIM Calcutta has one of the best state-of-the-art infrastructure. There's a well-equipped computer center, a finance lab, a huge digital library, a sports arena, and an auditorium. The hostels provide a comfortable stay for the MBA students here. The rooms have twin-sharing beds. The hostel blocks are enabled with 24X7 Wi-Fi connection for the computing needs of the students. The canteen provides a homely and a hygienic food varieties to the students.

reviews.review_heading: This is a must join college.
reviews.review_text: Being the oldest IIM, the infrastructure can't be an issue. We have been to foreign universities, and their facilities are not much better than ours. In addition, the campus has 7 lakes which make the landscape beautiful. There are modern multi-court sports area and a world-class gym. Hostels and other parts of campus are equipped with high-speed Wi-Fi facilities.

reviews.review_heading: PGPEX-VLM course for manufacturing executives.
reviews.review_text:
IIM C is well equipped with modern amenities, which makes it a world class institute. Wi-Fi is available in classrooms and hostels.

hostel.description:
Indian Institute of Management, Indore residential facilities include hostels for all the students.
Single-seated/ twin-sharing accommodation facilities are available for all the students in the campus premises with separate blocks/ floors for men and women. Each of the block has a square in the center where basketball/ badminton courts with artificial turf are maintained, with some blocks also having lawns in the square. Each hostel block has a common room where facilities such as wall-mounted televisions with DTH connection, table-tennis tables, dart game and carom and chess games are available and each block is also equipped with water coolers and water purifiers. The housekeeping staff is available throughout the week to take care of cleaning of rooms, corridors and rest rooms on a daily basis.

library.description: The IIM Indore Learning Centre (LC) with its modern collection of knowledge resources and innovative information services; fills an essential role for students, faculty, and the surrounding community in their intellectual pursuits. The resources available in LC include 2,50,000 e-books, 10000+ e-journals, 36,000 print books & bound journals, 59 databases, 150 print journals & magazines. It is a hybrid library with the state-of-the-art technological applications, holding knowledge resources predominantly related to management and allied subjects. The entire LC collection including the CD-ROM databases and the online databases are made available through Institute’s network. The LC offers a range of information services to support the learning process set to the highest professional standards. IIMI Library is an active member of IIM Consortia & INDEST Consortia.

reviews.review_heading: I like my college and our professors.
reviews.review_text: Our hostel facility is very good, and the food quality is good. Our college authority provided a high-speed internship to students. Our classroom is very good and big. But our college sports facilities are not very good. In our college, a well-stocked library is provided by the authority.

reviews.review_heading: Post graduate diploma in Management
reviews.review_text: The college is well developed in terms of digital communication and other infrastructure. Continuous internet connectivity, along with banking and medical facilities, is available within the campus zone. Classrooms are modernized with comfortable seating and other necessary requirements.

reviews.review_heading: Post graduate program in management at IIM Indore.
reviews.review_text: The exact fee range would basically above 2.5 lakhs and between 3 lakhs and 5.6 lakhs for the entire course duration which included hostels, placement, and other fees too. Even though the seats were too limited, the curious of students joining the college was unstoppable. College administration was so lethargic in responding.

reviews.review_heading: IIM Indore has a big name, but inside, it's not good, and there is no support.
reviews.review_text: Rooms are not clean, and the fans do not work sometimes. Wi-Fi is very slow. Classrooms are okay, but AC is not always available. The library is big, but there are old books. The mess food is bad, but the oil is old and not fresh. The canteen is costly. The sports ground is broken. Medical help comes late, and I'm not happy with the facilities.

reviews.review_heading: My review about this college.
reviews.review_text: Hostel stay was compulsory on the campus. The rooms were spaced enough with bed, table, and chair. Each student got a room in PG course while some PGP-HR students got a shared room. One of the drawbacks was that there was a set of washrooms on floors instead of attached washrooms in the room.

reviews.review_heading: IIM Indore College review.
reviews.review_text: The college had the best infrastructure compared to the other colleges in the city. Wi-Fi was available all around the campus. Our classrooms were very clean. The library had good books. We had clean washrooms. The hostel did not provide good things. The food was the worst. Sports were good.

reviews.review_heading: The college is overall good .
reviews.review_text: The IIM Indore campus spans over 200 acres. The institute has high-speed internet, well-equipped laboratories, air-conditioned classrooms, a conference hall, and a seminar hall. The main building looks like a building from heaven. Hostels are in good condition, and the mess and canteen food available is the best. The medical facilities are also provided by the college administration.

reviews.review_heading: Review of IIM Indore - Indian Institute of Management.
reviews.review_text: Facilities present in my course are so good. The infrastructure is not good. Wi-Fi, classrooms, and labs are present for students. The library is not available in the college. The canteen food is good. Medical facilities are present in my courses. Sports and games facilities are also present.

reviews.review_heading: Something about my college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is one of the best perks of IIM Indore. Spanning almost 200 acres, there is a sports complex with various activities, including a swimming pool, squash court, sauna, gym, etc., two large auditoriums, many food courts, and a lot of lush greenery. The campus is very clean and peaceful.

reviews.review_heading: Shiksha college review online.
reviews.review_text: The facilities available in my college were so super. Infrastructure of the college was very good. Wi-Fi, classrooms, library, and all things were available for students. The quality and facility in my hostel canteen were so good. Food was very tasty and medical facilities were available. Sports and games were also present for the students.

reviews.review_heading: Very resourceful and well satisfying facilities.
reviews.review_text: The overall facilities and infrastructure available for our department are very satisfying. Classrooms and labs are modified and well-maintained. A well-stocked library is available, with a vast collection of books. The quality of food available in the mess and canteen is hygienic.

reviews.review_heading: Excellent management and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The overall facilities and infrastructure available for our department are very good. The classrooms and labs are well-maintained and very modified. A well-stocked library with a vast collection of books is present. The quality of food available in the mess and canteen is hygienic.

reviews.review_heading: Great facilities and faculty members.
reviews.review_text: Facilities available in our college are very satisfying. Our classrooms and labs are very modified and well-maintained. Wi-Fi is available for everyone. Many varieties of food items are present in the canteen. The quality of the food is also very good.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with almost everything.
reviews.review_text: The hostel facilities at the Indian Institute of Management (IIM) in Indore are known for being comfortable and well-maintained. Here are some key aspects of the hostel's facilities: The rooms are air-conditioned and well-furnished, with facilities such as a B.Ed. wardrobe and study table. The hostels have their own dining facilities, serving nutritious and tasty meals to students. The hostels are equipped with high-speed Wi-Fi and laundry facilities for the convenience of students. The hostels ...

reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi: Good, it has a backup line as well. Wi-Fi and storage capacity: very limited and troublesome. MDI Gurgaon Application Process 2025

Apply throughmdi.ac.in. Fill details carefully in the admission form. The application fee (INR 1,000 for Online PGDM, and INR 3000 for PGDM) must be paid to apply successfully. Aspirants must also ensure that they submit theirMDI Gurgaon formwithin the due date.
Release of Cutoff/Merit List

For MDI Gurgaon admission, the expected percentile is above 95. Moreover, MDI does not release the cutoff in the public domain. Read more aboutMDI Gurgaon Cutoff.
Shortlisting of Students

After the conclusion of the application process and cutoff list declaration, candidates are shortlisted based on the accepted exam scores. Some of the national-level exams accepted by the institute are CAT/GMAT/XAT/MAT, etc. Shortlisted candidates further become eligible for participation in the next selection round.
Other Selection Rounds
Applicants get shortlisted due to exam scores. After that, they will appear in group discussion and personal interview round.
Admission Confirmation

Based on the applicant's overall performance in the selection rounds, exam score and profile, the final selection is done. Before seat allotment, aspirants may have to go through document verification. After which, candidates shall pay theMDI Gurgaon feeto confirm their seat.

faqs.question: Can I get direct admission in MDI Gurgaon?
faqs.answer: Yes, Management Development Institute also offers direct admission through the management quota. Candidates seeking admission must visit the official website of the University to register themselves. Candidates have to make an online payment irrespective of the number of programmes they apply for.

faqs.question: Does MDI Gurgaon accept CAT score?
faqs.answer: Yes, MDI acceptsXAT,CAT,MAT,GMAT, andGREscores for admission. Management Development Institute, Gurgaon offers many post-graduate programmes including PGDM, PGDM (HR), PGDM (IB) and executive programmes. Candidates can apply online after registering for Common Admissions Test (CAT). GMAT is applicable only for foreign nationals, NRIs, and PIOs. There is one Common Application Form for all three programmes given above. In the online Application Form, aspirants need to mention their programme preference in order. At the time of the admissions offer, candidates will be informed about the programme they are selected for.

faqs.question: Is Management Development Institute, Gurgaon application window open for Executive PGDM?
faqs.answer: Yes, MDI Gurgaon is currently accepting applications for the round one of admission to executive PGDM Business Management course. The applications were released on Nov 5 and the last date to apply isMar 28. In addition, the interviews will tentatively be conducted onApr 13,  2025. Moreover, the course will commence fromSep 1.

placement_data.title: MDI Gurgaon Placement Overview 2025
paragraphs: The batch included 311 students from PGDM program , 114 students from PGDM-IB program, 28 students from PGDM-BAN program and 125 students from the PGDM-HRM program. 75% of the total students enrolled from an Engineering background, while the remaining students were from other backgrounds such as Arts, Science, etc.
During PGDM and PGDM IB placement 2025, the Consulting sector recorded most number of offers. The conglomerates sector was the top recruiting sector during PGDM HRM and PGDM BAN placements.
Moreover, the highest and average stipends offered during MDI Gurgaon summer placements 2025 stood at INR 4.7 lakh and INR 2.5 lakh , respectively. The median stipend offered stood at INR 2.5 lakh .

hostel.description: Provides on-campus hostel accommodation facility for students of PGPM, PGP-HR, and PGP-IM in Change Masters, Takshashila and twin-sharing/four-sharing in Kshitij. The hostel has separate blocks for the girl students called Oddessy (twin-sharing) & Kaveri (twin/triple sharing). Students are required to bring their own PC with LAN card. All the hostels have basic amenities like water purifiers, common room, recreation room, mess, laundry services, security and surveillance system etc. The students may bring their own mattress, bed linen, toiletries and locks for almirah and hostel rooms though these are also available in the student-run co-operative store “Mart”.The institute also has a separate Executive hostel with air-conditioned rooms equipped with modern gadgets. MDI also has an arrangement with Warsaw School of Economics, Poland, Lahore University of Management Sciences, Pakistan for providing free accommodation on reciprocal basis (each out-going student pays the rent for the in-coming student).

reviews.review_heading: Expect teachers, everything is good.
reviews.review_text: The campus is situated in the industrial hub Gurgaon. The College building looks like a monument. On special occasions, it is decorated with lighting. The institute has all modern facilities including Wi-Fi service, labs are clean and maintained. I like the library it is a very quiet place, we can take books and study in the reading room. Yes college has hostel facility but I lived in PG which is near to college. I have some bad reviews about the college food, it is not eatable. First aid kits, ...

reviews.review_heading: The college provides top class facilities and faculty for our course.
reviews.review_text: Our college has a well developed and maintained infrastructure. Our course department has Wi-Fi, labs, library, canteen, etc. Facilities are available for the students. The quality of these facilities are good. Hostel facility is also available for the students. Mess food was good to eat.

reviews.review_heading: Nice college with all facilities.
reviews.review_text: The hostel infrastructure is definitely one of the best on campus, which is huge. Wi-Fi facilities are available throughout the campus, and the labs and classrooms are well-organized. The hostel facilities are quite good, and the mess food is awesome. Additionally, sports and games are conducted.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is a great institute with amazing placements.
reviews.review_text: There are various festivals, events, competitions, and seminars organised for students welfare. Quality content is provided by the library with more than 50,000 books and 15,000 E-Journals. Clubs and Communities are there for well-being. College provided separate hostels for both girls and boys with necessities. Rooms are spacious with attached bathrooms. Food provided by the hostel mess is good with many food options.

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides exceptional infrastructure and placements.
reviews.review_text: Campus life is great. Classrooms are well-maintained. Books are easily available and provided. Students have a comfortable and a pleasant stay at the hostels with basic necessities like twin sharing bedrooms with attached bathrooms, bed, a study table, a chair, a closet, etc. Mess serves a variety of quality non-vegetarian and vegetarian foods which are prepared under hygienic conditions.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is a place where dreams become reality.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure are up to the mark. The immersion and the interaction with the peers aid the overall development. Food served is good and we also have gym and other activities to aid the physical fitness. We have parking for outsiders and close vicinity with the markets.

reviews.review_heading: Our college has great faculty members and placements.
reviews.review_text: The campus life at MDI, Gurgaon is one of its kind. All events like annual festivals, cultural events, industry tours, workshops, industry tours & seminars are conducted grandly throughout the year. The college library provides more than 50,000 books to students. Various clubs have been made for the overall development of students. Hostel life is a very important part of the management field students because of the schedule of the programs. So good faculty members are required by students & MDI ...

reviews.review_heading: Our college has great students, great placements and great campus life.
reviews.review_text: Our college has a good hostel and labs. All facilities are provided as per industry demands.

reviews.review_heading: MDI Gurgaon-Amazing place to be.
reviews.review_text: All the facilities provided are of the highest quality. The library is equipped with the resources which are helpful in the curriculum as well as about various industries. Access to various online journals add to the knowledge and enable us to have deeper insights. 24*7 high-speed internet makes the job easier. Medical facilities, food in mess and canteen, sports and games are all up to the mark.

reviews.review_heading: Best college in North India.
reviews.review_text: MDI Gurgoan is spread over 40 Acres of land with excellent infrastructure including classes, canteen basketball, tennis and football ground. All the facilities are available 24*7. Campus is fully wi-fi connected. Mess food is good. Hostels are spacious with double and triple occupancy.

reviews.review_heading: It was fun learning in MBA.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is the best, which includes a state-of-the-art computer centre, best and huge library, wonderful greenery, Wi-Fi, student support and reading classes are available on the campus. Infrastructure is being develope for air-conditioned hostels. There is a wide green space to enjoy, exercise and yoga for good health. There is a cricket pitch, football ground, golf course, badminton courts and lawn tennis courts available on the campus.

reviews.review_heading: Highly satisfied, Best college.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of the college is very decent which can be improved in the future. It has all the necessary facilities like Wi-Fi, spacious classrooms with high-tech whiteboard, library, auditorium etc. All available for 24 hrs. Quality of food is also very good and hygienic. No, I have not faced any infrastructure related issues till now.

reviews.review_heading: One of the best colleges from where you can do MBA.
reviews.review_text: The college is located in the middle of Gurgaon and the infrastructure of the college is very good. We have auditorium, computer labs, discussion rooms etc. The hostel rooms are with double occupancy and house cleaning staff support. The food in the mess is okay and can be improved.

reviews.review_heading: Placements and campus are excellent. One can have the advantage of being in the corporate hub.
reviews.review_text: The campus is lush green and is spread over 40 acres. It has all the amenities such as smart classrooms, sports complex, and computer centre, etc. There are spacious hostels with excellent food including non-vegetarian food varieties and desserts. Minor issues relating to room maintenance/Wi-Fi were experienced on the campus. The library is kept open for 24 hours.

reviews.review_heading: A review of MDI Gurgaon for students.
reviews.review_text: The campus is spread over 40 acres. It is an enclosed lush green campus and is equipped with state-of-art classrooms, IT infrastructure, library, students hostel, playgrounds, gym, etc. The infrastructure is one of the best parts of MDI. You can get every required facility within the campus along with two night canteens.

data.description: The faculty of MDI Gurgaon is awarded 4.4 stars by various Shiksha-verified students. All the faculty members are PhD holders and have good industry experience. As per the student's reviews, it can be said that the teachers are friendly and problem-solving.

overview_faqs.question: What is the XAT application fee?
overview_faqs.answer: The XAT application fee is INR 2,200. The XAT fee is to be paid online at the time of forms submission. The fee is same for candidates belonging to all categories. Unlike other MBA entrance exams, there is no rebate for Reserved category candidates in XAT. If you select XLRI in the application form for admission, you will have to pay INR 200 additionally.The fee can be paid via debit/credit card, cash card, mobile wallets, or net-banking. It is mandatory to pay the application fee before deadline for successful registration. Candidates can fill the application form and pay the fee later, however they will need to make the fee payment before the registration deadline so that their form is accepted by the examination authority. Until the fee is paid, the XAT application form will remain pending acceptance. Candidates must note that the registration fee is non-refundable. So, they should fill the form without error, otherwise they will have to fill the form again and pay the fee again.

Candidates must appear for the XAT entrance test to be eligible forXLRI PGDM admission 2026. Soon after the declaration of the XAT result, XLRI releases the admission cutoff list. Those who meet theXAT cutoff, are eligible to appear for the Personal Interview (PI) round ofXLRI course admission. Candidates with a valid GMAT or GRE score can also apply for PGDM GM. The institute selects candidates for Executive programmes based on their XAT or GMAT scores.
Candidates must have a valid national-level entrance exam score such as XAT, GMAT, GRE, GATE, UGC-JRF or NET for admission to FPM programme.
3:Final Admission

The college shortlists students for PI based on their entrance exam scores. Apart from national-level entrance exam scores and screening of applications, XLRI also considers work experience, educational background and extracurricular activities.
4:Admission Confirmation

The final merit list and admission confirmation is based on XAT scores, Group Discussion and Personal Interview, etc. The institute releases the merit list of selected students for the final admission.

placement_data.title: XLRI Jamshedpur Placement Overview 2025
paragraphs: 172 companies visited XLRI Jamshedpur campus during the 2025 placements for its PGDM (BM), PGDM (HRM), and PGDM (GM) batch. Students were offered 600 domestic and 2 international job offers. The highest international and domestic packages offered to PGDM BM and HRM students during XLRI Jamshedpur placement 2025 stood at INR 110 LPA and INR 75 LPA , respectively. A total of 41 new recruiters visited the campus and extended 34.17% PPOs to the Cohort 2025. T he Consulting sector emerged as the top recruiting sector with 26% offers made, followed by BFSI with 22% offers extended to the batch 2025.

Additionally, the PGDM (GM) batch 2025 comprised 112 students, of which 107 opted for placements and 103 were placed in new-age job roles with handsome packages. The highest and average package offered to PGDM (GM) students during XLRI Jamshedpur placement 2025 stood at INR 75 LPA and INR 28.78 LPA, respectively. The IT Consulting and IT Operations sector emerged as the top recruiting sector with 28% offers made to PGDM (GM) batch 2025, followed by BFSI with 20% offers made.

reviews.review_text: Our college library is one of the most extensively stocked libraries and has almost every book an MBA student might need. There is a multitude of premium subscriptions for students like HBR, Economic Times, etc. Each classroom is equipped with high-speed Wi-Fi and charging points. There are multiple study rooms available for students. XLRI also has a fully equipped gymnasium, football field, and volleyball court. Each student gets a single room with a wardrobe, a bed, a table, and a chair. There...

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides awesome placements and friendly faculty members.
reviews.review_text: Campus has an amazing environment which is well facilitated with the necessary facilities. There is a recreational room, sports ground, auditorium, seminar halls, computer labs, finance labs, medical emergency facilities, video conferencing facilities, etc. Hostel facilities offered were very satisfactory. Single rooms were provided to every student which was facilitated with the best facilities. Food served in the mess was top-class in quality. Both vegetarian and non-vegetarian food varieties ...

reviews.review_heading: Review of XLRI Xavier School of Management.
reviews.review_text: Sports infrastructure was good in this college. The campus was always alive. The library was extensive and comfortable and there was rarely any book students will not find here. Classrooms were equipped with the latest infrastructure. The hostels were clean, all students had their room but shared washrooms. The meal quality was medium and overall all the amenities were good enough. The premises were cleaned regularly and students can voice concerns if needed. Apart from some negligible issues, t...

reviews.review_heading: Our college is worth all the hard-earned money.
reviews.review_text: Sports activities are given a lot of importance at XLRI. There are separate fields and areas for badminton, basketball, cricket, football, tennis, and volleyball. A sports festival named Ensemble Valhalla is also organised here. XLRI has a perfect environment for learning. Sir Jahangir Library has over 69,500 books, 49 electronic resources and databases, 90 print magazines and journals, etc. There are 22 classrooms with a seating capacity of 70, and each classroom has been designed like an amphi...

reviews.review_heading: There were excellent placements in our batch.
reviews.review_text: Our college infrastructure is modern and has decent classrooms and mess facilities. The food served in the mess and canteen is affordable, and its price is fair. There are 3 computer laboratories and research classrooms. The library has a good collection of books, journals and magazines and has a decent studying area also. The campus is beautiful and near to a natural environment. There is an arrangement for sports activities also, but we got very less time due to constant studies and internship...

reviews.review_heading: There is no better college than this.
reviews.review_text: Every sporting facility, top-class library, lush green environment, amazing weather and internet connectivity are very seamless. The academic rigor and extra activities are always conducted here.

reviews.review_heading: It is a professional course with ample learning and improvement opportunities.
reviews.review_text: My classmates are staying in the hostels, and I get to know information from them regarding various facilities provided to them. The campus has a high functioning Wi-Fi facility and a library with many latest journals from scientific and management publishing authorities. Sports facilities provided here include a tennis court and basketball court for all the students.

reviews.review_heading: Great culture which ensures senior-junior interaction and peer learning, amazing placements.
reviews.review_text: Every facility is available, library is huge along with an option of remote access of resources. Learning centers are air-conditioned with all the necessary facilities. Wi-Fi is available almost everywhere in the campus. Hostels have single sharing rooms with all the necessary facilities. Ample number of washing machines and water coolers are available on every floor. Laundry and dry cleaning services are also available in campus.

reviews.review_heading: Review of XLRI Xavier School of Management.
reviews.review_text: XLRI has a superb campus in Jamshedpur with all the facilities, which students would require in a top college. Unlike engineering college, B-School hostels are much better in terms of facilities and also in food quality. XLRI is a private college, so all the facilities in the hostel and mess were good.

reviews.review_heading: XLRI Jamshedpur is amongst the top 10 B Schools of India.
reviews.review_text: XLRI Jamshedpur Campus is best in its class. It was really very great pleasure and proud to spend 2 golden years of our life at this campus. Campus is very well developed with various facilities. Our hostel facility was also good, I always felt that I was at my home only.

reviews.review_heading: Brilliant must have experience.
reviews.review_text: It has top-notch in terms of available facilities and infrastructure. The quality of life at XLRI is brilliant art both academics and extra curriculums, the standard of food and amenities available is above par and is in line with the few they ask. The campus is very beautiful.

reviews.review_heading: Review of XLRI Xavier School of Management.
reviews.review_text: Labs were all equipped with Wi-Fi which was pretty decent. Since it is an old college, so classroom infrastructure was a bit outdated, but still, they have now built a separate building to accomodate the increasing students. Library and classrooms are above average. Food served is awesome, and the rest things are above average.

reviews.review_heading: It is a perfect college for MBA.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure is excellent. There are single rooms in the hostel. The campus is enabled with Wi-Fi. Moreover, LAN nodes are also provided in all the hostel as well as classrooms. The library is equipped with 1.5 lacs books and has functional seating capacity.

reviews.review_heading: Premier business school, provides everything that you expect!
reviews.review_text: The hostels are clean and hygienic, with single room occupancy. The entire campus has a Wi-Fi access. The classrooms and library are air conditioned and adequate in size. The mess food is very good as compared to the general perception of food available on hostels. There is a 24/7 infirmary and doctor availability. There are facilities for most popular sports like Football, Badminton, Cricket, Snooker, Table tennis etc.

individual_reviews.course: MBA in Innovation and Entrepreneurship - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: The college is good enough to study according to Indian standards.

content.Placements: There are very good placements, and 80% of students get placed. The highest package is 53 LPA and the lowest package is 28.83 LPA. IBM and KPMG are the top companies. A high percentage of students get great internship opportunities. Roles like business analyst, advisory, data science, market researcher, and risk analyst are offered to students.
content.Infrastructure: There are three hostels which are located in new, old and annex within close range to mess with double, triple and single sharing rooms separately for boys and girls. The food is also good enough with proper quality check and clealiness. There are sports and entertainment facilities.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: College campus is large enough.

content.Placements: The chance for placement begins in the fifth trimester, in addition to the replacement offer. Campus visitors from Microsoft, Dabur, JP Morgan Chase and Company, Goldman Sachs, and DE Shaw. 200 candidates were hired. Microsoft's top domestic package is Rs. 45 Lacs, and the typical is Rs. 21 Lacs. Finance, Sales and Marketing, Consulting, International Business, IT, Analytics, and Trade are among the available profiles. I intend to work for a reputable trade company like Cargill, Olam International, or Cofico after receiving my degree.
content.Infrastructure: The college does not have its boys hostel it has three girls hostels of its own they have tie ups with private hostels there are hostel which offer you a room at 90,000 to hostels where the price is 2,75,000 the food is good in my hostel I would recommend a first year student to stay in a hostel for a year then shift to a flat.

individual_reviews.course: MBA in Innovation and Entrepreneurship - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: My review of this college.

content.Placements: The placement cell works to bring in companies that might be interested in campus recruitment. However, the college does not guarantee 100% placements, but I'll tell you why that's fine. The average pay is 6-7 LPA, whereas the maximum goes to 17 LPA, depending on market conditions. The key recruiters are TCS, Infosys, Deloitte, Accenture, Tech Mahindra, Capgemini, Tata Motors, Flipkart, Snapdeal, Amazon, Vodafone, Airtel, Reliance Industries, Virtusa, and many more. Even Microsoft visits the campus. Companies from various domains such as operators, consulting, network, VAS, digital media, etc. Packages vary upon the company and skill sets of students.

individual_reviews.title: A total package of learning combined with fun.

paragraphs: The SIBM Pune application process for both programmes is conducted in online mode. Candidates applying for a full-time MBA and MBA (IE) have to register for SNAP. SIBM Pune admission is a multi-step process. Candidates can refer to the following steps to understand each stage of the admission process:
1. The applications are accepted via online mode. You can apply atwww.sibm.edu. Aspirants need to pay an application fee ofINR 1,000for SNAP and submit it before the last date.
2. SIBM Pune MBA course admission is done based on the candidate's score on the SNAP test.

3. Candidates are shortlisted based on scores in the entrance exam. Candidates who have applied for an MBA have to participate in group exercises and interview round. For the EMBA course, candidates are shortlisted based on merit and directly called for a personal interview.

4. The institute releases the merit list on the official website of the institute. Following the seat matrix, the seats are allotted to candidates based on merit in the entrance exam and personal interview. Selected candidates can pay theSIBM Pune feeto further confirm their seats.
