sports.description: To support students' overall development, the institute features multiple playgrounds, including areas for cricket and football. Options for outdoor games include basketball while taking in the institute's scenic hilltop views, with a professional court dedicated to basketball. These sports facilities also motivate students to take their sporting pursuits seriously.

reviews.review_heading: The college is good enough to study according to Indian standards.
reviews.review_text: There are three hostels which are located in new, old and annex within close range to mess with double, triple and single sharing rooms separately for boys and girls. The food is also good enough with proper quality check and clealiness. There are sports and entertainment facilities.

reviews.review_heading: College campus is large enough.
reviews.review_text: The college does not have its boys hostel it has three girls hostels of its own they have tie ups with private hostels there are hostel which offer you a room at 90,000 to hostels where the price is 2,75,000 the food is good in my hostel I would recommend a first year student to stay in a hostel for a year then shift to a flat.

reviews.review_heading: My review of this college.
reviews.review_text: One of the best campuses in the country. Hostel rooms are clean and airy and are available on twin or 3-sharing. The hostel has a basketball court,  2 badminton courts, a squash court, a swimming pool, a football stadium, a gym, and an aerobics centre. There are PGs around within the range of Rs. 5,000 to Rs. 10,000 per month. However, by the second year, most students prefer staying in flats with their friends, and they are all available close to the college. The course is divided into trimeste...

reviews.review_heading: A total package of learning combined with fun.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure facilities offered at SIBM Pune are state of the art. We are blessed with beautiful and picturesque campus at the top of lavale hills. We have a state of art library as well as access to online database like EBSCO and Prowess IQ. The classrooms are equipped with technology to help learning and presentations. The campus has a hostel to support the residential programme.

reviews.review_heading: Come and experience the beautiful phase of transformation at the hilltop heaven.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure facilities offered at SIBM Pune are state of the art. We are blessed with beautiful and picturesque campus at the top of the Lavale hills. We have a world-class library and access to online databases like Ebsco and ProwessIQ. The classrooms are equipped with technology to help learning and presenting in an effective manner. The campus has a hostel to support a residential programme.

reviews.review_heading: An amazing place to spend the most valuable 2 years of your life.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure facilities offered at SIBM Pune are state of the art. We are blessed with beautiful and picturesque campus at the top of the Lavale Hills. We have a state-of-the-art library as well as access to online databases like Ebsco and ProwessIQ databases. The classrooms are equipped with technology to help learning and presentations. The campus has a hostel to support a residential programme.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with faculty and placements of the college.
reviews.review_text: The facilities provided by the college are great whether its e-library to online classes or providing Wi-Fi facilities. Everything was available in the institute. The hostel facilities of the college are also great as they have various different types of hostels with good mess and medical facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Great college and campus.
reviews.review_text: SIBM Pune is the hilltop heaven. The campus is really a heaven, surrounded with greenery, it feels like a scenic beauty. Many Bollywood movies are shot in SIBM Pune. The hostels are wonderful as well. There is double/triple/quadruple sharing rooms, with attached washrooms.

reviews.review_heading: Hill-top heaven, great campus life, very good placement scenario.
reviews.review_text: SIBM Pune is situated at lavale hills, and it is referred as Hill-top heaven. The institute has great infrastructure in terms of Academics, Hostels, sports and extra curricular activities. Special mention would be behavioral lab, bloomberg terminal,  2 huge Auditoriums and fully wi-fi campus.

reviews.review_heading: Review about Symbiosis institute of business management, Pune.
reviews.review_text: SIBM Pune is defined as hilltop heaven. The major reason is because of its excellent campus located at the hills of lavale with an excellent cafeteria called symbieats and world-class library facilities provided for the students. We have 2 girls and 2 boys hostels and apart from that we have mess, cafeteria and laundry services in the campus.

reviews.review_heading: The college has great placements and amazing campus life.
reviews.review_text: Rooms in the hostel are spacious, and LAN helps us with great internet speed. Wi-Fi is available throughout the campus. Classrooms are good, and the library has all varieties of books. Bloomberg terminal and information technology lab is also available here to help us.

reviews.review_heading: Placements and infrastructure are good, but the salary package offered is average.
reviews.review_text: Labs, classrooms and library facilities are good, but there is an issue with Wi-Fi at some places on the campus. Food quality is not that great, but on some days in a week, we get good food. Sports facilities are pretty good. Medical facilities are good, but they are a bit far from the hostel.

reviews.review_heading: Wonderful college with a beautiful campus life making it one of the best B-school of the nation.
reviews.review_text: Pretty decent room with good Wi-Fi connection. Library is wonderful with huge collection of books and e-books. Quality of food at the mess is decent enough. Decent lush green campus with good facilities for sports. Great medical facilities which is available 24*7.

reviews.review_heading: Get to know more about SIBM!
reviews.review_text: Hostel is fantastic. It is extremely hygienic, clean, neat and provides ample amenities and space to all students. Typically available in three and two sharing (unsure about others), it allows you to bond with people from other colleges apart from the college you are from. The mess and canteen are equally good. You get plenty of food- variety of options. Also, the mess menu typically changes weekly.

reviews.review_heading: SIBM Pune has got one of the best infrastructures in the country with 100% placements.
reviews.review_text: SIBM Pune has got one of the best infrastructures in the country. It has got the best Library facility, world-class labs, and classrooms. The hostel facilities are really nice. It has all facilities nearby like laundry, mess and sports facilities for the students.

faqs.answer: The Science and the HSS Department of IIT Kharagpur started four-year BSc programme admission to which is subject to a valid rank in JEE Advanced exam. Aspirants seeking IIT Kharagpur BSc and Integrated MSc admission need to qualify for both JEE Main and JEE Advanced exams to get shortlisted. For eligibility, candidates are required to have completed their Class 12 with a minimum of 75% aggregate. Those who would like to earn an MSc degree are given the option to do so at the end of the sixth semester of the BSc programme. Accordingly, the seventh and eighth semesters are planned so that a candidate gets an MSc degree at the end of the tenth semester.

faqs.question: Which branch should I choose at IIT Kharagpur? Are the placements better than other similarly ranked IITs?
faqs.answer: IIT Kharagpur, IIT Hyderabad and IIT Guwahati are three similarly-ranked Engineering institutes in India that are closely ranked by the NIRF Ranking Institution. Needless to say, these institutes have outstanding academic and placement achievements. Students look for informed decisions while choosing between the three. In NIRF Engineering ranking 2025 , IIT Kharagpur stands at 5th position, whereas, IIT Guwahati and IIT Hyderabad are ranked at 8th and 7th position, respectively . Thus, indicating a close competition between the three. IIT Kharagpur outshines IIT Hyderabad and IIT Guwahati for having the largest campus area and being the oldest IIT. IIT Kharagpur came into existence in 1951, whereas, IIT Guwahati and IIT Hyderabad were established in 1994 and 2008, respectively. Comparing the institutes on academic grounds, IIT Kharagpur (108) offers a larger number of full-time courses than IIT Hyderabad and IIT Guwahati. In terms of placements, IIT Guwahati has released the overall statistics for BTech. IIT Kharagpur wins the race with the highest package of INR 2.40 crore per annum. The second slot is taken by IIT Guwahati with the highest package of INR 1.20 crore per annum. Then comes, IIT Hyderabad highest package of INR 90 LPA. The table below represents the IIT Kharagpur highest package comparison with other closely ranked IITs for the BTech placements: IIT Name BTech (Highest Package) IIT Kharagpur INR 2.40 crore per annum IIT Guwahati - INR 1.20 crore per annum (domestic) - INR 72 LPA (international) IIT Hyderabad INR 90 LPA Students looking for more elaborated branch-wise placement information can read the below section comparing IIT Kharagpur and IIT Hyderabad. The highest package grabbed by the CE batch 2022 during the IIT Kharagpur phase-I placements was INR 55 LPA. The IIT Hyderabad CE highest package was very close and stood at INR 52 LPA. For other branches, such as CH, CS, EE, and ME, IIT Kharagpur beats IIT Hyderabad in terms of the highest package

For the exact fee, students can reach out to the admission office. Other than this, students are required to pay the JEE Main application fee which is INR 625 (for boys) and INR 325 (for girls). For JEE Advanced, the application fee ranges from INR 1,400 to INR 2,800 for different category students. Read more about IIT-KGP BTech fee and other details here . To answer the second question of whether IIT Kharagpur BTech fee is expensive or not, the fee for all IITs is almost similar to each other. Through the years, the NIRF rankings for IIT Kharagpur indicate the institute's strong performance in crucial areas such as the Quality of Education, Conducting Impactful Research, the Expertise of Faculty members, and Overall Institutional Management. These good rankings not only prove the institute's positive reputation but also highlight its excellence across diverse domains, evaluated against the standards established by the NIRF. It has been seen that in the 'Overall' category, the institute's ranks have shown a fluctuating trend when evaluated against the ranking of the prior year. In 2025, IIT Kharagpur's rank is #6, the same as last year's rank in the 'Overall' category by the NIRF ranking.
It has been seen that within the category of 'Engineering', the institute's ranking has fluctuation when compared with the previous year's ranking. In 2025, IIT Kharagpur's rank is #5, the same as last year's rank in the 'Engineering' category by the NIRF ranking.
It is to be noticed that the institute has shown a fluctuating trend in the 'Management' category as compared to the ranking of preceding years. In 2025, IIT Kharagpur climbed 7 ranks to #12 rank in the 'Management' category by the NIRF ranking.
In the 'Law' category, the institute's ranks have ascended when compared with the previous year's ranking. In 2025, IIT Kharagpur climbed 1 rank to #6 rank in the 'Law' category by the NIRF ranking. This is the second consecutive year that the institute has ascended in the rankings.
Explore the IIT Kharagpur latest rankings by other ranking bodies and their categories below:

qs_world.description:
Based on the rankings from QS World University Rankings, IIT Kharagpur outperformed numerous other institutes, securing a higher position, indicating that the institute is considered to be doing better in various factors evaluated by the QS World University Rankings system. In the 'Top Global Universities' category, the institute's ranks have improved in comparison with last year's ranking. In 2026, IIT Kharagpur climbed 7 ranks to #215 rank in the 'Top Global Universities' category by the QS World University Rankings. This is the second consecutive year that the institute has ascended in the rankings.
It has been observed that the institute has displayed a decreasing trend in the 'Asia' category as compared to the ranking of preceding years. In 2026, IIT Kharagpur fell 17 ranks to #77 rank in the 'Asia' category by the QS World University Rankings. This is the second consecutive year that the institute has slipped in the rankings.
In the 'Southern Asia' category, the institute's ranks have shown a fluctuation when compared with the previous year's ranking. In 2026, IIT Kharagpur fell 2 ranks to #6 rank in the 'Southern Asia' category by the QS World University Rankings.

reviews.review_heading: A land of opportunities where legacy meets innovation.
reviews.review_text: The department being one of the most heavily funded and having state-of-the-art technology in the labs students get to work with reliable and modern instruments and labs. The infrastructure offered for the students in the course of biotechnology is very good and one of the best in the country. The quality of food in hostels is fine not too good not dreadful either. The medical facilities are free for students. There are a lot of grounds for each sport and all the sports and games are taught as p...

reviews.review_heading: If you want to go ahead with your dream, then it's your best college.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi was present everywhere. Fully furnished labs, digital classrooms, and a central library were present on the college campus itself. Hostels were of top quality with AC rooms, speed Wi-Fi, clean and green campus, fully styled rooms, and a digital movie theatre.

reviews.review_heading: Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur B.Sc. Geology Review.
reviews.review_text: Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur has decent labs, classrooms, modern libraries with 24/7 Wi-Fi facility, sports facilities. There are primary healthcare centers, auditoriums, banks, shops, and restaurants available on the campus of IIT Kharagpur itself.

reviews.review_heading: The best part of my life is spent here at IIT Kharagpur.
reviews.review_text: This college's infrastructure and quality of things are very high and provide many facilities to the students. In this course, facilities are available like fast Wi-Fi, classrooms, labs, fans, bathrooms, branches, hostels, canteens, etc. In this college, the canteen food is very tasty; it is like homemade food.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied because of the faculty, good peer connection, and night walks.
reviews.review_text: This college's infrastructure and quality of facilities are very high and provide many facilities to the students. In this course, facilities are available like fast Wi-Fi, classrooms, labs, fans, bathrooms, branches, hostels, canteens, etc. In this college, the canteen food is very tasty. It is like homemade food.

reviews.review_heading: Mother of all IITs - IIT Kharagpur.
reviews.review_text: State-of-the-art infrastructure is present for all the students. Labs, classes and libraries are best. The hostels can be a little disappointing, the food there is not that good, and it will take time to adjust to the taste of the mess food. But you can always find night canteens and restaurants inside the campus if you want to treat yourself to good food.

reviews.review_heading: Its the top college in India, you have to qualify for this.
reviews.review_text: The hostel facilities in IITKGP are not up to the mark. The hostels are mostly run based on Hall tempo and bonding. The library here is also one of the biggest libraries of all the IITs, and it has a lot of rooms where you can sit and study. It stays open till 12 o'clock. Almost all of the books are available in the library that you want to read, or it has access to the national digital library, and you can read anything that you want. The facilities of technological aspects are also really good...

reviews.review_heading: An engineering life at IIT Kharagpur is very joyful and good.
reviews.review_text: Many facilities are available in our college. Wi-Fi is very good and useful for our academic career. High-speed Wi-Fi is also available at our central library. Hostel facilities are available and comfortable. Hostel food is satisfactory, but it is not good. There are good games to play, like cricket, carrom, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Review of IIT Kharagpur.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of IIT Kharagpur is very good, as it has high-speed Wireless Fidelity (Wi-Fi), and it also has many labs that are very good and well-maintained by the college. The mess food is also very good and hygienic, and the hostels are also well-maintained.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur.
reviews.review_text: The IIT Kharagpur infrastructure is old, but it's clean and filled with greenery. All facilities are available in our college, with full speed of Wi-Fi, all resources are available in our college, with full security, and the hostel rooms are clean, and the hostel food is tasty and hygienic.

reviews.review_heading: Top student in India to get into this college.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure was world class. This was the best campus in all of India. Classrooms were made fully furnished by the British Empire. All facilities were available in the classrooms. Library is like a university campus, with all types of books in the world available. There are gardens, a swimming pool, different grounds for different sports and many extracurricular activities present. Hostels are very good. Mess food is very good.

reviews.review_heading: It is a big place where you can definitely find someone with the same vibe as you.
reviews.review_text:
The Wi-Fi connection is smooth and good, and is available through the hostel's classroom library and even the auditoriums. 
It has one of the biggest libraries, but some books are not so well-maintained. 
The quality of food is enough to survive in terms of taste, but it is also nutritious for the body.
There is a hospital on the campus, which is open 24/7
We have a court for basketball, volleyball and badminton in every respective hall, with the seniors allowing anyone interested to play to go ...

reviews.review_heading: Everything is excellent, only sometimes the infrastructure may seem to be old.
reviews.review_text: The academic section is excellent. Wi-Fi (avg speed 200mbps) is available throughout the whole campus. Hostels are not up to date. In the first year, you will get a triple-sharing room. From the second year, you may get a triple sharing or a single room, depending on the hostel you are allotted. From the third year onwards, you are allotted single rooms.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements but bad gender ratio.
reviews.review_text: There are around 21 hostels in the institute, approximately 16 hostels for boys and 5 for girls. I live in Nehru Hall. This is one of the oldest hostels in IIT Kharagpur. Sundar Pichai also stayed here. There are facilities like Wi-Fi, cooler, geyser, LAN connection, etc. The mess food quality is average, as in most of the hostels. They serve food 4 times a day, 2 heavy meals and 2 light meals. Hostel and mess fees are usually around Rs. 40,000 per semester. There are also gyms, basketball court...

reviews.review_heading: We have the best campus and the largest of all the IITs. Teachers and placements are good.
reviews.review_text: 24/7 Wi-Fi is available with good speed. The Department building is huge, and advanced machinery and devices are present in the lab. There is a Nescafe just outside the department for refreshment, and there is a personal departmental library for the Biotech students.

fees_and_eligibility.overview: DoMS IIT Madras offers PG courses to students. These courses are provided across the Management and various other streams. At the PG level, DoMS IIT Madras offers MBA, EMBA, PGPEX-VLM, Post-Doctoral Research programmes, and dual degree MS courses to students. The college also provides MDP and various other courses to students. IIT Madras MBA students are provided with a well-rounded learning experience in terms of management theory and its actual practice. The programme involves hands-on management internship in industry and project work, classroom teaching, case discussions, and others. Following are the details of IIT Madras DoMS programmes, including eligibility criteria and full course fee:

faqs.answer: A:     DoMS IIT Madras offers MBA, EMBA, PGPEX-VLM, and MS courses at the postgraduate and doctoral levels in the field of Management. Candidates are required to complete a minimum of graduation to apply for PG courses. Below is course-wise eligibility at DoMS IIT Madras:CoursesCommon EligibilityMBAGraduates (or professional qualification equivalent to UG degree) in any stream with 60% aggregate (55% for SC/ST/PD)Executive MBAA pass in the relevant bachelor's degree with 60% and above aggregate (55% for SC/ ST/ PwD)Minimum three years of work experience as on Dec 31 of the year of admissionPGPEX-VLMFor self-sponsored: Minimum 4.5 to 10 ten years of work experienceFor sponsored: Upper limit on the maximum experience of 10 years is waived offPhD2-5 years dual degree + 5 years of managerial experience (for part-time &external)
faqs.question: Who is eligible for DoMS IIT Madras?

faqs.answer: A:    IIT Madras admissions are entrance exam based. Candidates need to clear the National-level entrance exams for admissions to various courses. For MBA admissions, candidates should have a valid CAT score to appear for CAT Counselling. Based on IIT Madras cut off for MBA, candidates can get admission as per their corresponding rank. Candidates who want MBA admission can visit the official website of CAT to fill the application form online. At the time of CAT application candidates also need to submit the application fee on the portal.
faqs.question: Can I join IIT Madras without CAT exam?

faqs.answer: A:    Yes, IIT Madras does accepts CAT score for admission to MBA level programmes. A valid CAT score is required to pass the selection process of IIT Madras like any other MBA Institution. CAT 2023 exam date was November 26. CAT 2023 registration had  commenced from August 2 at the official website and the last date to apply was Sep 13, 2023. The required fee for the CAT exam is  INR 2,300 to INR 2,400 for General category candidates and from INR 1,150 to INR 1200 for Reserved category candidates. Applicants have to pay the fee at the time of form filling. The application form is not accepted without the payment of fees.
faqs.question: Does IIT Madras accept CAT score?

faqs.answer: A:    Candidates willing to get admission must take part in the DoMS IIT Madras admission process before the last date of application. Follow the IIT Madras MBA application process mentioned below:Go to the official website of IIT Madras MBA.Select the coursefill out the form. Pay the fee and submit the application form.

review_content.Placements: During the placement semester, I had the opportunity to interact with graduating students who recently graduated. They were extremely helpful to me throughout this difficult process. Almost everyone in my class was hired, with an average salary package of 14LPA. The highest package offered was 29LPA During our MBA placement drive, key recruiters included McKinsey, Accenture, Dell, Amazon, IBM, and HCL.
review_content.Infrastructure: At IIT Madras, we were able to enjoy convenient and enriching campus life with facilities like a well-oriented library with over 2 Million books, medical facilities, food, sports, etc. The hostel rooms are single and are fully furnished. The fee per semester (6 months) was around Rs 15000 including accommodation and food. The food is for 4 times and has a minimum of 5 items per meal. Every hostel has its own library, playing area, washing machine, etc.

overview_faqs.question: Is it worth pursuing MBA at IIT Madras?
overview_faqs.answer: Yes, IIT Madras can be one of the prime choice for MBA aspirants. The institute recorded a 100% placement rate for its MBA batch passing out in 2024. The highest and average package offered during IIT Madras MBA placements in 2024 stood at INR 29.65 and INR 16.93 LPA, respectively. Further, the median package offered to during IIT Madras MBA placements in 2024 stood at INR 20.40 LPA.Talking about the Indian Institute of Technology Madras rankings, the institute has been ranked 15 by the National Institutional Ranking Framework (NIRF) 2023 for its Management category courses. In the year 2022, IIT Madras was ranked 10 in the Management category by the NIRF. Find here about the other top ranking IITs in India.

review_summary.college_name: IIT Madras MBA Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: One of the best colleges to pursue an MBA has great faculty and multiple placement opportunities.

content.Placements: In our batch, around 60% of the students get placed at the dorms in Madras. The college has a well-developed placements cell that conducts various placement drives for the on-campus placements of the students. Many companies, such as IBM, TCS, Goldman Sachs, Flipkart, etc., offer on-campus placements.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure available for the MBA course at this college was very good. The college has a big campus with all kinds of modern facilities, which enhances students learning. The entire campus has Wi-Fi connectivity, which can be assessed by the college teachers and students. The canteen, labs, library, hostel, sports and other necessary facilities were also available for the students.

individual_reviews.course: Post Graduate Program for Executives for Visionary Leadership in Manufacturing (PGPEX-VLM) - Batch of 2019
individual_reviews.title: IIT Madras Post Doctoral course Review.

content.Placements: 80% of the students got placed in our batch. The highest package was INR 50 lpa, and the minimum package was INR 20 lpa. The average package was INR 25 lpa. The recruiting companies are all the big ones, like Maruti Suzuki, Tata, etc. The internship season was also good and 50% of students got internships.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure are top-notch. The Wi-Fi is fast. The labs have everything someone would need to conduct research. The library is vast and has thousands of books. The classrooms are big and vibrant. The sports field is very big and has everything.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Good placements and college campus.

content.Placements: During the placement semester, I had the opportunity to interact with graduating students who recently graduated. They were extremely helpful to me throughout this difficult process. Almost everyone in my class was hired, with an average salary package of 14LPA. The highest package offered was 29LPA During our MBA placement drive, key recruiters included McKinsey, Accenture, Dell, Amazon, IBM, and HCL.
content.Infrastructure: At IIT Madras, we were able to enjoy convenient and enriching campus life with facilities like a well-oriented library with over 2 Million books, medical facilities, food, sports, etc. The hostel rooms are single and are fully furnished. The fee per semester (6 months) was around Rs 15000 including accommodation and food. The food is for 4 times and has a minimum of 5 items per meal. Every hostel has its own library, playing area, washing machine, etc.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: Packages offered could have been better.

content.Placements: Last year, the placement percentage was 95%. In the previous year to that, it was around 90%. For the last batch, the highest package was 14 LPA, and the lowest package was 7.8 LPA. It depends on your hard work in the studies period, and that will help you a lot at the time of placements.
content.Infrastructure: The campus life is full of cultural activities from time to time to promote holistic supplements for students. The campus has free Wi-Fi for students. The college also organises a fest every year. The college provides hostels and basic facilities. Separate in-house hostel facilities are available for boys and girls. The enchanting hostel campus gives a very homely atmosphere for students, making them feel at home. There is a library inside the hostel campus along with the television to relax the students.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Best college for the diversity.

content.Placements: There is 100% placement is the Dorms IIT Madras, as there is small batch size so there is no as such problem in the placement. There was 29.5 lacs package in last year . Mckency was top recruiter last year. Analyst was top role which was offered. Almost all the people got the internship last year.
content.Infrastructure: Due to covid 19, I have not been able to visit campus as of now. But as per the seniors all the necessary stuff is available there. Wi-fi is available is whole campus and if we talk about health facility then we have our own in house hospital and every person is having insurance policy there.

paragraphs: DoMS IIT Madras admissions are primarily entrance-based. Candidates can register online for admission to their preferred course. The admission process at IIT Madras is as per the steps below:
1. Application Process

The mode of application is online. MBA admissions are based on CAT scores. Candidates must pay an application fee of INR 1,600 (INR 800 for SC/ ST/ PwD). While PhD courses require an application fee of INR 1,000.
2. Selection

The institute considers CAT scores for admission to MBA programme. The institute also considers the academic performance and work experience of the candidates for final selection. Besides, the institute conducts an aptitude test to shortlist aspirants for Executive MBA programme.
3. Merit List & Admission Confirmation

After the release ofDoMS IIT Madras cutoff, candidates with score equal or above the cutoff are offered admission. The institute also releases a merit list based on the composite score of the candidates for admission. Selected aspirants need to come for document verification and pay theDoMS IIT Madras feeto confirm their seat in the institute.

DoMS IIT Madras fee is a sum of multiple components such as caution deposit, hostel fee, etc. Aspirants need to pay course fee at the time of admission to confirm their seat in the institute. Below is course-wise fee for DoMS IIT Madras:

faqs.question: How can I get admission to PhD at DoMS IIT Madras?
faqs.answer: Candidates are offered admission in PhD course of DoMS IIT Madras based on academic performance, merit in the last qualifying exam, statement of purpose and research proposal. reviews.review_text: The infrastructure available for the MBA course at this college was very good. The college has a big campus with all kinds of modern facilities, which enhances students learning. The entire campus has Wi-Fi connectivity, which can be assessed by the college teachers and students. The canteen, labs, library, hostel, sports and other necessary facilities were also available for the students.

reviews.review_heading: IIT Madras Post Doctoral course Review.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure are top-notch. The Wi-Fi is fast. The labs have everything someone would need to conduct research. The library is vast and has thousands of books. The classrooms are big and vibrant. The sports field is very big and has everything.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements and college campus.
reviews.review_text: At IIT Madras, we were able to enjoy convenient and enriching campus life with facilities like a well-oriented library with over 2 Million books, medical facilities, food, sports, etc. The hostel rooms are single and are fully furnished. The fee per semester (6 months) was around Rs 15000 including accommodation and food. The food is for 4 times and has a minimum of 5 items per meal. Every hostel has its own library, playing area, washing machine, etc.

reviews.review_text: The campus life is full of cultural activities from time to time to promote holistic supplements for students. The campus has free Wi-Fi for students. reviews.review_heading: This is a safe option for any MBA aspirant compared to other colleges with a huge batch size.

faqs.question: How can I take admission in MBA at SJMSOM without CAT?
faqs.answer: Candidate seeking admission to the MBA programme at SJMSOM, IIT Bombay must take the CAT exam as SJMSOM inducts candidates for the MBA programme based on a valid score in CAT. Candidates having valid minimum CAT overall and section wise percentile as mentioned in the cut-off list released by the SJMSOM, IIT Bombay will be shortlisted for Personal Interview (PI) round. The final merit list for candidates selected for the MBA programme at SJMSOM, IIT Bombay will be based on candidate’s composite score of different parameters whose weightage are given below:ParticularWeightageCAT Overall Score70%Gender Diversity10%Academic Profile10%Work Experience5%Post Graduate/ Professionals5%

reviews.review_heading: The college has provided decent placements in 2025 despite the bad market.
reviews.review_text: You get to experience campus life at the IIT hostel with excellent sports amenities, and medical facilities. SJMSOM has a separate building with state-of-the-art classrooms and seating facilities. Hostel food is decent enough, and you also have outlets like Chaayos and CCD giving food at subsidized prices for students.

reviews.review_heading: Getting into my Dream College.
reviews.review_text: The academic infrastructure is built exceptionally well. All the lecture halls/classes and buildings are air conditioned. Some departments are old but still very well maintained. For hostels, newer hostels 15-16 and 18 are having good infrastructure and facilities. Older hostels are being demolished now.

reviews.review_heading: This college is very good, and many opportunities are waiting for students.
reviews.review_text: In this college, Wi-Fi was average. The speed was fine because most student use college Wi-Fi at the same time but laboratories, classroom, and library were very good. The facilities were good but students can get problem with food as some time there were many high spices in the food and oily also. The medical was very good, and my friends were in sports and they were on a national level but I was not interested in sports.

reviews.review_heading: There are fantastic sports facilities and faculty members.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure available here includes right from a full-size tennis court to an Olympic-sized swimming pool, gymnasium, sports ground and many more. The good thing is that the library is well stocked. If there is a shortage of any book, you always have access to the IITB central library, which has every journal, book and subscription you would need. The classrooms are spacious, air-conditioned and have all the required facilities such as projectors, etc. In the first year, in the hostel, ev...

reviews.review_heading: It is the best college in India, and I suggest you join it.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is just amazing here because the campus of this university is just incredible, i.e., there is no need to go anywhere else because there are all facilities on the campus only. Wi-Fi, labs and libraries are well managed. They take care of all the diet of students, and meals served here are rich in protein due to the nutritionists. There is all the sports equipment here, and they are world-class.

reviews.review_heading: Awesome college with awesome facilities and faculty.
reviews.review_text: The campus of our college is full of greenery and amazing. Wi-Fi available everywhere on the college campus. Classrooms are fully air-conditioned. A vast collection of books is found In the library. Hostels are very good all the facility are available in hostel.

reviews.review_heading: The college teaches good things for students.
reviews.review_text: In our department, all the facilities are available for the students. Good Wi-Fi facility is available for the students. Wi-Fi facility is also available in the classrooms and in the library. In our hostel, all the facilities are provided for students. The food served in the hostel is very good. Hostel rooms are also very good. They provide proper furniture in each room.

reviews.review_heading: It is one of the best colleges of our country to join, if you really want to learn something.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is very good. The best thing about SJMSOM is, we leverage all the world-class facilities of IIT Bombay. The campus is full of greenery, and the area is around 550 acres. We have a very big library where one can find any book related to any course. High-speed Wi-Fi network is available.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied by the faculty, infrastructure and placements of the college.
reviews.review_text: Owing to the IIT Bomaby, SJMSOM enjoys a very rich infrastructure. There is almost every curricular and extra curricular facility available to the students. The hostels are well maintained an the food at canteen too is good. I did not face any infrastructure related issue until now in the college.

reviews.review_heading: A review of Shailesh J. Mehta School of Management, IIT Bombay.
reviews.review_text: The facilities available in the college are world class. Our college shares the lush green campus of IIT Bombay, and we enjoy all the amenities offered by it. There are world-class sports facilities, campus hospital and clubs for any diverse activities or interests. The classrooms are well-furnished and are provided with all the necessities required for students to get a proper education.

reviews.review_heading: SJMSOM, one of the best schools for MBA, provides a great industry exposure and good placements.
reviews.review_text: The SJMSOM, being a part of IIT Bombay, has the best infrastructure facilities for all students. Lectures are delivered in fully air-conditioned classrooms coupled with good acoustics and projection facilities. Apart from the IIT central library, SOM has its own library and has a good collection of books in various domains of MBA. All the hostels provide good quality food and students also have access to private restaurant Gulmohar in the campus apart from night canteens in all hostels. IIT has ...

reviews.review_heading: Small batch size, good summer and final placements and very good ROI.
reviews.review_text: The college is in the heart of the city, and the campus is around 550 acre in the area filled with greenery. All sorts of medical facilities, sports and game facilities are available on the campus. The hostel and other infrastructure are world class. The classrooms are fully air-conditioned, and Wi-Fi is available anywhere on the campus. Apart from these, every student has been given separate personal LAN port.

reviews.review_heading: Wonderful campus, Good placements and faculty.
reviews.review_text: The academic and hostel sections of the campus are wi-fi enabled.Facilities at the campus are above average and there are many projects to improve the infrastructure. The campus has excellent badminton, Cricket, Tennis and Basketball courts. Students are provided with ample opportunities to be a part of the University teams and they've always won laurels for the institute.

reviews.review_heading: Excellent placements, faculty, and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: IIT Bombay has one of the best infrastructures in the country. The facilities like high-speed Wi-Fi connections, a huge central library with 24x7 study room, hospitals, everything is available on the campus. Every hostel has its own mess. Lots of other canteens and eateries are situated at various places. Both indoor and outdoor sports facilities are available.

reviews.review_heading: This is the place with a strong foundation to become great future leaders.
reviews.review_text: As we are a part of IIT, Bombay, the infrastructure facilities are world-class. We have everything that a student can dream of. There is something for everyone and the best place to develop as well as nurture their interests. There are around 16 hostels with good quality food and clean rooms.

faqs.answer: The answer to this question of whether an average student can get into IIM can be both yes and no depending on the definition of an average student.Based on Academics (Class 10/ Class 12/ Graduation): While a student with average scores in Class 10, Class 12 and graduation with a good CAT score certainly has good chances of getting a call from IIM-A, chances are less for someone with an average CAT score.Based on student category (General or Reserved): While it is tough for a General category average student to grab a seat at IIM due to high score requirements, a reserved category student can get admission being at average scores as well.Based on past work experience, diversity and other factors: Gender and academic diversity is also a factor on which students are shortlisted at IIM. IIMs judge the past academic category based on the degree obtained by the students before MBA and then a weightage is allotted based on that. For Engineers, the percentage for scoring the highest marks is higher as compared with other streamsPerformance in selection rounds: Once you make it to the final selection rounds, i.e., AWT/PI process, it can be considered a fresh start. At this stage, students can forget their past average-ness but definitely require good grasp over the past subjects as academics-related questions are asked in the interview.Based on the above factors, it can be considered that while getting into top Management institutes, such as IIM is extremely tough, the past performance, CAT performance, student category and a lot of factors can be the reasons for a student to receive that final call.
faqs.question: Q: Can an average student get into an IIM?

Hence, candidates willing to pursue an MBA from IIM Raipur must prepare well for the CAT exam.
faqs.question: Q: Is it necessary to meet section-wise cut-off percentile for MBA programme at IIM Raipur?

faqs.answer: IIM Raipur, like other top IIMs, accepts admission for most of its courses based on the Common Admission Test (CAT) score. The application process for CAT is generally concluded between August and September. Also, Candidates having their CAT percentile in accordance with the cut-off list released by IIM Raipur can register further for the personal interview (PI) round, and the registration process for Personal Interview (PI) is usually held in June. Therefore, candidates are advised to apply for both processes within the given time period.
faqs.question: Q: What is the last date to apply for admission at IIM Raipur?

faqs.answer: Candidates seeking admission to the MBA programme at IIM Raipur must meet the overall and section-wise CAT percentile. According to cut-off details of IIM Raipur for the year 2023, candidates having overall and section-wise CAT percentile equal to or above 90 were eligible for admission to the MBA programme.Hence, students are advised to give equal importance to all the sections, i.e. verbal ability and reading comprehension (VARC), data interpretation and logical reasoning (DILR) and quantitative aptitude (QA) while preparing for the CAT exam to get eligible for admission to the MBA programme at IIM Raipur.

paragraphs: IIM Raipur offers Certification, PG, and doctoral-level courses in the field of management. Among all the courses, the MBA programme is the flagship programme of IIM Raipur, a two-year full-time course comprising six trimesters. Besides, MBA (General) IIM Raipur also offers an executive MBA and Fellow Programme of Management (FPM), a doctoral-level course. IIM Raipur course admission is strictly entrance exam-based.

Candidates eligible for IIM Raipur admission can register themselves through the college's official website. Here are some popular courses of IIM Raipur along with their eligibility, selection criteria and total tuition fees

IIM Raipur Admission Process 2025

For the PGP course (or MBA) admission, candidates with a valid CAT score that matches the cutoff foradmission at IIM Raipurget a seat. Hence, for this flagship course, students need to complete the CAT application process and take the test. For other courses such as MBA Ex, or Certificate, applications can be directly submitted through IIM Raipur's official website. Further, the IIM Raipur admission criteria are explained below:
STEP 1: IIM Raipur Application Process 2025

Indian Institute of Management Raipur application process is carried out in online mode. After the online registration, candidates shall send a copy of the filled form along with all the documents through the post to the institute.
STEP 2: Written Ability Test (WAT)/ Personal Interview (PI) Round

Candidates shortlisted on merit in the CAT entrance test and academic merit have to take the WAT/PI round. Further, a commutative score is calculated for final selections. For the other programmes, students who fulfil theIIM Raipur eligibility criteriaare shortlisted based on course-specific selection criteria.
STEP 3: Proclamation of Final Merit List.
After the IIM Raipur selection criteria are over, the institute can release a merit list in terms of categories.Students who manage to appear on the merit list are allowed admission.
STEP 4: Confirmation of Admission.
The selected applicants are then free to secure their seats with the payment IIM Raipur fee.

According to cut-off details of IIM Raipur for the year 2023, candidates having overall and section-wise CAT percentile equal to or above 90 were eligible for admission to the MBA programme.Hence, students are advised to give equal importance to all the sections, i.e. verbal ability and reading comprehension (VARC), data interpretation and logical reasoning (DILR) and quantitative aptitude (QA) while preparing for the CAT exam to get eligible for admission to the MBA programme at IIM Raipur.

placement_data.title: IIM Raipur Placement Overview 2025
paragraphs: IIM Raipur placement report 2025 has been out on the official website. The highest package offered was INR 34.3 LPA . The average package offered to the MBA class of 2025 was INR 18.8 LPA . While the median package offered was INR 18.4 LPA . In total, 166 companies took part during the IIM Raipur MBA placements 2025.

The highest and average package offered during IIM Raipur MBA placements 2024 stood at INR 42.29 LPA and INR 18.15 LPA , respectively. Further, the median package offered during IIM Raipur MBA placements 2024 stood at INR 17.5 LPA . In addition, a total of 116 recruiters visited the campus and 302 offers were made during IIM Raipur MBA placements 2024. The top recruiters during IIM Raipur MBA placements 2024 included Amazon, Accenture and EY .

Other than this, out of the total of 311 registered students , all students were placed during IIM Raipur MBA summer placements for the batch of 2022-24. Moreover, the highest and average stipend offered during IIM Raipur MBA summer placements for the 2022-24 batch stood at INR 3.50 lakh and INR 1.39 lakh for two months, respectively.

reviews.review_heading: My honest review of my college.
reviews.review_text: Hostel facilities were good, but sometimes we had issues with cleanliness and washing of clothes. Overall, it was better than my previous hostel. The food was good in the first year, but in the second year, it was pathetic.

reviews.review_heading: Infrastructure is amazing.
reviews.review_text:
1. It's world class infrastructure.
2. Best hostel available with attached bathroom. 
3. Excellent hostel infrastructure with amenities such as swimming pool, gym, indoor badminton court and ground for football, cricket and play other relevant outdoor sports. Table tennis and many other things are also available.

reviews.review_heading: Review of IIM Raipur - Indian Institute of Management.
reviews.review_text: In the first year, students are exposed to all the domains such as Marketing, HR, Operations, Strategy, etc. This helps in building the foundation for all the functional areas of management and provides students with a chance to understand every domain and find their interests. In the hostel room, the facilities provided include a whiteboard, a cupboard, a table, a chair, a mattress, a bed, a bedsheet, a pillow, and a pillow cover. The quality of mess food is great with a live counter for eggs a...

reviews.review_heading: Wonderful faculty members with state of the art campus.
reviews.review_text: The classrooms, libraries and other academic rooms are all Wi-Fi enabled with centralised AC. Library is equipped with all the books necessary with E-journals at our discourse. Hostels are single occupancy with attached bathroom and 24 hours hot/cold water facilities. The food provided in our mess is very tasty and menus are different for different days.

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides good placements and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The entire campus is Wi-Fi enabled. Students get single rooms for themselves, and it helps in self-study. The college is located away from the city in the greenery. You also get to enjoy good natural scenery in the college. The quality of food served in the mess is average, but it'll probably change in the coming year.

reviews.review_heading: The college is great with great possibilities.
reviews.review_text: The campus has aesthetically designed classrooms to enhance delivery and reception of the content during classes and facilitate discussions. There is a horse-shoe shaped classroom with furniture from Godrej aids in the learning process. All classrooms have the state of the art sound and projection systems.

reviews.review_heading: It provides the best education. It has excellent placements.
reviews.review_text: The college provides facilities like air-conditioned classrooms, 24 hours high-speed Wi-Fi facility, full-fledged library, single bed hostels with radiant cooling and good quality food with vegetarian and non-vegetarian options. There is also round the clock medical officer is available. Ambulance facility is also available in case of emergency. Games like badminton, football, squash, table tennis and cricket are available.

reviews.review_heading: College experience of a student in IIM.
reviews.review_text: The new campus was built last year. There are 5 hostels at present and 1 sports building which has a gym, badminton courts, swimming pool. The mess is very large and can easily accommodate 500 people at one time. But the food quality is not good because of the caterers.

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides excellent teaching methodology and good placements.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure of our college are the best among the new IIMs. Single room facilities are also provided in our hostels with Wi-Fi and attached bathrooms. The quality of food served in the mess is average. Sports facilities provided are very good with a huge sports complex near our hostel. Medical facilities provided by the campus are also good.

reviews.review_heading: Insider View @ IIM RAIPUR.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is class apart and is one of the best in India. There are dedicated hostel blocks, playground, auditorium etc. The mess food is okay. But the other facilities provided just overcome the shortcomings of the mess food.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with college, but placements are a bit less.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure of our college are good. It provides Wi-Fi, radiant cooling, security, a huge library, and every other facility which are necessary for course completion. Hostel rooms are good, and there is a single allotment with attached bathrooms. Mess food is also pretty good, and they serve two meals, i.e., breakfast and evening snacks.

reviews.review_heading: IIM RAIPUR- Front runners in management studies.
reviews.review_text: The college has sprawling 200 acres campus laced with state-of-the-art technology and infrastructure. The classrooms are equipped with modern teaching tools which enhances the learning experience manifolds. The hostel rooms are single occupancy with attached washrooms and radiant cooling.

reviews.review_heading: Good facilities with a chance to improve.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure at the student's disposal is of state of the art standard. Classrooms are equipped with public address systems facilitating the class progression of around 60-70 in a single room thereby ensuring equal focus on all. Wi-Fi is available around the hour in almost all places inside the campus. The library boast of its growing repository of books and articles on management, philosophy etc. The hostels are a single room with attached washroom for each student giving t...

reviews.review_heading: An amazing MBA experience.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is amazing. We have got single room with attached bathrooms and radiant cooling enabled in all the hostels. We have got a fully functional multi sport complex built just in 2019 end. Full size football fields and cricket fields are being planned to be built.

reviews.review_heading: Review of IIM Raipur - Indian Institute of Management.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is amazing with a breath-taking library. I spend about 5 hours daily in our resource enrich, which includes international journals, Harvard e-library access, Bloomberg terminal, etc. Library and classrooms are good as they can be. There are new hostels, each with 5 floors and about 90 odd single rooms with well-equipped attached bathrooms. They also have a tennis court, basketball court, and indoor stadium includes a squash court, swimming pool, tennis court, et...

hostel.description:
The Institute has separate hostel building for boys and girls. The boys' hostel is called Beryl. All basic amenities have been provided in the rooms. It has a recreation room with indoor games such as table tennis and carom, LCD television. Along with this, there is ample space outside the building for outdoor games. Beryl is also stocked with musical instruments for the music enthusiasts.

Separate girls hostel, on the other hand, is also situated well within the NIT campus. It is located in a picturesque block that is abundantly green and sufficiently well-lit. Among a host of facilities provided are a gymnasium as well as large open spaces that allow for socializing, outdoor activities as well as the celebration of various festivals.

library.description: The Learning Resource Centre (LRC) of the Institute is the center for academic and professional knowledge resources. The LRC also provides access to the leading electronic resources in the areas of business and management through which we will serve the needs of academics as well as practitioners. LRC is powered by RFID Technology to enable hassle-free check-in check-out of documents providing convenience and flexibility of access to the students. The LRC gives access to databases like Capex – CMIE, EMERALD INSIGHT, J-Gate, ProwessIQ, Oxford Online Journals and many more. The LRC has the latest softwares like IBM SPSS, IBM SPSS Modeler, STATA, TURNITIN, NVIVO - 10, LINGO, Eviews and Palisade/Decision Tools Suite

sports.description: Available Facilities: Badminton Court, Basketball Court, Cricket Ground, Football Ground, Swimming Pool, Tennis Court, Hockey Ground, Table Tennis

reviews.review_heading: Postgraduate programme in Human Resources.
reviews.review_text: The atmosphere created a successful mindset for students. It provides hope and confidence in approaching new things. It made students come out of their comfort zones and try new ideas. Clusters of students from all branches jointly participated in various cultural activities.

reviews.review_heading: The college finds successful youth talents.
reviews.review_text: The college usually follows a lot of formalities to maintain its standards at a high level. To concentrate on sports and other activities, and to grow our talent, special sessions for extracurricular activities are arranged. The college is so familiar and so environmentally friendly.

reviews.review_heading: Postgraduate Programme in Management with Human Resources.
reviews.review_text: College is known for its excellence in its infrastructure, with good reports for its consistent performance in all areas. It's easier to approach the higher authorities of the college to discuss anything. The canteen has spacious areas, so it's crowded most of the time.

reviews.review_heading: The management was so good at IIM Trichy.
reviews.review_text: The regulations of the college have changed every four years. There was relaxing seating available in the canteen areas. Canteen areas were handled by the professional contractors, but this changed when there will be a lot of complaints were received from students.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is highlighted by its performance.
reviews.review_text: Most resourceful libraries with online and offline collections. Students can use the library whenever they needed. And we won't be afraid of security systems in the college, security cameras are fixed everywhere in the campus area. Also, you can find some good places for relaxing in the canteen portions.

reviews.review_heading: College of national importance.
reviews.review_text: Hostels and classrooms are great. Our college has a green campus, with a large artificial lake and sports complex with facilities for every sport that one would want to play. It also includes gym and swimming pool. LRC is a 5-floor library with all the access to modern research sources.

reviews.review_heading: Indian institute of management, Trichy.
reviews.review_text: Campus Life is as pretty as they come; it equipped with modern technologies, aesthetic architecture and well-decked classrooms. The best of best is our library, where there are plenty of places for group study, such as glass room, ground pods, ground table, etc. It equipped with the latest subscription and publications. There are many students who run clubs and committees so you will not get bored. college is 20 km away from city. The hostel that provides is great; it is spacious and well built,...

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure and multiple placement opportunities available at this college.
reviews.review_text: IIM Trichy had excellent infrastructure for the PGPM course. Top-quality facilities were available on the college campus for the students. Wi-Fi, labs, library, canteen, hostel, sports, medical, etc. for the students on the college campus. Multiple sports facilities were available for the students.

reviews.review_heading: IIM Tiruchirappalli unofficial review.
reviews.review_text: The campus of IIM Trichy is state of the art. The facilities on hand are first class. The library has all the materials and databases, and the classrooms are well-equipped. The school contains a swimming, as well as various other sporting facilities such as basketball, football and cricket.

reviews.review_heading: It is one of the best B-schools in India.
reviews.review_text: IIM Trichy has a state of art campus. The facilities provided are excellent. Classrooms are well-equipped, and the library has all the resources and databases. The campus has its swimming pool, and numerous other sports facilities like basketball, football, cricket are available.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, It is the best college, but need to improve in a few aspects.
reviews.review_text: IIM Trichy has one of the best infrastructures among all second-tier IIMS. All students get a single room equipped with air-conditioners and all facilities. Classrooms and library have very good infrastructure and top of the class facilities. There are mess, sports complex, etc., and many other facilities available here.

reviews.review_heading: Review of IIM Trichy - Indian Institute of Management Tiruchirappalli.
reviews.review_text: This campus is relatively new, and it does provide many facilities such as the sports complex, swimming pool, academic blocks, hostels, etc. The learning centre is yet to be opened for usage, and the gym is yet to be built. Hostels are not equipped with basic facilities such as washing machines or room cleaning services which is an issue for the students.

reviews.review_heading: The Best B-School to be in is IIM-T.
reviews.review_text: IIM-T provides students with a state of the art campus with facilities like fully equipped classrooms with seating capacity varying from 100-250; access to numerous sports facilities including swimming pool, floodlight courts for basketball, volleyball, football, cricket, etc. IIM-T has a plethora of books and other learning sources in the state of the art "Learning Resource Center". Hostels are single occupancy, air-conditioned with an attached balcony.

reviews.review_heading: IIM Trichy, The Southernmost IIM.
reviews.review_text: The permanent state-of-the-art campus is spread over 175 acres. It is one of the most modern campuses ever built. It will be the first among all the IIM's to have a 2MW solar power plant to manage its energy requirements. Harward style Horseshoe seating format is there in the classroom which is complemented by multiple types of capacities ranging from 250 to 50 seater arrangement. AC Single rooms are provided in hostels. Learning Resource Center is soon going to be operational to enhance the lea...

reviews.review_heading: New state of the art campus and global learning environment.
reviews.review_text: IIM Trichy has new State of the Art campus. The campus is around 15 kms away from the city. The campus is installed with all the basic facilities required. We have a full Wi-Fi campus, e learning classrooms, sports complex available with basketball court, badminton, Table tennis, Swimming pool, football and cricket ground. The doctor is available in the campus every alternate days. The new state of the art library is ready but yet to be inaugurated. Each student is given single occupancy room wi...

Candidates need to visit the official website of IIFT Delhi to begin the application process(iift.ac.in). All candidates are being advised to confirm their compliance with the set eligibility criteria before proceeding with the IIFT Delhi admissions.
2: Shortlisting of Students

IIFT shortlists candidates for MBA (IB and BA) programmes based on CAT scores. Earlier admission was through the IIFT exam. For other courses, such as MA and PhD, the institute shall continue to conduct entrance exams. Only the candidates shortlisted based on the accepted exam score become eligible for participation in the next selection round.
Check:CAT Question Papers
3: Selection Rounds

For IIFT Delhi MBA course admission, shortlisted candidates have to go through WAT, GD, and personal interview rounds. The interview round is further conducted for admission to all the programmes, except for MA.
4: Release of Merit List/Cutoff
After all the selection rounds, the institute may release a selection or cutoff list. This list carries the names of all the selected candidates who are eligible for admission.
5: Confirmation of Admissions

Candidates who make it to the final selection list become eligible for admission. Such candidates can pay the required amount of fee to confirm their admission. The institute might carry out document verification before the final seat allotment.

placement_data.title: IIFT Delhi Placement Overview 2025
paragraphs: 7 international offers were made to MBA IB students during the IIFT Delhi MBA IB placement drive 2025. The overall highest package recorded was INR 123 LPA . The median package for MBA IB and MBA BA courses this year was INR 26 LPA and 20 LPA . Consulting was the top recruiting domain for MBA IB and IT & Analytics was the domain for MBA BA with placement distribution of 22% and 28%.
The overall highest and average package received during IIFT Delhi placement 2025 for MA Economics program was INR 24 LPA and INR 12 LPA.

Earlier, the overall highest and average stipend offered (for two months) during IIFT Delhi summer placement 2025 for the MBA IB batch of 2024-26 stood at INR 6 lakh and INR 2.73 lakh. Sales and Marketing domain emerged as the top recruiting domain. For the MBA BA batch of 2024-26, the highest and average stipend stood at INR 4 lakh and INR 1.42 lakh.

The highest domestic and international package offered during IIFT Delhi placements 2024 stood at INR 75.6 LPA and INR 85.4 LPA , respectively. The average and median package received by the MBA IB batch 2022-24 was INR 27.3 LPA and INR 25 LPA . More than 120 recruiters visited the campus and 10 international positions were offered during IIFT MBA placements 2024. Sales and Marketing emerged as the top recruiting domain with placement distribution of 22%.

The MBA IB batch of 2022-24 (including Delhi and Kolkata campus) constituted 68.8% male candidates and 33.2 female candidates. 15.2% of the entire batch was from premier Institutes such as IITs and NITs whereas 47.5% of the batch was from DU and other Central Universities . In reference to the educational background the students, 52.1% of the batch was from Engineering background while the remaining 21.8%, 16.6% and 9.5% of the batch came from Commerce / Business, Science / Pharma and Arts & Other backgrounds, respectively. The average work experience of IIFT MBA 2022-24 batch was 19.20 months.

library.description:
The library has a collection over 84,000 volumes and subscriptions to 800 journals with complete online cataloging. IIFT Library is a veritable storehouse of information. The library has a unique collection of publications of FAO, IMF, OECD, UNCTAD, UNCTC, World Bank, and other international agencies. IIFT has set up the WTO Resource Centre in the Library to focus exclusively on WTO issues. 
Presently Foreign Trade Library has a collection of 1,03,407 resources that comprises76,422 book/CDs-volumes, 17581 bound periodicals, and 255 periodicals / Journals. The library has also installed 12 Bloomberg terminals in the Library. The specific features of Bloomberg Database are that it provides a range of Global Economic data and live changes for stocks Markets, Company Reports, Sector analysis, and future trends.

reviews.review_heading: Review of M.A. Economics in the specialisation of trade and finance at this college.
reviews.review_text: It has the most enthusiastic and energetic environment, which induces the positive mindset of the students. Student unions are strongly supported by the college management, and they help them while they are involved in some socially responsible activities. Indian Institute of Foreign Trade is known for its excellence in academic coaching.

reviews.review_heading: Overall best College for M.A. in Economics Course.
reviews.review_text: IIFT has excellent infrastructure. The college has a dynamic campus. Students and faculty have access to Wi-Fi on the college campus. Students have access to labs and libraries that are fully equipped. The college classrooms were well-equipped with appropriate facilities and excellent teaching tools. There was also a restaurant at the college.

reviews.review_heading: College has good faculty for our course.
reviews.review_text: IIFT Delhi has really good infrastructure for the students. The quality of the facilities available at our college is of good quality. College Wi-Fi, labs, library, canteen, and sports facilities are available on the campus. Students receive proper support from the college management.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Indian Institute of Foreign Trade, Delhi.
reviews.review_text: Our college has a peaceful and stress-free environment. They provide huge support and show interest in sports.

reviews.review_heading: College has really good infrastructure and faculty for our course.
reviews.review_text: IIFT has a very good infrastructure. College has a lively campus. The campus of the college has Wi-Fi for the students and teachers. Labs and libraries are available for the students with all the necessary stuff. Classrooms of the college were having proper furniture and projectors for better explanation. A canteen facility was also available in the college.

reviews.review_heading: The quality of the offered facilities and faculty was good enough at IIFT Delhi.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the IIFT was good for the MBA programme. All the necessary facilities were offered in the MBA programme. Wi-Fi was available on the entire campus. The labs and library of the college were good. Hostel facilities were also available for the students. Mess and canteen food were good to eat.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, I am satisfied with all the facilities.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides Wi-Fi facility and classrooms, and computer labs are equipped with the latest technology. Everything is available here, but the campus is small.  Hostels are not very good and don't have air-conditioners. Even hostels are of triple sharing basis, and there is a small and old building for hostels. The mess is also small. However, medical facilities are good, and sports and games are also available.

reviews.review_heading: Dissatisfied from faculty members but the placements are very good .
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is not so good. The classrooms lack many facilities as compared to other colleges. The library is good. The hostels are below average and not so good infrastructure and condition. The quality and taste of food is not so good. The facility for sports and games are good .

reviews.review_heading: Placements have been on par compared with its peers, but there is a scope for improvement.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms and library are fully equipped with the Wi-Fi facility, which can be provided to your laptops. The mess menu changes according to the feedback of the students and the mess contractor. There are two hostels, and one is an old hostel for juniors, while the other one is a new hostel for seniors.

reviews.review_heading: The college provides great opportunities and exposure to the industry.
reviews.review_text: The campus at Qutab Institutional Area is compact and good enough to fulfil the requirements of an MBA programme. The campus is among many other prominent institutes located in the region. The location of the campus and the overall atmosphere makes it conducive to learning. The campus is equipped with Wi-Fi connectivity, 2 hostels each with its own mess, auditorium, conference halls and classrooms. A new campus for IIFT is coming to UPAT Maidan Garhi, New Delhi.

reviews.review_heading: IIFT is the best college for IB.
reviews.review_text: IIFT has a decent infrastructure. There are digital classrooms, auditorium, a huge library with all resources and databases, spacious hostel rooms, and mess food is also decent. The only thing our college lacks is the outdoor sports facilities. However, gym and indoor sports facilities are available. The campus is Wi-Fi enabled.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with my experience in the college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is average. IIFT doesn't have any sports grounds. Wi-Fi facilities are extremely poor. Classroom and hostel facilities are decent. Quality of food in the mess is extremely pathetic (probably the only thing which I don't like about IIFT)

reviews.review_heading: A holistic learning experience for prospective leaders. It is in one among the top B-Schools.
reviews.review_text: With a campus spanning a tad over 6 acres, the institute is equipped with digitally powered classrooms, an auditorium with a capacity of 500 people, an MDP centre and a library. It is thereby, creating an environment conducive to learning. The infrastructure is lacking in terms of avenues and facilities for a sports enthusiast. The hostels are well maintained. Quality of food in the mess is always a matter of debate in B-Schools across the country.

reviews.review_heading: I am very satisfied with my decision to join IIFT because of great faculty and amazing placements.
reviews.review_text: The library of this college is the largest in this developing world, with a holding of around 84,000 volumes and subscriptions to 800 journals with complete online cataloguing. We have access to Bloomberg terminals, and the whole campus is Wi-Fi enabled. The college has state-of-the-art infrastructure.

reviews.review_heading: The placements and the campus experience along with the crowd makes IIFT the place to be.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure could be categorised at average currently but a new campus nearing completion in 2020 would address most of the issues for the Delhi campus with the Kolkata campus recently shifting to a newer one. The food is average along with the Hostels.

review_summary.college_name: IIM Ranchi Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: IIM Ranchi for master's in business administration.

content.Placements: IIM Ranchi is a renowned institute around the country and it has a record for 100% placement. The highest package generally was 50 LPA, and the median was 19 LPA. These are as per 2024. The recruiters are from some of the top companies. The institute is filled with brilliant brains.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure and everything are good, especially the hostels, which are great. There is Wi-Fi all around the campus. The labs and classrooms are good, too. The mess food is good and hygienic, and there are many sports options available on the campus, which include both indoor and outdoor games.

individual_reviews.course: MBA in Human Resource Management - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Overall best College for MBA in Human Resource Management Course.

content.Placements: At our college, about 97% of students are enrolled in our course. The maximum wage is 29 LPA. The minimum wage is 7 LPA. The average wage is 17 LPA. Axis Bank, Tata Motors, and Microsoft were the top performances. 92% of students received internships. Top positions include HR and Manager, among others.
content.Infrastructure: IIM Ranchi currently does not have a campus. The academy and guest house are located in distinct areas. Students take college buses from hotels to classes. The hotel is located in the Khelgaon Housing Association and has good facilities. The classroom is likewise outfitted with all necessary amenities.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Mandatory to show concern for all the activities.

content.Placements: There will be no consistency in the results of placements. In the initial century, it is very easy to grab job opportunities while we study well with good percentage. But now a days it's not enough to grab job opportunities with good academic performance in addition. It is necessary to keep us updated with the new technology to get higher salaries. So team of placements helps us to train with various skills.
content.Infrastructure: There will be certain limitations for the students in eating hostel food. We should visit the hostel lounges at the proper time to have our meals, breakfast, and dinner. Hostel warden won't mind the activity of students in the hostel rooms. But if we had created any problems, we were watched strictly.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: IIM Ranchi has the best quality facilities, faculty, and placement opportunities for its students.

content.Placements: In the IIM, all the students of the MBA program get placement opportunities. Around 60-65% of the students get successfully placed at our college. The average package offered was between 5-10 LPA. Top recruiters at this college were Capgemini, Cognizant, HUL, Walmart, Flipkart, IBM, etc.
content.Infrastructure: IIM Ranchi had very good infrastructure for our course. The college had the best quality facilities on the campus for the students. Wi-Fi, labs, library, canteen, mess, hostel, sports, medical, and all other modern facilities were available in the college for the students. Hostel facilities were also of good quality.

individual_reviews.course: Integrated Programme in Management (IPM) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: The feel of this college is high, but it is worth it for its quality education.

content.Placements: Actually, I do not have any direct knowledge about placement, as there are still 2 years left for the placement process for our batch. But, as far as I know, the highest package is around 25 LPA. As our seniors said in the alumni meeting, the college has great internship facilities.
content.Infrastructure: Our college campus is very great and nice. The overall environment is also nice. There is a swimming pool and playground on the campus. Classrooms are big, and a gym facility is also available. The hostel is separate, and the security is also strict for both boys and girls. Good food in the canteen.

admission_overview.title: IIM Ranchi Admission Overview 2025
admission_overview.description: IIM Ranchi admission is mainly entrance-based. Candidates willing to join the IIM Ranchi flagship MBA in General Management course have to appear for the CAT (Common Admission Test) examination. Other than an MBA in General Management, IIM Ranchi is also renowned for its IPM (Integrated Programme in Management), an integrated 5-year course that combines BBA and MBA degrees. Students after Class 12 can join the IIM Ranchi IPM course through the IPMAT examination. Additionally, the IIM Ranchi also offers EMBA and PhD courses. Admissions to other IIM Ranchi Courses are based on the performance of the candidate in the personal Interview round and marks scored in national-level entrance exams.
