reviews.review_heading: IIM Ranchi for master's in business administration.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure and everything are good, especially the hostels, which are great. There is Wi-Fi all around the campus. The labs and classrooms are good, too. The mess food is good and hygienic, and there are many sports options available on the campus, which include both indoor and outdoor games.

reviews.review_heading: Overall best College for MBA in Human Resource Management Course.
reviews.review_text: IIM Ranchi currently does not have a campus. The academy and guest house are located in distinct areas. Students take college buses from hotels to classes. The hotel is located in the Khelgaon Housing Association and has good facilities. The classroom is likewise outfitted with all necessary amenities.

reviews.review_heading: Mandatory to show concern for all the activities.
reviews.review_text: There will be certain limitations for the students in eating hostel food. We should visit the hostel lounges at the proper time to have our meals, breakfast, and dinner. Hostel warden won't mind the activity of students in the hostel rooms. But if we had created any problems, we were watched strictly.

reviews.review_heading: IIM Ranchi has the best quality facilities, faculty, and placement opportunities for its students.
reviews.review_text: IIM Ranchi had very good infrastructure for our course. The college had the best quality facilities on the campus for the students. Wi-Fi, labs, library, canteen, mess, hostel, sports, medical, and all other modern facilities were available in the college for the students. Hostel facilities were also of good quality.

reviews.review_heading: The feel of this college is high, but it is worth it for its quality education.
reviews.review_text: Our college campus is very great and nice. The overall environment is also nice. There is a swimming pool and playground on the campus. Classrooms are big, and a gym facility is also available. The hostel is separate, and the security is also strict for both boys and girls. Good food in the canteen.

reviews.review_heading: Review of IIM Ranchi – Indian Institute of Management.
reviews.review_text: Hostel facilities are good as per the fee taken for them, rooms are provided on a sharing basis that includes two sharing and three sharing as well. Food facilities are good, with a large variety of food provided in the mess. The hostels are well supplied with proper electricity, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfying faculty and infrastructure, brilliant crowd but high fees.
reviews.review_text: Hostels and mess food are in accordance with the high fees, but the college is newly made, so certain things are underdeveloped, such as the playground, community area, and some other buildings. College management is not that effective; otherwise, the campus is beautiful and serves its purpose.

reviews.review_heading: It's worth the high fees because of the knowledgeable professors and diverse crowd.
reviews.review_text: Basic facilities like Wi-Fi, single occupancy rooms, high-tech classrooms, library, and gym are available, but the campus is newly built and not up to par with other Institutes of national importance as it is still under development. Many more buildings are yet to be constructed.

reviews.review_heading: Review of IIM Ranchi - Indian Institute of Management.
reviews.review_text: Internet facility is available in all classrooms. Classrooms are well-furnished. It also has podiums, on-seat mic, smart boards, and air-conditioners. Hostels are very good. It has beds, wardrobes, chairs, and tables. Double occupancy rooms are available. Washrooms are good. We also have rented rooms near our campus.

reviews.review_heading: It is a great college for holistic development.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are excellent. Hostels are good. Our campus is beautiful. Playground is available. A swimming pool is also available. There is a gym facility in this college. Our campus is very peaceful and has good environment.

reviews.review_heading: Review of IIM Ranchi - Indian Institute of Management.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is great. Hostel is very good. Single occupancy rooms are available. Washrooms are good. Our campus is Wi-Fi enabled. All facilities are decent. Classrooms are well-maintained. Digital boards are also available in classrooms.

reviews.review_heading: Review of IIM Ranchi - Indian Institute of Management.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is good. Our college provides us with all facilities. Our classrooms are equipped with air-conditioners and smart boards. The library is equipped with an ever-increasing collection of books of non-fiction and management journals. Students request new books.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied, amazing faculty, average infrastructure and facilities, good crowd, good placements.
reviews.review_text: The food quality is very good at IIM Ranchi, they serve tasty and healthy food. Although, as the temporary campus is in a housing society, there are several restrictions for the students. Sports facilities are average, not too good and not too bad. The rooms follow an apartment system which is a big advantage as it's better for privacy and every apartment gets a kitchen.

reviews.review_heading: Really satisfied with the college because of the faculty, good placements and campus life.
reviews.review_text: The IIM Ranchi was established in 2010 and was operating in a temporary campus at suchna bhawan and the hostels were at khelgaon, however now the new campus is ready to operate the new batches has started operating in the new campus. The campus is in 70 acres. The campus is vertical and the infrastructure is world class. It is equipped with every essential amenities like medical, sports, swimming pool, canteen.

reviews.review_heading: Review of IIM College Ranchi
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi was available. No proper classrooms, labs, or libraries were available. The hostel is the best with all facilities and personal room for all students. Food quality was above average. Medical facilities were available. No proper canteen and sports were available.

faqs.answer: The answer to this question of whether an average student can get into IIM can be both yes and no depending on the definition of an average student.Based on Academics (Class 10/ Class 12/ Graduation): While a student with average scores in Class 10, Class 12 and graduation with a good CAT score certainly has good chances of getting a call from IIM-A, chances are less for someone with an average CAT score.Based on student category (General or Reserved): While it is tough for a General category average student to grab a seat at IIM due to high score requirements, a reserved category student can get admission being at average scores as well.Based on past work experience, diversity and other factors: Gender and academic diversity is also a factor on which students are shortlisted at IIM. IIMs judge the past academic category based on the degree obtained by the students before MBA and then a weightage is allotted based on that. For Engineers, the percentage for scoring the highest marks is higher as compared with other streamsPerformance in selection rounds: Once you make it to the final selection rounds, i.e., AWT/PI process, it can be considered a fresh start. At this stage, students can forget their past average-ness but definitely require good grasp over the past subjects as academics-related questions are asked in the interview.Based on the above factors, it can be considered that while getting into top Management institutes, such as IIM is extremely tough, the past performance, CAT performance, student category and a lot of factors can be the reasons for a student to receive that final call.

Some of the popular programmes are PGP, IPM, DPM, etc.IIM Rohtak course admission 2025is completely entrance-based. Candidates are required to appear for the respective entrance exam in the first place and appear for the other selection rounds. Find below the detailedIIM Rohtak admission processfor the year 2025:
STEP 1: IIM Rohtak Application Process

IIM Rohtak application formfor PGPx is currently available on the official website of IIM Ranchi. Interested candidates who satisfy the eligibility for the desired programme can register their candidature and pay the required application fee. The aspirants must have a valid scorecard of the entrance test accepted by IIM Rohtak for admission to a particular course. Students must fill out and submit the application form before IIM Rohtak last date of registration.
STEP 2: IIM Rohtak Selection Rounds

IIM Rohtak admission criteriais entirely based scores of candidates obtained in the respective entrance exams. Foradmission to PGP course, candidates must qualify for CAT exam. Further, foradmission to IPL & IPM courses, the institute conducts its in-house aptitude test, i.e.,IPM AT. Candidates who get shortlisted through a valid score/ percentile in the respective entrance exams are called for an online personal interview round. For the other programmes, students who fulfil the minimum eligibility criteria are shortlisted based on course-specific selection criteria.

faqs.question: Can I get into IIM Rohtak with 70%?
faqs.answer: IIM admisison to the MBA course is based on a valid CAT score, followed by Written Ability Test (WAT) and Group Discussion & Personal Interview (GD &PI). CAT 2023 cut offs for IIM admission are estimated to be in the range of 95-100 percentile for General candidates. For top IIMs such asIIM Ahmedabad,IIM BangaloreandIIM Calcutta, among others, the minimum CAT cut off is 90 percentile and the maximum can go upto 100. IIM Rohtak estimated CAT cutoff 2023 (percentile) will range between 92 and 94 for the General category students.So, considering the previous year trends and estimated CAT percentile forIIM Rohtak, students with 70 percentile cutoff will not be able to get into IIM Rohtak. Candidates can get admission to other B-Schools likeXIME, BangaloreandLIBA, Chennaiwith 70 percentile CAT cutoff.

faqs.question: I've a CAT score of 76 percentile and I'm from general category. Can I apply for IIM Rohtak?
faqs.answer: Each test takers is shortlisted on the basis of his/her CAT score viz-a-viz CAT 2022 cut offs fixed by each IIM individually for that year. Minimum cut-offs of the IIMs generally over 90 percentile for General candidates (much lower for reserved category candidates), which means, those who will score above 90 percentile in CAT 2022 will be eligible for the interview round. But whether they are invited for the interview, depends on the actual CAT score and past academic record. On the other hand, cut-offs of newer IIMs range between 80-60 percentile.

placement_data.title: IIM Rohtak Placement Overview 2025
paragraphs: IIM Rohtak has the released the PGP placement report 2025 for the batch of 2023-25. The overall highest and average package received by PGP students in 2025 was INR 36 LPA and INR 18.73 LPA , respectively. Further, 40 new recruiter visited the campus in 2025. The placement rate recorded during IIM Rohtak placement 2025 was 100%. More than 30 Pre Placement Offers were made this year as well. Marketing & Strategy was the top recruiting sector in 2025 with placement distribution of 30%. In addition to this, Sales & Marketing was the top recruiting domain as well wherein students received highest and average package of INR 36 LPA and INR 17.73 LPA , respectively.

The PGP Batch of 2023-25 included 386 students with male and female ratio of 3:7 . Out of the total students enrolled, 61% students were from Commerce background whereas the remaining 15%, 14% and 10% were from Engineering, Science and Arts & Other background, respectively.

faqs.answer: A:    SPJIMR shortlists candidates for its flagship programme i.e. PGDM based on their profiles. The profiles are evaluated, and the applicants are sorted into two groups: Profile-based and Profile-cum-Score-based. In the first phase, candidates shortlisted based on their profile are called for a Personal Interview (PI). However, the second phase is held after the availability of entrance test scores. That means, the institute accepts entrance exam scores as well for admission. The accepted entrance exam for PGDM is CAT/ GMAT. For admission to FPM, aspirants need to appear for Research Aptitude Test followed by a personal interview round. The institute shortlists candidates for admission to GMP based on scores of the candidates in CAT, GMAT, GRE, etc.

individual_reviews.title: A few notes about my college.

content.Placements: The competition for placement is so huge. Nearly 1000+ students participate in the campus drives throughout the academic year. So, we should be well groomed by the training cell, and our hard work plays an important role in our selection in the recruitment process. Also, 87% of students get placed from our college in on-campus drives.
content.Infrastructure: Sometimes it's difficult to understand the college's working process. The cultural and other events are conducted at the request of students. individual_reviews.course: Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) - Batch of 2025

content.Infrastructure: This college would be economically preferable for students from various backgrounds. faqs.question: How do I get admission to SP Jain (SPJIMR)?
faqs.answer: SP Jain Institute of Management and Research admission is primarily entrance-based. Candidates are first required to register for the programme of their choice. Once the registration is done, the institute shortlists candidates for admission. SP Jain shortlists candidates for PGDM/ PGPM programmes based onCAT/ GMATscores followed by a personal interview round. Besides, the final selection is based on academic background, versatility and achievements, entrance exam and PI. For FPM, admission is based on the Research Aptitude Test followed by PI. The selection for GMP programme is based on CAT, XAT, GMAT, etc. followed by PI.

faqs.question: Does SPJIMR also select students based solely on their profiles without even taking any entrance exam?
faqs.answer: SPJIMR shortlists candidates for its flagship programme i.e. PGDM based on their profiles. The profiles are evaluated, and the applicants are sorted into two groups: Profile-based and Profile-cum-Score-based. In the first phase, candidates shortlisted based on their profile are called for a Personal Interview (PI). However, the second phase is held after the availability of entrance test scores. That means, the institute accepts entrance exam scores as well for admission. The accepted entrance exam for PGDM is CAT/ GMAT. For admission to FPM, aspirants need to appear for Research Aptitude Test followed by a personal interview round. The institute shortlists candidates for admission to GMP based on scores of the candidates in CAT, GMAT, GRE, etc.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility criteria for PGDM at SPJIMR?
faqs.answer: SP Jain Institute of Management and Research offers admission to the PGDM course on the basis of merit obtained in the qualifying exam as well as the scores obtained in the national-level entrance exam (CAT/ XAT/ MAT/ NMAT/ CMAT/ ATMA/ GMAT). In order to secure admission to the PGDM programme at SPJIMR, candidates must obtain a minimum of 50% in graduation along with valid entrance scores.

library.description: The fully computerized library is equipped with a variety of learning media. reviews.review_heading: Stepping zone of my career.
reviews.review_text: The mode of fee payments would be arranged according to the facilities provided by the students. All modes of money transactions should be accepted by the college. Supports students with both the mode of studying and helps us in the usage of online tools.

reviews.review_heading: A few notes about my college.
reviews.review_text: Sometimes it's difficult to understand the college's working process. The cultural and other events are conducted at the request of students. But in the previous year, they didn't conduct any events. At the entrance of the college, we must sign the records for entry while we choose to use the campus bus for transportation.

reviews.review_heading: Well-furnished course in a reputed college.
reviews.review_text: This college would be economically preferable for students from various backgrounds. All the online and offline resources and technologies would be accessible to all the students. Individual enrollment identity cars would be given to all the students for easier accessibility. Also, encourage us to collect scholarships for doing our courses.

reviews.review_heading: A short description of my college.
reviews.review_text: The management of the college always says that participation is more important than winning or losing. Students dress conservatively according to their convenience, but it must be formal. They pave a path for creation, innovation, and implementation, followed by success.

reviews.review_heading: Review of PGDM in Business Management
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is very constructive and well architecturally developed. CCTV cameras and security cameras are fixed in each department to monitor students, and this is managed by the higher authorities of the college. Also, speakers are fixed in every classroom to communicate emergency information.

reviews.review_heading: Very good infrastructure and faculty members.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms and labs are clean and big. The technologies are modified and updated. Wi-Fi is available. A well-stocked library is present. The hostel facilities are very good. The quality of the food available in the mess and canteen is hygienic.

reviews.review_heading: Global management program at SPJIMR.
reviews.review_text: The campus is an enlarged greenery, covering nearly 45 acres, with buses and a serene lake. The campus is also built with halls, auditoriums, recreational rooms, and laboratories. Especially, hostel areas are built with cafes and lounges, particularly for boys and girls students.

reviews.review_heading: SPJIMR, Mumbai is a prestigious organization.
reviews.review_text: Students from different backgrounds and regions are encouraged to pursue their preferred courses without any experience of splitting or groups. There are no chances of harassment, discrimination, or ragging within the campus. The college is under the surveillance of college authorities.

reviews.review_heading: Review of S.P. Jain Institute of Management and Research, Mumbai.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are air-conditioned with the required technology. The seating is fully furnished with lockers for keeping records and notebooks. Classrooms are neatly represented by students using chart works related to subjects. Foods are commonly cooked for all the students in afternoon which includes hosteller's too.

reviews.review_heading: A journey of growth, enjoyment, personal and professional development.
reviews.review_text: The hostel and mess facilities at SP Jain Institute of Management and Research (SPJIMR) are the best. The hostel washrooms are cleaned every day, and the mess facilities are clean and hygienic. The staff are professional and conscientious. The classroom facilities are also state-of-the art, with amenities suited for offline and online modes of teaching.

reviews.review_heading: College review for SP College.
reviews.review_text: The overall infrastructure is good, making it amazing for people. It has good labs and Wi-Fi quality. It has a good canteen serving delicious food, also available in Jain options. It has a lake beside it, making it a fun experience overall. Thus, I enjoy the college.

reviews.review_heading: I am absolutely satisfied. SPJIMR GMP provides opportunities for an international career.
reviews.review_text: Students have access to all the facilities in SPJIMR, including a library, open areas, computer labs, 3D printing labs, etc. All the facilities are of high standards. Hostels have a good Wi-Fi facility and air-conditioners. There are open areas to work in groups. The food in the hostel mess is available until 2 am.

reviews.review_heading: It is a very good balance of courses, the best of schools, and value for money.
reviews.review_text: The campus in Mumbai is very good in terms of amenities. It is right in the heart of the city. Even then, you get a nature-rich beautiful campus with very well-equipped classrooms and B-School infrastructure. The whole campus is Wi-Fi enabled. The canteens are available inside that let you do your group works all night. SPJIMR offers sports facilities inside and outside the campus. reviews.review_text: 1. Classrooms are world class infra structure, all classes done with PPTs. Library was fully equipped with books and software for research purposes. 2. Hostel rooms had AC, daily cleaning facilities, multiple canteens nearby with decent quality food, sports facilities not that great.

reviews.review_heading: The college teaches its students to become future business leaders.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms were well-equipped with CCTV and audio recording sessions, and each classroom has a semicircle seating arrangement. The college distributes textbooks and handouts. review_summary.college_name: IIM Udaipur Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: It is the best university of my life for my career.

content.Placements: My college provides placements from the third semester. Companies that visit the college are ICICI Bank, etc. The salary package offered ranges from 1-5 LPA. Students of the third semester apply for the same and they prepare for certain tests, etc., to clear the upcoming steps. My plan after getting a degree is to get a job in the field of human resource management.
content.Infrastructure: I stayed in a private hostel with a fee of Rs. 7,000 per month. Morning breakfast, lunch, and dinner are provided. There are also hot water benefits. It provides 3-sharing rooms. Wi-Fi is available. It has a good ambiance and the hostel has good security.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Campus infrastructure and the location are good of the college.

content.Placements: All the students have been placed apart from those who have opted out of placements due to their own reasons. The lineup of companies at IIMU is good when compared to other new IIMs. But there is still a long way to go. Most of the prominent companies hire from IIMU. The top recruiters consist of Accenture Strategy, Pidilite, Amazon, PwC, GE, EY, and JPMC. These firms offer various roles in finance, marketing, and consulting.
content.Infrastructure: The IIMU campus is state of the art, with the best infrastructure and the architecture is something you would be awestruck with. All the classrooms are equipped with multiple projectors and the seating is very comfortable. The hostel and mess fees are comparatively on the lower side. Each student gets a single-occupancy room with an AC. The mess food is decent and they prepare all Indian dishes. Rooms are allocated on a random basis.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Campus life is amazing. You will enjoy it like nothing else.

content.Placements: There is a 98% placement guarantee, and I know that most of the students got their placements with their best scores in the semester exams. From the 2nd year, students become eligible for campus placements. Companies like Amazon, Wipro, Accenture, and TCS visit our college. The highest package offered in campus placements is 16 LPA. I think 60% of students get placed in companies. If a student scores well and is serious about their studies, they can get placements. I have a plan to pursue off-campus placements if the college doesn't offer a good package.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Great infrastructure and great faculty members along with the latest course outline.

content.Placements: Good placements, with 100 percent placement from the college side. Great placement team! Helps everyone with all the preparation needed. Preparation such as group discussion, mock interviews with industry mentors, alumni mentors, domain-selected mentors, etc.
content.Infrastructure: Great infrastructure and great accommodation facilities for everyone. All places accessible to everyone also have facilities such as a gym, a sports complex, a field, and others. The hostels have one room per person and, hence, are pretty great for everyone.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Review of MBA at IIM, Udaipur.

content.Placements: In the first year, they give internships in Pidilite, Titan, and Amazon. 100% students got internships with stipends starting from 20k monthly. In the final year, on-campus placements start with JP Morgan, Well fargo, Goldman sachs, Titan, TATA and many other companies visiting for the placements drive. Package offered was 20 lacs depending on the students’ performance. Roles offered depend on vacancies in the company.
content.Infrastructure: IIM Udaipur’s infrastructure is under construction. The college provides all the basic facilities including books, internet, computers, etc. Classrooms are really big. In the library, books are arranged in a shelf and anyone can take any book for reading. In the campus we have 13 clusters with each cluster having many rooms for the students. Rooms are on individual basis with AC and 24*7 power availability. Meals quality is moderate and many students complain about it. During monsoons, many insects enter the hostel rooms creating problems.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best university of my life for my career.
reviews.review_text: I stayed in a private hostel with a fee of Rs. 7,000 per month. Morning breakfast, lunch, and dinner are provided. There are also hot water benefits. It provides 3-sharing rooms. Wi-Fi is available. It has a good ambiance and the hostel has good security.

reviews.review_heading: Campus infrastructure and the location are good of the college.
reviews.review_text: The IIMU campus is state of the art, with the best infrastructure and the architecture is something you would be awestruck with. All the classrooms are equipped with multiple projectors and the seating is very comfortable. The hostel and mess fees are comparatively on the lower side. Each student gets a single-occupancy room with an AC. The mess food is decent and they prepare all Indian dishes. Rooms are allocated on a random basis.

reviews.review_heading: Campus life is amazing. You will enjoy it like nothing else.
reviews.review_text: Social life is very active in the MBA program, and IIM U is no different. There are 34 clubs here, and most people are part of one or two clubs. People party a lot and do networking. Many events like Solaris, TEDx, Utkrisht, and Audacity represent management and cultural festivals. Overall, the campus life is great, and you will enjoy a lot in this college.

reviews.review_heading: Great infrastructure and great faculty members along with the latest course outline.
reviews.review_text: Great infrastructure and great accommodation facilities for everyone. All places accessible to everyone also have facilities such as a gym, a sports complex, a field, and others. The hostels have one room per person and, hence, are pretty great for everyone.

reviews.review_heading: Review of MBA at IIM, Udaipur.
reviews.review_text: IIM Udaipur’s infrastructure is under construction. The college provides all the basic facilities including books, internet, computers, etc. Classrooms are really big. In the library, books are arranged in a shelf and anyone can take any book for reading. In the campus we have 13 clusters with each cluster having many rooms for the students. Rooms are on individual basis with AC and 24*7 power availability. Meals quality is moderate and many students complain about it. During monsoons, many inse...

reviews.review_heading: Nothing is bad. It's the best college.
reviews.review_text: IIMU's infrastructure, campus and social life are very cool. There are 34 clubs in campus. There are many events, like Solaris, TEDx, Utkrisht and Audacity, held on campus. We have all the facilities: an AC room, auditorium, study centre, library, and internet provided by college itself. hostel is really good; they provide single room with AC. It has 2 people sharing rooms, common washrooms, almirah, etc. Mess food is good compared to other colleges; we can not expect good mess food anywhere.

reviews.review_heading: Campus always has something to offer on a daily basis.
reviews.review_text: Earlier, two first-year students were accommodated in a single room, and starting second-year, individual rooms were provided. Starting last year, everyone will be provided individual rooms. The hostels are divided into clusters. The room has all the basic infrastructure, like a bed, table, chair, mirror, cupboard, LAN-able, etc. There is Wi-Fi present in every nook and cranny of the campus. We have one mess for food. The menu includes food from every part of the country. We have 24/7 room servi...

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides good faculty members and the food quality is also better.
reviews.review_text: Hostel facility has been twin-sharing for the first year and now, due to COVID, it's only one person per room. We have quite a large space now and we have a cupboard and an air-conditioner in our room. The hostel facility is good. The mess is quite large and can accommodate 700 people at a time. The food is of very good quality and healthy.

reviews.review_heading: IIM Udaipur is a miracle of wonders.
reviews.review_text: Hostels rooms are very spacious with attached bathroom, Wi-Fi access to the students, departmental store for their daily needs, laundry. Mess is there where hostel students can have veg or non veg meals as per their convenience, different menu is there for everyday and quality of food is also very good. Admission team helps you with all the formalities for hostel. Yes, near to the college there are many PGs and even flats are also available at some 2-3 kms distance.

reviews.review_heading: IIM Udaipur is magic with placement session.
reviews.review_text: For the first year, twin accommodations are provided. The room have basic facility, a clean shared bathroom and mess. In the second year students get individual rooms. Cost amount of hostel is 50000 per semester. (included in the fees) Along with mess fees.

reviews.review_heading: One of the great college in Udaipur.
reviews.review_text: Experiencing my first ever hostel experience that too from IIM Udaipur was really an amazing time period. All students in the hostels were quite friendly and I made great bonds with some of them who turned my best of friends. My rooms were more like study place for all of us because we have decided to discuss all our queries in my room. For fun and entertainment one of my friends room was the ideal place for us.

reviews.review_heading: The greatest college in Udaipur.
reviews.review_text: The hostels of IImu are quite good. In the first year, each room is given in a twin sharing basis, I. e, two students in each room. In the second year, every students has/her individual room. The room facilities are quite good. There is a provision of a proper cupboard for storing your clothes and other items that you would be bringing. Everyone has a study table beside the B.Ed which also has a connection to LAN.

reviews.review_heading: Review of IIM Udaipur - Indian Institute of Management, Udaipur.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure and campus life at IIM-U are awesome. 24 hours access is available to Wi-Fi. Students can remotely access all the library features, including numerous databases and journals. Each classroom at IIM-U is newly built, ergonomically designed, and air-conditioned with fixed projectors and crystal clear sound systems. There are multiple conference rooms with swivel cameras. Students can avail of single or double-occupancy hostel rooms, and the rooms are equipped with furniture, TV, ...

reviews.review_heading: There were great placements even in 2020.
reviews.review_text: Our campus offers a good environment. Our institute has been well-designed and well-equipped with all the basic management facilities such as well-furnished and air-conditioned classrooms accommodated with 3D display, projectors and sound system. There's a recreational room, sports arena and a medical room with basic medical equipment for emergency purposes. There is a huge multi-storeyed library with a collection of whopping 50,000 books, materials, journals, etc. There are 3 to 4 food outlets ...

reviews.review_heading: I am absolutely satisfied with the current placement scenario. The infrastructure is very good.
reviews.review_text: There are excellent facilities in terms of Wi-Fi, and every cluster is Wi-Fi enabled. There is a proper library for students, and there is also an online library and other resources. Gymnasium facilities are also up to the mark. There are also medical services inside the campus.

paragraphs: The Indian Institute of Management Udaipur offers a number of category-based and merit-based scholarships to students pursuing a two-year MBA. The details of all IIM Udaipur scholarships offered along with the names of their respective issuing authorities:
Central Sector Scholarship Scheme of Top-Class Education for SC Students
Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
National Fellowship and Scholarship for Higher Education of ST students
Ministry of Tribal Affairs
Merit-cum means-based scholarship scheme belonging to the minority communities
Ministry of Minority Affairs
Scheme of Scholarship for Top-Class Education for Students with Disabilities
Mukhya Mantri Sarvajan Uchcha Shiksha Scheme (for students who belong to Rajasthan)
Government of Rajasthan Scholarships

In addition to the above-mentioned scholarships, IIM Udaipur extends financial assistance to MBA aspirants who have an annual household income below INR 4.5 lakh. Other students with different severe financial conditions can also apply. This assistance is granted in the form of tuition waivers on the MBA fee.

individual_reviews.course: Integrated M.Tech. in Geological Technology - Batch of 2030
individual_reviews.title: Vibrant college life that you'll remember for a lifetime.

content.Placements: Out of 30, 15 got placed, 10 go for off-campus, 5 go for higher studies 30 LPA being the highest, the lowest goes to 10 LPA, and the average is 16 LPA. Companies like Schlumberger, British Petroleum, and mainly recruit for core jobs. Internships are very few, like fewer than 5 students get core internships, and for this also CG should be above 9. Geotechnical roles or office roles also are also offered.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is available throughout campus (except in bathrooms), and every department has well-equipped labs (note that lab supervisors may occasionally give you bad advice, so be cautious). Classrooms also have good infrastructure, including teaching boards and projectors. The library is accessible except at night (it is also open at night during exams). Additionally, there is a 24/7 reading room. New hostels are very luxurious, old ones are decent. The mess food is very good, as there are various options available. The canteen provides a 24/7 menu at a good rate. Medical facilities are provided well, MBBS doctors are available, and with insurance, free medicine and consultation. Every sport has enough sports grounds or courts, and fun games.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: A beautiful campus that anyone would love.

content.Placements: All the giants do come here, but it is not worth the hype. The top roles offered are like those of an SDE. This year, as far as I have heard, the highest package is of 1.62 crores per annum. One thing that could be done better is calling some quant giants for recruitment as well.
content.Infrastructure: Hostels for first year are decent but those of second, third, and fourth years are not good. The rooms are very small, and the washrooms are not very clean and are sinking too. The classrooms could have been a little better, as even some of their two and three-year ITs have better classrooms, and we do not have any synthetic race track so that's also a loophole. One more thing is that though healthy, the taste of the mess food is not good.

faqs.question: Do I need to give any entrance exam for admission to BSc at IIT Roorkee?
faqs.answer: Yes, in order to take admission in IIT Roorkee BSc courses, candidates must first qualify JEE Main. Students who qualify JEE Main are then required to register and appear for JEE Advanced. This exam is conducted by one of the IITs every year by rotation under the supervision of a Joint Admission Board, which comprises of representatives from all the IITs. IIT Roorkee makes the selection based on candidate’s rank according to the merit in JEE Main+ JEE Advanced.

placement_data.title: IIT Roorkee Placement Overview 2025
paragraphs: The average and median package received by CSE students in 2025 was INR 34.05 LPA and I NR 30.5 LPA . The average package received by ECE , Electrical and Civil students during Phase 1 placements 2025 was INR 30.81, INR 28.36 LPA and INR 16.62 LPA . 60 companies visited for SDE roles whereas 32 companies offered PM and Consulting roles during placements 2025 (Phase 1). Further, a total of 201 offers were made to SDE profile whereas 113 offers were made for the PM and Consulting profile . A total of 742 offers were made out of which 222 were PPOs during IIT Roorkee placements 2025 (Phase 1). 163 recruiters participated in the placement season.

In top branch such as CSE , ECE and EE , the median package received during Phase 1 placements 2025 was INR 30.5 LPA, INR 27.51 LPA and INR 25.75 LPA . Further, the average and median package received by MTech students in 2024 was INR 13.48 LPA and INR 12 LPA. The highest, average and median package offered during IIT Roorkee MBA placements 2024 was INR 26 LPA, INR 18.3 LPA and INR 18.5 LPA , respectively. MBA placement rate recorded in 2024 was 100%.

Earlier, as per the media reports, the highest domestic and international package offered during IIT Roorkee placements 2024 was INR 150 LPA and INR 205 LPA . The average package offered during IIT Roorkee placements 2024 was around INR 20 LPA .

reviews.review_heading: Vibrant college life that you'll remember for a lifetime.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available throughout campus (except in bathrooms), and every department has well-equipped labs (note that lab supervisors may occasionally give you bad advice, so be cautious). Classrooms also have good infrastructure, including teaching boards and projectors. The library is accessible except at night (it is also open at night during exams). Additionally, there is a 24/7 reading room. New hostels are very luxurious, old ones are decent. The mess food is very good, as there are various o...

reviews.review_heading: A beautiful campus that anyone would love.
reviews.review_text: Hostels for first year are decent but those of second, third, and fourth years are not good. The rooms are very small, and the washrooms are not very clean and are sinking too. The classrooms could have been a little better, as even some of their two and three-year ITs have better classrooms, and we do not have any synthetic race track so that's also a loophole. One more thing is that though healthy, the taste of the mess food is not good.

reviews.review_heading: My college campus is very nice.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very good. Our college has the famous James Thomson building, which is famous across the country. The Wi-Fi is very good. Wi-Fi is available in hostels and classrooms. Hostels are better, but three students live in a single room.

reviews.review_heading: It is one of the best institute.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of this course is good for students. Many facilities are provided by this college. It includes all-time Wi-Fi for the university students and faculty. There are many classrooms in this university for students, which are fully furnished and air-conditioned. Many hostels are available for students where students live together. In this university, the medical facilities are also good.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied. Placements are very good, which makes this a perfect Tier 1 college.
reviews.review_text: Hostels are excellent, with single rooms available. Classrooms are five-star and fully air-conditioned. The library is impressive, with all types of books available. The food in the mess is very good, fresh, and hygienic. All types of sports are also available.

reviews.review_heading: My journey and experience at IITR.
reviews.review_text: For our department/course, we have fast Wi-Fi, modern labs, smart classrooms, and rich central libraries. Hostel facilities are decent enough with 24/7 internet. Even the mess food is good and decent. Medical centres are always available. Coming to the sports section, it is excellent and well-maintained.

reviews.review_heading: Overall really good absolutely dissatisfied from mess and faculty.
reviews.review_text: The course structure is very good but it still needs improvement as most of the courses are either related to out of industry knowledge or are completely backward structured. More courses like data structures or a course providing interview knowledge regarding data structures questions being asked in the interview. Classrooms have highly functional Wi-Fi AC and heaters. The library is excellent. The quality of food in the mess and canteen is the worst with a rating of 1 out of 5 stars. The medic...

reviews.review_heading: Excellent but dissatisfied with faculty and course structure.
reviews.review_text: Our department has many facilities including smart classrooms and laboratories. Classrooms are good they have all the facilities but laboratories are still developing. There are some outdated methods that are still being used considering them to be basic experiments. Some of them are really outdated. There is a central library which is very good well maintained. Hostels are good they have many facilities including Wi-Fi gyms canteens and sports rooms. The main problem is the mess it offers reall...

reviews.review_heading: Excellent infrastructure, but dissatisfied with placements and internships.
reviews.review_text: The course is a complete 4 out of 5. Classrooms are amazing with excellent seating, AC, and heaters in winters. The practical labs cater to job-ready skills that mechanical engineers require, such as CAD modeling and sessions on 3D printing. Hostels are 3.5 out of 5 because the management is good, but the rooms could be more modern. The Wi-Fi system and balconies score 5 out of 5. The canteen and mess food are good, both 3.5 out of 5. Medical facilities and sports are excellent, 5 out of 5.

reviews.review_heading: Sometimes, prioritize college over the desire.
reviews.review_text: Departmental infrastructure is average, not like the whole campus, with a limited lab for the core branches. Wi-Fi enabled departments and classrooms are, on average, not equipped with many facilities, like comfortable seating. Libraries are there, which are accessible all the time. Hostel facilities are just okay, it depends on which hostel you are living in. Canteen and mess food have average taste. Sports facilities are there where you can explore all games.

reviews.review_heading: A short review of IIT Roorkee and its earth science department.
reviews.review_text: Department facilities are decent with well-equipped labs, and all the instruments work properly. Classrooms are also mostly tidy. Regarding the hostel, for me it's been 3 years now on the campus so I have experience living in 3 hostels. I think the best one is Jawahar by far in terms of mess, canteen, and extracurricular activities.

reviews.review_heading: IIT Roorkee - The IIT of your dreams.
reviews.review_text: The whole campus is Wi-Fi equipped. The library and other academic facilities are state-of-the-art. Some hostels are better than others and are good, others are okayish. Mess food is so bad, but breakfast is awesome and nutritional. Sports facilities and gym are top-notch.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with the campus and faculty. The core placements are not satisfactory.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure are good. There is Wi-Fi on the whole campus. Labs are well-maintained with all the modern equipment. The condition of classrooms of our department is a little bit deteriorated. The mess food is good, and the canteen food is reliable. There are good facilities for sports. Medical facilities are the best, and we can consult a doctor at any time.

reviews.review_heading: World-class infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available for our course were of a premium class. Wi-Fi-enabled campus. Modern design library with huge books. The laboratory was also equipped with all the updated instruments and machines. The hostel was also very nice. Multiple sports complexes are available.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Roorkee IIT for the Post Graduate Diploma in Hydrology course.
reviews.review_text: Our college's infrastructure quality is very good. The college canteen food is also good, very tasty, and hygienic.

faqs.question: Does IIM Kashipur participate in the CAP round?
faqs.answer: The CAP round is the abbreviated term used for the Common Admission Process that is conducted by new and baby IIM's for the ease of candiates. Candidates are shortlisted for the CAP round based on their CAT scores and candidates are required to appear for the GDPI round which is conducted once for the bunch of CAP colleges. IIM Kashipur does participate in the CAP round and has participated in the CAP 2025 as well.

All the hostels have basic amenities like bed, chair, table, closet, water cooler/ heater, washing machines and TV for recreation purposes. A common air conditioned reading room and classroom are available in each hostel which is used by students for discussions, meetings, projects and other activities. The sports facilities available in hostels are Table Tennis, Carom, Chess, Basketball, Volleyball and Badminton.

reviews.review_heading: IIM Kashipur MBA analytics is best for students who want to pursue analytics.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good from AC equipped, classrooms to sports equipments, and library. Hostels are also good with attached washrooms and a common area where refrigerators and washing machines are there. Hostels are neat and clean with spacious rooms and balcony.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Indian Institute of Management Kashipur.
reviews.review_text: Library has many books and provides many facilities. Classrooms are very good. Food served in the canteen is good.

reviews.review_heading: Nice university with all facilities.
reviews.review_text: In terms of infrastructure college is amazing and college has very huge library. Hostel is very nice in hostel room there is a room and all basic facility. In our college's canteen is very nice with affordable price with good higyenice food quality. Sports, dance, singing, drama events are conducted by students community here.

reviews.review_heading: Nice college for higher studies and for big dreamers.
reviews.review_text: College has very big campus and in terms of infrastructure college is best. And hostel facility are nice here. Classroom has projects and labs are well maintained here. In college campus Wi-Fi is available with high-speed and In college canteen food is very nice. Cricket tournament are held by college in sports events.

reviews.review_heading: IIM Kashipur - The Rising Star.
reviews.review_text: Hostels are provided to all the students. 1st-year students have to share the room while 2nd-year students are provided single occupancy rooms. Microwave, refrigerator and washing machine are provided on each floor. The food provided in the mess is of decent quality. Charges for the same are Rs 200/day.

reviews.review_heading: Infrastructure and hostels are wonderful.
reviews.review_text: IIM Kashipur is very rich in terms of infrastructure. It has a very lush green environment spread over 200 acres land. The library is huge and quite good and the study environment is also calm. They have a finance club, literature club, academic committees, and others that take care of everything from dance, music, to academics. For first-year, they provide two sharing and a single room for the second year. The hostel facility is really amazing with 24-hour electricity, oven, fridge, washing mac...

reviews.review_heading: Great placements and placement cell.
reviews.review_text: The institute is well-equipped with facilities inside and outside the campus premises such as the digital library, a computer lab, well-equipped gymnasium, well-furnished classrooms with Projector facilities and sound system facilities, conference room etc. In hostel facilities you will be getting a microwave, fridge washing machine. Everything is pretty good. Talking about food that everything here is run by students only. So, the mess committee looks after this.

reviews.review_heading: It was an exceptional growth opportunity to study among the very best in the industry.
reviews.review_text: The building was spacious and newly build with big hostel and rooms. The area in between the corridors was a getaway spot for students to sit and discuss about classes. The Wi-Fi was always available and many events were organised all throughout the year.

reviews.review_heading: Very good infrastructure with excellent facilities.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is very good, good food and on special occasion it becomes mouth watering. Gym and sports facilities are available inside the campus. There are separate grounds for each sports with proper lights for days and night. When you will enter you will love the campus if you love the natural beauty.

reviews.review_heading: Amidst in between the green environment.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is at par with other sisters IIMs. The whole campus is well-equipped with Wi-Fi classrooms, library. Quality of facilities is decent in hostel / Mess and canteen also. Medical facilities well-equipped. We have basketball court, Badminton court, Cricket ground etc.

reviews.review_heading: Best IIM in the North India.
reviews.review_text: IIM Kashipur has the best campus among the new IIMs. The hostel rooms are excellent and quite spacious with each student getting individual rooms with attached bathroom. Mess food is better than all the other messes. I have been to including engineering college.

reviews.review_heading: IIM Kashipur : one of the good option after IIM A, B, C, L.
reviews.review_text: IIM Kashipur facilities were world class and yes it must be as it is the brand of India. Classrooms were equipped with all technologies. And Library of IIM Kashipur was wonderful with best collection. Hostel facilities were also quite wonderful. Canteen facility was also world class.

reviews.review_heading: The college is the fastest-growing IIM in North India.
reviews.review_text: IIM Kashipur is the 1st of new IIMs to shift into a permanent campus. The campus is lush green and spans over 200 acres. It provides all the required facilities. Classrooms are air-conditioned and have projectors and other equipment. Hostels have single occupancy rooms. The campus is Wi-Fi enabled.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college and campus life is great.
reviews.review_text: IIM Kashipur has excellent infrastructure. The campus covers 200 acres. The entire campus is Wi-Fi enabled. Hostel rooms are spacious, and students are offered single occupancy rooms with facilities like hot water, washing machines, etc. There are basketball and volleyball courts and a fully equipped library.

reviews.review_heading: Kashipur: How to get 100% ROI?
reviews.review_text: Campus is amazing. It grows on you by the time first fall comes. Talking about specifics, all sports facilities are available. Gym wasn't there at our time in campus but you can find multiple good ones in the city. Long ride though. Classrooms and all are decent. Mess is huge and food is better than most of the places I've studied/lived at. Hostel rooms are swanky.

admission_overview.title: IIM Nagpur Admission Overview 2026
admission_overview.description: IIM Nagpur admission 2026 is being provided through the CAT exam. Admissions are entrance exam based & the application mode at IIM Nagpur is generally online. Being one of the newly established IIMs, the college is currently being mentored by the IIM Ahmedabad. IIM Nagpur gives an MBA & a PhD course in Management. The college also offers 4 PG Certificate courses along with EMBA Hybrid to interested candidates. IIM Nagpur also accepts UGC NET scores etc. for admission into its courses that is followed by a PI round. Further, the candidates have to go through GD, WAT, & PI for the final selection. After completion of the various selection rounds, a category-wise merit list is prepared by the college based on the Final Composite Scores. To get admission into IIM Nagpur's flagship PGP course, students should have a bachelor's degree, score well on the CAT (typically above a 95%), & apply to IIM Nagpur through the CAT registration process. The selection process also considers student's CAT scores, their academic performance, work experience, & the student diversity, followed by a WAT & PI.

Candidates who will appear in CAT 2025 exam will be screened based on the institute's CAT cut-offs. Candidates who clear the IIM Nagpur CAT cut-off will be notified via email and will be invited to fill out an application form for IIM Nagpur.

Candidates who meet the CAT cut-offs and have submitted their application form for IIM Nagpur within the given deadline will proceed to the second stage shortlisting score will be calculated for all such candidates, and a shortlist will be generated based on the score. The selected candidates will be called for the third stage - Personal Interview (PI) process. Candidates who are shortlisted for PI will be required to confirm their interest in the PI process of IIM Nagpur.
Step 3: IIM Nagpur Admission Confirmation

Candidates who appear for the PI process will be considered. This stage will calculate the Final Score for the candidates, based on which candidates will be shortlisted, under their merit list in the final score.

reviews.review_heading: The best college from my experience.
reviews.review_text: Meal Quality was pretty satisfactory and their menu was the catch of eye as for every occasion, big or small, you'll find a dedicated cuisine for the foodies out there. Indoor sports and gym facilities were available for students on campus to make recreational a part of their daily routine.

reviews.review_heading: The best college of my life.
reviews.review_text: Hostels were really good here. No sharing and there was 1 room for 1 person. Water quality was not that good in hostels. Mess facilities were not also very good. The registration process was not very difficult here. Since it was a residential program, and everyone was allotted a hostel.

reviews.review_heading: Infrastructure, management, facilities, faculty members, clubs, and Committees.
reviews.review_text: There are 20 clubs and committees at IIM Nagpur. We are also given subscriptions to the Economic Times, New York Times, NDLI, etc. The sports complex here is one of the best sources of entertainment. They also have a proper tennis court, yoga hall, badminton court, basketball court, and football court. Even the gym here is at par with the professional gyms. You can check the IIM Nagpur website to know the details about everything.

reviews.review_heading: IIMN is the best MBA college in Nagpur.
reviews.review_text: Our college campus is very big; it's around 132 acres. We have 33 buildings, including the Academic Block, Administration Block, and Student Hostels. We have high-speed Wi-Fi available throughout the campus. IIM Nagpur provides hostel facilities, and these facilities are good. Food is provided four times a day, and the food is very hygienic. In the hostel, we have sports, gym, and games facilities as well.

reviews.review_heading: IIM Nagpur's campus life is happening.
reviews.review_text: IIM Nagpur's infrastructure is one of the best campuses among all IIMs. Our campus has an academic block, faculty block, executive MBA block, sports complex, hostels, essential services, cafe, and mess. We have all amenities in our hostels, starting from rooms and balconies to refrigerators and automatic washing machines.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and facilities available for the students.
reviews.review_text: IIM Nagpur has excellent infrastructure for the MBA course. The college campus has good quality facilities for the students, including Wi-Fi throughout the campus. Labs, library, canteen, classrooms, and sports facilities are available for the students. The college also offers hostel facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Campus of IIM Nagpur is great, and life at the campus is fun.
reviews.review_text: Hostel facility at the campus was very good. College provided single occupancy rooms to all its students, which were well-furnished and had all the amenities. Hostel fee for each semester was Rs 35,000, and the hostel fee was included in the overall course fee. Mess food was also good at IIM Nagpur, and its menu changed every month. Mess fee was around Rs 6,000 per month. There was also a cafe and an essential store on the campus for students. Hostel fee was INR 1,05,000 per year.

reviews.review_heading: College having best quality faculty and placement opportunities for its students.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure available for the MBA course at IIM Nagpur was really good. In the college campus students were getting all the types of modern facilities. College management was properly managing all the facilities such as canteen, library, labs, Wi-Fi, sports and many more. Hostel facilities were also really food. Food quality was good at both the hostel mess and canteen.

reviews.review_heading: Nice college with all the facilities.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available in our college. Many facilities are given in college and hostel. College has good environment for study and library is large with all Books. Research papers are found. Hostel is nice with large rooms and good food.

reviews.review_heading: Review of IIM Nagpur - Indian Institute of Management.
reviews.review_text: A standard setup with all the facilities is well arranged in IIMN campus. The hostels especially are more like home than a hostel in fact. About food, everybody will have their own opinion. If you join soon, the campus is going to be huge.

reviews.review_heading: Review of IIM Nagpur - Indian Institute of Management.
reviews.review_text: We have a well-equipped campus with all the facilities. There were modern classrooms equipped with air-conditioners and projectors. Hostels have spacious rooms with all the amenities like washing machines, etc. We have a well-equipped gym. Both indoor and outdoor sports facilities were available.

reviews.review_heading: At IIM Nagpur, you look at life through a different outlook. So enjoy the time here!
reviews.review_text: We have spacious rooms in our hostels with top-of-the-class facilities like fast network connection, Wi-Fi all around the campus, well-maintained washrooms, washing machines and many more. The library has a plethora of academic resources and software for the use of students. All the essential software are provided by the institute itself. We also have Badminton, Table Tennis, volleyball, and basketball courts. Among other things, the IIM Nagpur campus also has a spacious gym to maintain your hea...

reviews.review_heading: Great learning decorum and curriculum
reviews.review_text: The course content is quite comprehensive and covers different areas of financial technology. Covers fintech fundamentals, blockchain, etc. The classroom discussions and seminars make students industry-ready.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfactory experience with amazing atmosphere. Educational hub with every facility available.
reviews.review_text:
Availability of Wi-Fi with high internet speed, well maintained classrooms with highly equipped labs, library is quite resourceful with lot of sections for readers, one can enjoy variety of co curricular activities whether sports, games, music, dance, clubs etc.
Canteen is nice but hostel is not really up to the mark.

reviews.review_heading: I had spent absolutely tremendous years of my life because of faculty members and friends.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our campus is very good. There is a Wi-Fi connection and well-furnished classrooms. Fire safety precautions are also considered. There are fire extinguishers in almost all labs. There is a very hygienic canteen with nice food in a good environment. Hostel rooms are very clean. Every day staff members will clean all the rooms. I have not faced any problems until now.

faqs.question: What is the required qualification for admission to Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham BTech course?
faqs.answer: Amrita University accept applications for only the students who fulfil the eligibility requirements. Thus, a candidate must be a Class 12 or equivalent pass from a recognised board with at least 55% aggregate in Physics, Chemistry & Mathematics separately and should have secured at least 60% aggregate in Physics, Chemistry & Mathematics. Additionally, candidates should hold the mark sheet and pass certificate as well at the time of form filling and admission confirmation. While online form filling, candidates need to upload a scanned image of the document. Further, these documents are required for verification purposes. reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by Amrita School of Engineering, Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham - Amritapuri CampusReviewed on 21 Dec 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Academic excellence and facilities, mediocre placements, and hardcore campus life.
reviews.review_text: The campus facilities are excellent and include adequately equipped CSE laboratories, strong internet access on Wi-Fi, neat classes, and a central library with a lot of stock. Facilities of the hostel are very strict yet good, with clean rooms and heavy security. Mess food is mediocre and monotonous, and there are medical and bare-bones sports amenities on campus.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by Amrita School of Engineering, Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham - Amritapuri CampusReviewed on 20 Dec 2025)
reviews.review_heading: It is good and infrastructure is getting changed every year for the better. No faculty are good .
reviews.review_text: They will provide Wi-Fi in hostel and college food is okay but not really good. They will encourage sports students. Medical facilities are there but not good quality of food is not good but the taste is okay. Library is okay, not as good looking as other colleges.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by Amrita School of Engineering, Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham - Amritapuri CampusReviewed on 20 Dec 2025)
reviews.review_heading: It is a university that believes in education for life and education for living.
reviews.review_text: In terms of facilities, it's good. There is no AC in any classroom. We can only have AC in labs, so it is better not to keep such thoughts. Hostels are good, and they are cool as the climate is mostly humid and cool here. The best quality of food is served. If students are from the state of Andhra Pradesh or Telangana, then it is hard for them to adapt to it. Medical facilities are extraordinarily good, as we can find a hospital on our own campus with all the equipment. Sports facilities are goo...

reviews.batch: Batch of 2026Offered by Amrita School of Engineering, Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham - Amritapuri CampusReviewed on 12 Dec 2025)
reviews.review_heading: It is a good college with good teachers, good placements, and a good library.
reviews.review_text: Our college has good Wi-Fi, labs, and a library. The hostel food is a bit bad because it's vegetarian. Medical facilities, sports, and games are good. Food available in the canteen is Idli, Dosa, Pasta, Sambaar, etc.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2029Offered by Amrita School of Engineering, Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham - Bengaluru CampusReviewed on 9 Dec 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Good college with decent placements and supportive faculty
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is good and useful for daily study. Classrooms are clean, labs have the required computers, and Wi-Fi works most of the time. The library is peaceful for self-study. Hostel rooms are okay. The food is average but manageable. Medical and sports facilities are available for students.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2029Offered by Amrita School of Engineering, Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham - Bengaluru CampusReviewed on 9 Dec 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Detailed and unfiltered review of Amrita University, Bangalore.
reviews.review_text: Hostels are very good at Amrita University Bangalore. Rooms are large enough for four students, which does not make it difficult because rooms have enough space. The campus is located in Bangalore, so it is not as large as it is seen in movies.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by Amrita School of Engineering, Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham - Amritapuri CampusReviewed on 6 Dec 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Absolutely dissatisfied with placements.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good, but still needs improvements. The hostel is fine, but sometimes the mess food is a big headache because when some local students go home during holidays, the mess food is the worst at night. However, during breakfast and lunch, it’s good for the amount they charge per year.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2021Offered by Amrita School of Engineering, Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham, CoimbatoreReviewed on 4 Dec 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Review of M.Tech in Biomedical Engineering.
reviews.review_text: The innovative laboratories with all the special healthcare set up are built with all such necessary biomedical devices. Students never tense about anything on campus, because there are some primary responsibilities in all the zones. Everything was followed by us under certain rules of management.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2021Offered by Amrita School of Engineering, Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham, CoimbatoreReviewed on 2 Dec 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Review of Amrita School of Engineering, Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham, Coimbatore.
reviews.review_text: The laboratories were equipped with various testing equipment, CNC machines, and other tools.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by Amrita School of Arts and Sciences, Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham - Mysuru CampusReviewed on 2 Dec 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure, but a bad hostel.
reviews.review_text: The classroom and university are beautiful, including Wi-Fi speakers, libraries, PC lab, etc., for my BBA and B.A. courses. The hostel is not good. The food is bad, the rooms are small, and you're forced to share them with 4 people. The food may consist of insects and rocks. Canteen is good tho, the quality and quantity are really good, the price too is low.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2022Offered by Amrita School of Engineering, Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham, CoimbatoreReviewed on 30 Nov 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeeth review.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available for our course were extremely good. Wi-Fi facility, modern classroom, and labs were well equipped with instruments and machinery. The quality of hostel was very good. Canteen and mess food was awesome in taste.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: First, clear the CAT, then think about this college.

content.Placements: Placements commence for us in the 3rd semester, and there is a 100% placement rate. Companies like Wells Fargo, McKinsey, Axtria, etc., visit and give about 50+ offers. The highest package is around 24 lac/annum, and the average is about 16 lac/annum. For internships, companies like ICICI Bank and Emphasis visit. The roles offered are diverse, from Data Analyst to Product Management, and the total stipend ranges from 1-200,000 for most internships. It gives the students very good industry exposure.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel rooms are pretty basic but not bad at all. The meal quality is very good. The hostel fee is about 10-15000 for a semester. The library offers a wide range of books from academic to non-academic. We can also make their virtual copy available via the library app and website. The classrooms have AC, a blackboard, & a projector. The IITK offers a wide range of sports, from football, cricket, skating, and boxing etc. Anyone who is interested in any of these activities can come and play.

reviews.review_heading: First, clear the CAT, then think about this college.
reviews.review_text: The hostel rooms are pretty basic but not bad at all. The meal quality is very good. The hostel fee is about 10-15000 for a semester. The library offers a wide range of books from academic to non-academic. We can also make their virtual copy available via the library app and website. The classrooms have AC, a blackboard, & a projector. The IITK offers a wide range of sports, from football, cricket, skating, and boxing etc. Anyone who is interested in any of these activities can come and play.

reviews.review_heading: MBA/IME Course Admission in IIT - Kanpur for the year 2025-26.
reviews.review_text: The college’s infrastructure quality is very good and provides the best facilities such as a library, classrooms, bathrooms, labs, gymkhana, water drinking machines, computers, lift elevators, etc. The college canteen serves very tasty food that tastes like home-made food.

reviews.review_heading: The placements are impressive and Ttaching quality is very high.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is great at IME, IIT Kanpur, with state-of-the-art classrooms and hostels. High-speed Wi-Fi is available throughout the campus. Mess food is good, unlike many colleges, and canteens and other eateries are also available. Facility for almost every sport is available on campus - Badminton, football, tennis, squash, cricket, volleyball, basketball, and table tennis. Medical facility is also available.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with MBA at IIT Kanpur.
reviews.review_text: The library is clearly the best one in the country! Classrooms are top-notch, and there are a plethora of options for sports and extra-curricular activities. The fest committees are run by students only. The rooms are pretty basic but not bad at all. The meal quality is very good and taken well care of. Hostels are very affordable and the registration process is pretty hassle-free.

reviews.review_heading: Great faculty members and placements.
reviews.review_text: The experience on the college campus is great and life-changing. The library named PK Kelkar library has a large number of books for every field. The classes have air conditioners and projectors for better teaching. The college provides opportunities to learn different sports and extracurricular activities and showcase your talents in different competitions. In hostel, there was fan, B.Ed study table, chair and a small window in my room. I used to have my food in the mess. The food was satisfact...

reviews.review_heading: There are good placements and excellent infrastructure with a lot of facilities.
reviews.review_text: All classrooms are well furnished with air-conditioners and high-speed Wi-Fi. There are other facilities also such as the library and labs. Labs are also well furnished with each student having their own PCs with an internet connection.  Every hostel (PG boys) has a single room facility and has good mess food plus 12 hours canteen facility. Each hostel has its own medical facilities for minor concerns. Every hostel has a basketball, badminton, volleyball court and a lawn for other sports.

reviews_list.review_title: It offers what a tier-3 college can provide and is good in terms of ROI.

review_content.Placements: This year, nearly 50% of students secure campus placements, with an overall placement rate of over 80%, including off-campus placements. The highest package is 24 LPA from Landmark Group UAE, followed by 18 LPA from Splash and 11 LPA from ICICI Bank. Most offers range between 5-8 LPA, primarily for marketing, sales, and HR roles, along with positions in operations, project management, consultancy, and analysis. The lowest package is 5 LPA. It is advisable to seek internships independently, as those offered by the college are not very relevant.
review_content.Infrastructure: The basic facilities such as smart boards, microphones and speakers, drinking water, and a girls' common room are available. The departmental library is well-equipped with resources and study materials. There are numerous canteens on campus that offer good food at reasonable prices. The campus is green and beautiful. Talking about the hostel, it has 3-seater rooms, a common room, a reading hall, clean drinking water, and average mess food available.

review_summary.college_name: Jamia Millia Islamia Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Diploma in Electrical Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: College is very good and the faculty is very helpful in every advice or term.

content.Placements: The placement records are on the notice board. About 80 percent of students get internships. The highest is 12 LPA, and the lowest is 7 LPA. I don’t know the top roles, but they are majorly corporate and some are semi-government. Overall, students are very happy with it.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is pretty good. The Wi-Fi and the canteen food are also decent. Sports happen every month, and a lot of students participate in them. Prizes are also decent, like vouchers and electronic gadgets, which are very helpful for students and increase their productivity.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Affordable and superb infrastructure college.

content.Placements: A total of 48 students got placed in 2025, and the highest is about 18.56 LPA in Optum, and the lowest is in TCS Ninja with 3.5 LPA. Top recruiting companies include TCS, Optum, HCL, Accenture, Visa, IDFC, HSBC, etc. Around 40 percent of students got their internships.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is top-class. Although the area is not that big because of the Delhi location, the overall infrastructure is the best. Jamia has its sports complex where Ranji matches are also held, and all facilities are available. Hostel charges are about Rs. 40,000 per year, including mess and accommodation.

individual_reviews.course: MBA in International Business - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: It offers what a tier-3 college can provide and is good in terms of ROI.

content.Placements: This year, nearly 50% of students secure campus placements, with an overall placement rate of over 80%, including off-campus placements. The highest package is 24 LPA from Landmark Group UAE, followed by 18 LPA from Splash and 11 LPA from ICICI Bank. Most offers range between 5-8 LPA, primarily for marketing, sales, and HR roles, along with positions in operations, project management, consultancy, and analysis. The lowest package is 5 LPA. It is advisable to seek internships independently, as those offered by the college are not very relevant.
content.Infrastructure: The basic facilities such as smart boards, microphones and speakers, drinking water, and a girls' common room are available. The departmental library is well-equipped with resources and study materials. There are numerous canteens on campus that offer good food at reasonable prices. The campus is green and beautiful. Talking about the hostel, it has 3-seater rooms, a common room, a reading hall, clean drinking water, and average mess food available.

individual_reviews.course: M.A. in Sanskrit - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: Jamia Millia Islamia review

content.Placements: The placement in our course was not good in any college because it is an academic course, not a vocational course. The career options after this are assistant professor, teacher, or translator. Some companies like BPO/Customer Care recruit us with a salary of 3–4 LPA. Students also got internships in various institutes.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure available for our course were extremely good. Wi-Fi facility was available. A central library was present. Classrooms were integrated with digital TV. The quality of the hostel was extremely good, but the hostel capacity was very less, so most students could not get hostel accommodation.

individual_reviews.course: B.A. Hons. in French and Francophone Studies - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Review of Jamia Millia Islamia.

content.Placements: The placement in our course is not quite good, but it has a good curriculum and alumni network as compared to other colleges. The package offered in our course is around 4-5 LPA. Some translating firms hire us. Around 70 percent of students get internship offers.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure available for our course are good. Wi-Fi is available. Classrooms are good. A central library is present. The hostel quality and our faculty members are good. All essential facilities are available. Food and canteen food are good.
