At the postgraduate level, Jamia offers numerous MBA andE-MBAprogrammes to students in the field of Management. This two-year course is offered as a General course and is also provided across numerous specialisations, namely International Business, Entrepreneurship and Family Business and Healthcare and Hospital Management, among others. Check out the below video to know more: Read on to know more about Jamia Millia Islamia MBA admission.

faqs.question: How can I seek MBA admission at Jamia Millia Islamia?
faqs.answer: Jamia Millia Islamia MBA is a full-time programme offered at the PG level. The two-year programme is offered in six specialisations. Jamia Millia Islamia MBA admission is based on the performance of candidates in the JMI Entrance Exam followed by a Group Discussion (GD) and Personal Interview (PI) round.

faqs.question: How can I take admission to JMI for MBA?
faqs.answer: Candidates seeking admission to Jamia Millia Islamia for MBA can apply online on the official website. Admission to this course is offered based on the entrance exam conducted by the university, i.e. JMI Entrance Eest. Interested candidates must have a relevant bachelor’s degree with at least 50% aggregate in the subject concerned. Followed by application filling and before application submission, candidates are also required to pay the application fee which ranges from INR550 to INR 700. A step

faqs.question: I've scored less than 60% in graduation, can I get admission in Jamia Millia Islamia for MBA?
faqs.answer: To get admission in MBA program at Jamia Millia Islamia, students need to have completed undergraduate course from recognised university with minimum of 50% marks. Only meeting eligibility criteria does not guarantee admission to this course, students also need a valid score of CAT, CMAT, XAT, or MAT, alongside the JMI entrance test. They also need to appear in counselling and interviews. The application form can be filled on JMI website. It is top rated program with good ROI and placements.

faqs.question: Does Jamia Millia Islamia accept CAT score for MBA admission?
faqs.answer: According to official brochure of Jamia Millia Islamia, dated 2023. The university only accepts result of Jamia Entrance Test forMBAadmission. Interested students seeking admission are required to have completed their undergraduate degree from a recognsied university with at least 50% aggregate or equivalent grade. However, students who have a valid CAT score can reach out to admisison office to confirm if such special cases can be treated individually for admission to MBA programme.

faqs.question: Does Jamia Millia Islamia accept CUET score?
faqs.answer: Yes, Jamia Millia Islamia accepts CUET scores for UG courses such as BA, BSc and BVoc. Jamia Millia Islamia admission is based on entrance exam score. The university released its prospectus for admissions in March with the schedule for admission to courses accepting national-level and university-level entrance exams. JMI, New Delhi offers over 220 courses in both regular and self-financed modes. The university also provides distance learning courses at undergraduate (UG), postgraduate (PG), and Diploma levels.

faqs.question: How can I get admission in Jamia Millia Islamia?
faqs.answer: Jamia Millia Islamia admission to UG and PG courses is entrance exams based. The university accepts JMI entrance exam, CUET and JEE Main for admission. Further, to be eligible for admission, students also need to pass Class 12 with 50% for admission to UG courses and a graduation degree with 50-55% aggregate for admission to PG courses.

faqs.question: What is the reservation percentage for Muslim candidates at JMI?
faqs.answer: Jamia Millia Islamia offers seat reservations in almost all the courses based on the category of the students. Candidates seekingJMI admissionunder the reserved category can apply for reservation under one category only and are required to fulfil the prescribed eligibility conditions of the course. placement_data.title: Jamia Millia Islamia Placement Overview 2025
paragraphs: The 2025 placement data has been released for MCA and MSc Bioinformatics. The highest salary offered to MCA and MSc Bioinformatics students during 2025 placements was INR 18.5 LPA and INR 6 LPA . The placement rate for MCA was 46% . The MCA average salary stood at INR 7.85 LPA . TCS, IBM, and Newgen were some of the renowned companies.

The University has released the annual report 2024 incorporating the 2024 placement stats. The highest salary offered to the 2024 batch was INR 59.91 LPA and was offered to BTech Computer Engineering students. For MBA, the highest salary stood at INR 24 LPA. The total number of students placed during Jamia Millia Islamia placements 2024 was 330. The number of BTech Electrical Engineering students placed was 54 . The highest and lowest salary offered to BTech EE students was INR 22 LPA and INR 2.2 LPA .

reviews.review_heading: College is very good and the faculty is very helpful in every advice or term.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is pretty good. The Wi-Fi and the canteen food are also decent. Sports happen every month, and a lot of students participate in them. Prizes are also decent, like vouchers and electronic gadgets, which are very helpful for students and increase their productivity.

reviews.review_heading: Affordable and superb infrastructure college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is top-class. Although the area is not that big because of the Delhi location, the overall infrastructure is the best. Jamia has its sports complex where Ranji matches are also held, and all facilities are available. Hostel charges are about Rs. 40,000 per year, including mess and accommodation.

reviews.review_heading: It offers what a tier-3 college can provide and is good in terms of ROI.
reviews.review_text: The basic facilities such as smart boards, microphones and speakers, drinking water, and a girls' common room are available. The departmental library is well-equipped with resources and study materials. There are numerous canteens on campus that offer good food at reasonable prices. The campus is green and beautiful. Talking about the hostel, it has 3-seater rooms, a common room, a reading hall, clean drinking water, and average mess food available.

reviews.review_heading: Jamia Millia Islamia review
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available for our course were extremely good. Wi-Fi facility was available. A central library was present. Classrooms were integrated with digital TV. The quality of the hostel was extremely good, but the hostel capacity was very less, so most students could not get hostel accommodation.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Jamia Millia Islamia.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure available for our course are good. Wi-Fi is available. Classrooms are good. A central library is present. The hostel quality and our faculty members are good. All essential facilities are available. Food and canteen food are good.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the overall experience, good environment, and decent infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Hostels are well maintained and have all the basic necessities like Wi-Fi and air-conditioned libraries. The campus has decent infrastructure. The washrooms are not that great and need regular cleaning. Classrooms are well-ventilated. The food quality in the mess and the canteen is average but eatable. Medical facilities are barely provided. There is a huge sports complex at gate number 3.

reviews.review_heading: Best college for mass communication.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available for our course were extremely good. Wi-Fi facility was available. A central Library was present. The quality of the hostel was awesome, but it's rare to get a hostel. A medical facility was available in the college. A sports and games complex was available.

reviews.review_heading: It's a beautiful campus and a well-reputed university, and the teaching staff is great.
reviews.review_text: The hostel accommodation began by December, while I secured a seat in August itself. So it got a little difficult for me. The room is nice, spacious with a 3 seater, food was okay, we used to get veg and non-veg both. The quality was not great but decent. Seats are very much limited, this is one issue. The hostel is 1.5 km away from the college. Hostel fee is INR 48,000 per year. They need improvement in terms of class infrastructure, smart boards and projects are needed.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the quality of the course.
reviews.review_text: Our department is equipped with high-speed Wi-Fi, AC, a water purifier, and a projector. To conduct experiments, all necessary facilities are available in our lab, including RT-PCR, qPCR, BSL-2, a cell culture room, and a Virus culture lab. Our university has a central library near my department, where you can issue any two books for 14 days. The central canteen has good quality food at a cheap rate, and many other shops are also there. Cricket ground and other sports grounds are working, you ca...

reviews.review_heading: JMI: A central university in New Delhi.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good. Classrooms have AC for 2nd year students onwards, and the seats are good. Sometimes issues are faced that are resolved within a few days. Wi-Fi is available. FET library is working from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM on weekdays. The central library in a block remains open from 9:00 AM-2:AM, except national holidays.

reviews.review_heading: Very good faculty and very nice experience.
reviews.review_text: There are six boys' hostels named F.R.K, A.P.J, B.R.A, A.M.K, Kelat, and S.R.K (Alma Iqbal is not available right now). The hostels and mess are very affordable, with hygienic and nutritious food. The engineering department has one big building with different sections for different departments. The library has AC and Wi-Fi connection.

reviews.review_heading: Good faculty, but 2024 was not a good year for engineering.
reviews.review_text: All five departments, Computer, Electronic, Electrical, Mechanical, and Civil, have a common building. There is one separate building for the library and reading room, fully air-conditioned with centralized Wi-Fi. Electrical Engineering classes have no AC. In Jamia, there are 7 boys' hostels and 3 girls' hostels. The mess is hygienic and very affordable. Hostel costs around Rs. 40,000 per year for mess and accommodation.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, everything is okay.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure are good. Department is also good. Wi-Fi is good. Classrooms are not too much good. Library is excellent. The food quality is not too much good in mess. Canteen food is good. Medical facilities are free which is good. Sports and games are also good.

reviews.review_heading: Dissatisfied with placement but very good faculty.
reviews.review_text: The quality of mess food is good, especially in A.P.J. hostel and F.R.K. hostel. There are 3 girls' hostels and 6 or 7 boys' hostels, and there are many canteens in Jamia with affordable prices. Sports facilities are available, as well as a clinic. The engineering department has one building, and there is another building for the reading room and library.

reviews.review_heading: 2022 is the best year for electrical engineering.
reviews.review_text: The overall campus is good. The buildings are good, and the dentistry building is very nice, well-maintained, and well-designed. The engineering department has a personal library and reading room, and all 5 departments of engineering have a common building. There are a total of 6 boys' hostels and 3 girls' hostels. The mess is hygienic, and the food is decent at a reasonable price. Jamia has a sports complex and a free clinic for students.

review_content.General: The campus is newly built with all modern amenities. The vicinity in which the campus is located is quite desolate. Facilities are still under construction, so constant construction noise disturbs. The location is very far from the main city, with limited options for cabs and online orders. Networks like Airtel have issues on campus, but the newly built library has all study materials. I receive a single occupancy room with AC, fan, almirah, cupboard, mattress, a 7-foot-long mirror, a whiteboard, and a pinboard, with daily room cleaning facilities. Food is mostly South Indian, but we receive chicken three days a week.

content.Placements: The placement record of the college is becoming more promising with each passing day. Currently, a limited number of companies are visiting. The highest package offered, as per the latest record, is 42 lakhs, and the average is 16.5 lakhs, with 50% of the batch falling above the average range. The top 25% receive approximately a 23 lakh package. The roles offered include analyst, wealth management trainee, senior analyst, finance analyst, IT consultant, etc. Top recruiters include ICICI Bank, Deloitte, KPMG, Yes Bank, EY, Anand Rathi, and Amul.
content.Infrastructure: The campus is newly built with all modern amenities. The vicinity in which the campus is located is quite desolate. Facilities are still under construction, so constant construction noise disturbs. The location is very far from the main city, with limited options for cabs and online orders. Networks like Airtel have issues on campus, but the newly built library has all study materials. I receive a single occupancy room with AC, fan, almirah, cupboard, mattress, a 7-foot-long mirror, a whiteboard, and a pinboard, with daily room cleaning facilities. Food is mostly South Indian, but we receive chicken three days a week.

individual_reviews.course: Post Graduate Programme (PGP) - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Really good infrastructure and facilities.

content.Placements: In my college, every student got a job with a good salary package. Packages like 40 LPA are high; this is the top role offered in our course, and 7 LPA is low, while 15 LPA is the average in our courses. Top recruiting companies like Symbiosis Technology, Wipro Limited, etc., offered jobs to 100% of students.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure are very impressive for our courses and departments. 24*7 Wi-Fi is present, labs, classrooms, and the library are fine; there are no other words. Yes, the hostel is pretty good. The mess provides very hygienic varieties of food, although it is costly. Medical facilities and sports/games are available.

individual_reviews.course: Post Graduate Programme (PGP) - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: IIM Visakhapatnam is a perfect place to pursue a financial degree.

content.Placements: The course I opted for at IIM Visakhapatnam was PGP. The placement percentage was very good. Almost 100% of students got placed. Companies like Amazon and Flipkart visited the college for placements, offering roles such as financial manager. The highest package offered was 90 LPA, with an average package around 25 LPA. Almost every student gets an internship in their final year with good companies with proper stipends.
content.Infrastructure: As we all know, IIM campuses were well-equipped with all the future amenities. I really miss my campus a lot. The infrastructure of classrooms and hostels were excellent and maintained in a proper and neat manner. The food available was great and hygienic, and all facilities like sports, a medical center, and a supermarket were present inside the campus.

individual_reviews.course: Post Graduate Program for Experienced Professionals (PGPEx) - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: College placement is very good.

content.Placements: Students become eligible for placements right from the 4th Term. Around 180-190 companies visited the campus for placements last year The highest package offered was around 32 Lacs per annum and the average package was around 16 Lacs per annum. All students get placed. IIM Visakhapatnam has a 100 percent placement rate My plan is to join the marketing department of a reputed company as a Brand Manager.
content.Infrastructure: Samaarambh is the annual cultural fest of IIM Visakhapatnam and is conducted in the month of February. There are a lot of books on Managerial subjects available in the library if someone wants to do an in-depth study other than the course material which is provided to them. Other than that there are journals, newspapers and magazines available as well. Even biographies of famous and successful personalities. The classrooms are tidy and have 2 Televisions, and 2 Projectors to view presentations and are well organized with even cameras which track and detect the movement of any lecturer for anyone who would like to view a lecture from a different classroom. A lot of sports and extra curricular activities can be undertaken on the campus with a world-class sports complex consisting of a gym, basketball court, football ground, Athletic track, cricket ground, Pool table and Table tennis area available. The Student Affair Council here is the vice of the students at IIM Visakhapatnam.

admission_overview.title: IIM Visakhapatnam Admission Overview 2025
admission_overview.description: IIM Visakhapatnam admission 2025 is primarily entrance-based. The IIM Vizag application process is online. Admission to all the courses is completely entrance-based followed by an Interview round. Indian Institute of Management (IIM) Visakhapatnam offers various postgraduate and doctoral programmes such as PGP, PGPEx, PGPDGM, EMBA, PhD and MGNF. PGP is the flagship course offered by the institute. IIM Vizag admission to the PGP/ MBA programmes is through the Common Admission Test (CAT) followed by a Personal Interview round. Moreover, for PhD programme candidate with a valid score in CAT/ GMAT/ GRE/ GATE/ UGC-JRF/ CSIR(NET) are eligible to apply. As for the programme like the PGPDGM and PGPEx a valid score of either CAT/ GATE/ GMAT/ GRE or IIMV Test is applicable. Shortlisted candidates are invited for the Interview round for admission in various IIM Vizag courses.

paragraphs: IIM Visakhapatna admission process 2025is ongoing, and the Interview calls will be out soon.IIM Vizag admission 2025is entirely entrance-based as the institute accepts the scores and percentile scores of various entrance examinations such as CAT/ GMAT/GRE/ IIMV Test, etc. for admission in various courses. For admission to PGP, candidates are shortlisted based on the valid CAT scores, which match the cutoff for admission at IIM Vizag. For other programme likePhDandPGPEX, applications can be directly submitted through IIM Visakhapatnam website. IIM Vizag admission is conducted in phase wise manner. Find below theIIM Vizag admission process 2025:
STEP 1: IIM Visakhapatnam Application Process 2025

Indian Institute of Management Visakhapatnam application processis carried out in online mode. Candidates need to completeCAT registrationon iimcat.ac.in for admission to PGP, EMBA and PGPDGM programmes. For PhD and PGPEx courses, applications are accepted via IIM Vizag's official website. Once theCAT resultsare announced, candidates are required to fill out a detailed online application form separately for theIIM Vizag MBA course.
STEP 2: Personal Interview

Candidates who fill out the online application form and meet the minimum percentile will be considered as 'Qualified Confirmed Candidates'. IIM Visakhapatnam will then calculate the weighted scores based on CAT, Class 10, Class 12, Bachelor's degree, Diversity and Wok Experience and will give the Interview calls and candidates will then be required to appear for the Personal Interview round. The interview round for the For PhD, PGPEX and PGPDGM programme is conducted after the release of the selection list.
STEP 3: Final Selection

IIM Vizag will then calculate the 'Final Aggregate Score' based on various parameters like Personal Interview, CAT, Class 10, Class 12, Bachelor's degree, Diversity and Work Experience and will give the final shortlist for MBA/ PGP.

The final selection for various programmes is based on certain parameters including CAT/ GMAT/GRE/ IIMV Test, Diversity, Technical Knowledge and Domain Experience, SOP, Professional References and Personal Interview scores.
STEP 4: Admission Confirmation
The selected candidates can confirm their seats/ admission by paying the required amount ofIIM Visakhapatnam MBA fees.

Note:Candidates who are shortlisted and interviewed by IIMs Bangalore, Kozhikode, Lucknow or Indore (only for their PGP/ PGPM programme) will not be required to appear for the Personal Interview at IIM Vizag. For these candidates, the average of their Personal Interview scores from the aforementioned IIMs will be used to calculate their Personal Interview score for IIM Visakhapatnam. CheckIIM Vizag Cutoffs.

courses_data.description: IIM Visakhapatnam provides a 2-year Executive MBA (EMBA) course to students. Students who are Indian nationals and also residing in India only & who have a min. of 3-year Bachelor's degree with a minimum of 50% marks or equal CGPA (45% for NC-OBC/ EWS category candidates & 40% for SC/ ST/ PwD category candidates) & who have a min. of 3 years of full-time work experience as on the closing date of the respective application window at an officer/ executive level or higher, as a professional, or as an entrepreneurecan apply for IIM Vizag EMBA programme. IIM Visakhapatnam EMBA admissionis based on a composite score of performance in the EMAT & PI (online mode). The final composite score is created based on 47.5% weight to EMAT & PI each & 5% will be awarded to Female & Transgender students. Students who may have appeared for CAT/ GRE/GMAT& have valid test score can be exempted from EMAT. IIM Vizag also has PGPEx course for students. Candidates who have a min of 3-year Bachelor’s degree with min. 55% marks or equal & who have a minimum of 3 years of full-time work experience at an officer/ executive level or higher; as a professional or as an entrepreneur can apply for admission to the PGPEx programme. Candidates who require a valid CAT/ GMAT/ GRE scores to be considered for admission. Candidates can also choose to apply for PGPEx by opting to take IIMV Test. Shortlisted candidates are required to appear for Personal Interview.

reviews.review_heading: An overview of IIM Visakhapatnam.
reviews.review_text: A hostel is mandatory for every student. The best hostel facility is available on campus. Single-sharing room with AC, beds, and almirah. Study lamps and everything else that will be necessary for the next two years. All hostels have mesmerizing scenic views from their windows. Fridges, washing machines, induction, and clothing drying areas are available on every floor. Food is good in comparison to other foods. Breakfast, lunch, snacks and dinner are being provided, as well as special food on s...

reviews.review_heading: Indian institute of management Visakhapatnam.
reviews.review_text: The campus is newly built with all modern amenities. The vicinity in which the campus is located is quite desolate. Facilities are still under construction, so constant construction noise disturbs. The location is very far from the main city, with limited options for cabs and online orders. Networks like Airtel have issues on campus, but the newly built library has all study materials. I receive a single occupancy room with AC, fan, almirah, cupboard, mattress, a 7-foot-long mirror, a whiteboard...

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure are very impressive for our courses and departments. 24*7 Wi-Fi is present, labs, classrooms, and the library are fine; there are no other words. Yes, the hostel is pretty good. The mess provides very hygienic varieties of food, although it is costly. Medical facilities and sports/games are available.

reviews.review_heading: IIM Visakhapatnam is a perfect place to pursue a financial degree.
reviews.review_text: As we all know, IIM campuses were well-equipped with all the future amenities. I really miss my campus a lot. The infrastructure of classrooms and hostels were excellent and maintained in a proper and neat manner. The food available was great and hygienic, and all facilities like sports, a medical center, and a supermarket were present inside the campus.

reviews.review_heading: College placement is very good.
reviews.review_text: Samaarambh is the annual cultural fest of IIM Visakhapatnam and is conducted in the month of February. There are a lot of books on Managerial subjects available in the library if someone wants to do an in-depth study other than the course material which is provided to them. Other than that there are journals, newspapers and magazines available as well. Even biographies of famous and successful personalities. The classrooms are tidy and have 2 Televisions, and 2 Projectors to view presentations a...

reviews.review_heading: About the campus of Visakhapatnam.
reviews.review_text: I am overwhelmed to share the infrastructure and facilities of IIM Visakhapatnam. It's a beautiful space fully filled with beautiful souls and good vibes only. Events are arranged in great manner, and the students from other colleges participate in such events.

paragraphs: IIM Vizag offers scholarship to the candidates who are financial instable, with an objective of helping candidates to pursue their education. All PGP students with annual household income below INR 6,00,000 are eligible to apply for financial aid. Other students with severe financial difficulties arising from sudden unforeseen circumstances are also considered.A two-step process is included in deciding the number of awardees and the quantum of aid. In the first stage, students are given a Financial-status Score based on four criteria:

Based on this score, some of the students are called for personal interaction with a faculty panel. During the interaction, the faculty panel evaluates the financial need of the student, as well as establishes the genuineness of the details provided by the student in the application, and assigns a financial score. Based on the weighted average of these two scores, applicants are provided 100%, 80%, 60%, 40%, or 20% financial aid.

review_content.Placements: Honestly, there is no 100% placement; they forced students to PPT up for placement so they could get the tag of 100% placement. But, in honesty, they have quality placement. In the last year, one student from college got a 55 lac package; here, the average package we can expect is 12 lacs from the first semester when companies start visiting for placements. The 3-month internship is mandatory for each student. Recruiting companies are Wipro, BNY Mellon, Goldman Sachs, Amazon, Microsoft, Dell Technologies, Cisco, Google, and Dalmia Bharat.
review_content.Infrastructure: IMT campus never sleeps; you can see students at any moment in campus. You got utmost exposure here. There are lot of books and journals and you receive regular mail from library regarding new journals. The whole campus is air-conditioned. Classrooms are big there are sports events organized in campus. Hostel rooms are double, occupying 2 almirahs and 2 single beds; 2 tables and chairs are for each room. Rooms are also air-conditioned, and living in a hostel is mandatory as part of the residential programme. They give me four meals a day.

review_summary.college_name: IMT Ghaziabad Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: PGDM Dual Country Programme - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: One of the best colleges for placement.

content.Placements: Our college placement cell is very active. Around 99% of students are placed in many companies. Median salary goes to 16.25 LPA. Top recruitment companies are Birlasoft, HCL, American Express, and many more. More than 200 companies visit during placement season. Other than job offers, companies offer internships to students. Many students are getting jobs in this company while doing an internship. Common roles offered like consulting, IT, sales, and marketing.
content.Infrastructure: College infrastructure is pretty good and provides a good environment to students. Everything you need is already available here like separate labs for each course, library with amazing many types of books, and business magazines available here. Classrooms are properly decorated and each classrooms have a sound speaker. Mess food is too good and maintains proper hygiene. Mess repeats its food schedule every two weeks so that the students don't get bored eating the same food. Medical help is available 24X7. Sports facility is awesome. Our college organizes sports fest which name is Chakravyuh where 9 types of sports are organised.

individual_reviews.course: Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: IMT Ghaziabad - The B school offering everything.

content.Placements: Almost 100% of students from our course got placed. The highest salary package offered is 65 LPA and the lowest package salary package offered is 12 LPA. The average salary package offered ranges from 17-18 LPA. Top recruiting companies like Marico, Microsoft, Amazon, Adobe, etc., visit the college for placements. Almost 100% of students got an internship in FMCGs like MTR, Tata Consumer Products, Marico, Dabur, and other tech and marketing companies. Finance also had great placements with a lot of companies from the BFSI sector and also big names like Arcesium, D. E. Shaw, Goldman Sachs, etc. The top roles offered are management trainee, marketing trainee, risk management, etc.

individual_reviews.course: PGDM in Financial Management - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Top most institute for PG.

content.Placements: Honestly, there is no 100% placement; they forced students to PPT up for placement so they could get the tag of 100% placement. But, in honesty, they have quality placement. In the last year, one student from college got a 55 lac package; here, the average package we can expect is 12 lacs from the first semester when companies start visiting for placements. The 3-month internship is mandatory for each student. Recruiting companies are Wipro, BNY Mellon, Goldman Sachs, Amazon, Microsoft, Dell Technologies, Cisco, Google, and Dalmia Bharat.
content.Infrastructure: IMT campus never sleeps; you can see students at any moment in campus. You got utmost exposure here. There are lot of books and journals and you receive regular mail from library regarding new journals. The whole campus is air-conditioned. Classrooms are big there are sports events organized in campus. Hostel rooms are double, occupying 2 almirahs and 2 single beds; 2 tables and chairs are for each room. Rooms are also air-conditioned, and living in a hostel is mandatory as part of the residential programme. They give me four meals a day.

individual_reviews.course: Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM ExP) - Batch of 2017
individual_reviews.title: Our college has good value for money.

content.Placements: More than 70% of students got placed in 2017. The highest salary package offered was 6 LPA. The lowest salary package offered was 3 LPA. Top recruiting companies were Dixon, HCL, Zomato, etc. All students got internships.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel management was very good. The laundry service was hygienic and well-maintained. Security was always active at the main gate.
content.Faculty: Teachers were very helpful. The curriculum and exams were good. We used to revise well before exams. All teachers were highly educated and very supportive. They conducted extra classes for the best performance in exams.

individual_reviews.course: PGDM in Marketing - Batch of 2019
individual_reviews.title: Review of IMT Ghaziabad - Institute of Management Technology.

content.Placements: Around 80% of students got placed easily. The highest package offered was around 5 LPA, and the lowest package was about 2 LPA. Around 60% of students got internships. The college supports and guides you in every possible manner.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is available within the college premises. The speed of Wi-Fi is also good. Labs, classrooms and library are regularly cleaned and well-maintained. The quality of food in the college is good. They prepare different food items on different days, and special food is provided on special occasions.

admission_overview.college_name: IMT Ghaziabad Admission 2025 (Open): Courses, Fee, Eligibility & Selection, Application

paragraphs: Institute of Management Technology Ghaziabad admission window 2025 is open. The institute provides PG programmes under the management stream. IMT Ghaziabad admissions are based on entrance tests. Candidates must possess a valid score in the course-related entrance exam for admission. Applicants who are interested in pursuing the Degree of PGDM need to complete the eligibility requirement of IMT Ghaziabad that includes graduation in any course, with an aggregate percentage of 50 and valid CAT/XAT/GMAT scorecard.
The applications of ineligible candidates are treated as invalid. The following table mentions the eligibility and selection for some of the popularIMT Ghaziabad courses:
Eligibility Criteria
Selection Criteria
3-year bachelor's degree in any discipline with at least 50% aggregate
CAT/XAT/GMAT+ Personal Interview + Work Experience + Academic Scores
Master's degree or equivalent in any discipline with at least 60% aggregate OR
Five-year integrated master's degree programme with a minimum of 60% aggregate OR
Graduation with a professional qualification - CA/CMA/CS
CAT/GMAT/GRE/UGC-NET

Aspirants will make sure that they present the applications prior to the last date of IMT Ghaziabad form. Moreover, the process of admission is a multi-stage process that includes online registration, filling the application form, selection rounds and allocating seats. The information on each of the stages of the admission procedure is presented below in more detail:
Step 1: IMT Ghaziabad 2025 Application Process.

Application forms of IMT Ghaziabad are through the online method. The official site (www.IMT.edu) allows qualified applicants to enroll themselves to the preferred course. In order to be successful in submitting the application form, the payment of the fee should be completed in time. IMT Ghaziabad charges are in INR 3,500 and the bank charges. The exam score accepted is also needed during the form filling process.
Step 2: Shortlisting of Students.

The institute selects candidates to admission as per the score in accepted IMT Ghaziabad exam ( CAT/XAT/GMAT-PGDM, and CAT/GMAT/GRE/UGC-NET- FPM). A cut off list may be issued to declare the lowest marks which will qualify one to join the respective course. Applicants with a mark that is at least equivalent to the cutoff marks can be selected in the rounds.
Step 3: Personal Interview and Selective Rounds.

The shortlisted applicants must undergo the interview round in both FPM and the PGDM course admission. Moreover, in the case of IMT Ghaziabad PGDM admission, the other criteria upon which selection is made are the work experience of the candidate, academic performance, ability to think critically, and unbiasedness in terms of education.
Step 4: Result Declaration
The institute announces the final results after all the selection rounds. The candidates will have access to the results checked online on the official website of the institute.

Candidates willing to take admission in MBA programme at IIM Bodhgaya should have a UG degree in any domain with a minimum of 50% aggregate along with a valid score in the CAT exam based on which they will be shortlisted for the Personal Interview (PI) round. Those who qualify the Personal Interview (PI) round will be required to report to the admission cell at IIM Bodhgaya for document verification and fee payment.
faqs.question: Does IIM Bodhgaya accepts admission in MBA through any other exam besides CAT?

faqs.answer: A:    There is no such of provision for getting direct admission in Phd in Management course at IIM Bodhgaya. Candidates willing to pursue Phd in Management programme at IIM Bodhgaya must have a valid CAT/ GMAT/ GATE/ GRE score (last two years), along with relevant work experience. Candidates based on their score in any one of the aforesaid exam will be shortlisted for the personal interview (PI) round and will also be evaluated on other parameters such as work profile and academic profile. Those who qualify all the required admission rounds will be required to report to the admission cell at IIM Bodhgaya for document verification and tuition fee payment leading to final seat allotment.

individual_reviews.course: Integrated Programme in Management (IPM) - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: IIM Bodh Gaya is definitely one of the biggest ones.

content.Placements: Placements are often good. While my course hasn't gone through the placement process yet, the MBA batch placements have been done, and the highest was 44 LPA. However, the lowest was not disclosed, and the average was 14 LPA. The college offers 100% placements every year, which enhances its alumni relations.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is mesmerizing, whether it be the academic block or the sports complex. Everything is up to the mark, and hostels are also well and good. Proper maintenance of hostels and other infrastructure is taken, cleanliness is maintained, and it feels like home.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Average because of faculty, good placement

content.Placements: Mostly, sales roles will be offered for freshers, and if you have a B.Tech background, then only you will grab a good placement. The top recruiters of the college are HSBC, BNY MELLON, ICICI BANK, BENQ, NATIONAL STOCK EXCHANGE, HDFC, ACCENTURE, and V GUARD.
content.Infrastructure: The mess food is average, and all the facilities are available in the hostel, but there are some hygiene problems and water issues in the hostel. The library is good, having strong infrastructure. The college has very good infrastructure, and the view in the morning and evening is very nice.

individual_reviews.course: Integrated Programme in Management (IPM) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: IPMAT the Enlightening IIM.

content.Placements: The first batch of IPM will be placed in 2026 after merging with the MBA Batch of 2026. There are no campus placements for IPM after BBA. We can get an idea about how the placements are going to be for IPM by looking at the placements of the MBA Batch. In 2023, the highest package received was INR 48 LPA while the average and median stood at INR 15 LPA. 70 companies visited the campus for placements in 2023. Most of the students are placed in BFSI and consulting sectors. You can check out the placement brochure on the website of IIM BG for more details.

individual_reviews.course: Integrated Programme in Management (IPM) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Great faculty, curriculum and supportive culture.

content.Placements: The placements of the college is excellent. The placecomm works day and night to bring the best companies in the campus, and almost all of the gets placed. The companies also offer good salaries and the median salary has also been growing. Although placements have not started yet for us, it would definitely be a great one.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is good, the rooms are spacious bathrooms are clean. The new acad block is good but since construction is going on, the infrastructure is building. The mess is also nicely built, and food available is also good. The Wi-Fi speed is also good. There is medical block, gym, table tenn, bask, and more.

individual_reviews.course: Integrated Programme in Management (IPM) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Review of IIM Bodh Gaya - Indian Institute of Management.

content.Placements: Placements offered here is exemplary. The range of companies is extremely diverse. Companies like Amazon, Mckinsey, and others come here to hire many bright students. Placements are rising exponentially each year. IIM BG is emerging as one of the fastest-growing IIMs.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is decent. It's gradually improving at an astronomical rate. There is a basketball court, a table tennis court, and a gym.
content.Faculty: Faculty members here are incredible. The teaching quality is decent. The range of courses is eclectic. Marketing, HRM, and Economics faculty members are truly surreal. The course is designed in such a way as to promote eclectic and holistic approaches. The IPM program is designed in such a way that it provides an overall educational experience. The semester examinations are intellectually challenging.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: Satisfied with the curriculum and placements, but lacks in infrastructure and teaching skills.

review_content.Placements: The percent of students who get placed in my course is quite decent. The highest package offered is 1.2 crores per annum. The average package offered ranges from 7-8 LPA, which is good. Top companies like EY, Adobe, and Flipkart visit the college every year. The internship ratio is not so good. Companies offer different roles and mainly focus on software engineers.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the course department and hostel is not up to date as there is much rush in the building every time. In hostels, there is no lift. There is a big line whenever we go to the mess. The quality of food is not up to the mark. It also provides us with Wi-Fi and medical facilities.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
reviews_list.review_title: No good return on investment in this university for all the students.

review_content.Placements: Almost 20% of students will get placed in 2025. The highest package is 1.7 crore, the average is around 6 LPA, and the lowest is 3 LPA. The top recruitment companies are TCS, Wipro, and Infosys. About internships, mostly good internships are available for students through off-campus placements, while very few students get on-campus internships. I have no idea about the top roles.
review_content.Infrastructure: Wifi speed is not very good, but can be said to be okay. Labs are decent, classrooms are not good; benches in the last rows are broken in many classrooms. The library is decent and provides an environment for studies. If someone's faculty is good, then he or she will get good marks in practicals, and if someone's is bad, then better luck next time.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: Campus life & career-ready.

review_content.Placements: Around 60% of the students get placed per year. The placements kick start right from the 6th semester. My placements will start in Feb 2026. It depends on your skills, your personality, and your communication skills. The average package offered to CSE students is 8 LPA.
review_content.Infrastructure: The hostel facilities are not that good personally. The rooms are small, and all of them are either 4 or 5-seater rooms with only coolers provided. The AC's are provided to only international students. The mess food is very bland. We have a dispensary with all facilities available. The classrooms are fully equipped, and libraries are well-built with proper infrastructure and Wi-Fi provided.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: Good placement and perfect study place.

review_content.Placements: In my course, approximately 85 percent of students get placed in various companies. The highest salary in previous years is 57LPA with a average package of 7LPA for general placements. Top recruiting companies are Adobe, ServiceNow, Microsoft etc.
review_content.Infrastructure: Top class infrastructure, clean and clear buildings with labs for each case/condition. Perfect space for letting our energy out. Wi-Fi facility, libraries in each building block. Canteens, food services, water supply at every end possible, Medical services available 24 hours and emergency services as well.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: Chandigarh University has strong placements, global exposure and industry ready learning.

review_content.Placements: Batch 2021 to 2025 has the highest placement record of around 90 to 95 percent. The highest package was around 1.7 crore per annum and the average package is around 8 to 10 LPA. Top recruiters are Microsoft, Cognizant, IBM etc. Top roles offered are Data Analyst and AI and ML.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure has developed a lot from previous times to the current time like including multipurpose rooms, Apple Labs, and IoT Labs. The facilities in the hostels are quite impressive with washing machines on each floor and the mess is clean too. The games and sports are organized every year. People from other universities even come to participate in these sports.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Com. (Hons.) in Advanced Cost & Management Accounting (ITP) - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: There are many cafe areas on the campus. Scholarship structure is also very good.

review_content.Placements: Mostly students from the previous batch have been placed in good companies. They get a package above 3.5 LPA. Many opportunities are available because they organize many competitions you can be part of the event committee too. Overall good opportunity .
review_content.Infrastructure: A fully Wi-Fi campus is provided. Hostels are good, and my department classes also have air conditioning. You have options for both attached and common washrooms. Great opportunity and all the hostels also have stocked shops from where you can buy daily use things.

review_summary.college_name: Chandigarh University (CU) Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Satisfied with the curriculum and placements, but lacks in infrastructure and teaching skills.

content.Placements: The percent of students who get placed in my course is quite decent. The highest package offered is 1.2 crores per annum. The average package offered ranges from 7-8 LPA, which is good. Top companies like EY, Adobe, and Flipkart visit the college every year. The internship ratio is not so good. Companies offer different roles and mainly focus on software engineers.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the course department and hostel is not up to date as there is much rush in the building every time. In hostels, there is no lift. There is a big line whenever we go to the mess. The quality of food is not up to the mark. It also provides us with Wi-Fi and medical facilities.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: No good return on investment in this university for all the students.

content.Placements: Almost 20% of students will get placed in 2025. The highest package is 1.7 crore, the average is around 6 LPA, and the lowest is 3 LPA. The top recruitment companies are TCS, Wipro, and Infosys. About internships, mostly good internships are available for students through off-campus placements, while very few students get on-campus internships. I have no idea about the top roles.
content.Infrastructure: Wifi speed is not very good, but can be said to be okay. Labs are decent, classrooms are not good; benches in the last rows are broken in many classrooms. The library is decent and provides an environment for studies. If someone's faculty is good, then he or she will get good marks in practicals, and if someone's is bad, then better luck next time.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Campus life & career-ready.

content.Placements: Around 60% of the students get placed per year. The placements kick start right from the 6th semester. My placements will start in Feb 2026. It depends on your skills, your personality, and your communication skills. The average package offered to CSE students is 8 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel facilities are not that good personally. The rooms are small, and all of them are either 4 or 5-seater rooms with only coolers provided. The AC's are provided to only international students. The mess food is very bland. We have a dispensary with all facilities available. The classrooms are fully equipped, and libraries are well-built with proper infrastructure and Wi-Fi provided.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Good placement and perfect study place.

content.Placements: In my course, approximately 85 percent of students get placed in various companies. The highest salary in previous years is 57LPA with a average package of 7LPA for general placements. Top recruiting companies are Adobe, ServiceNow, Microsoft etc.
content.Infrastructure: Top class infrastructure, clean and clear buildings with labs for each case/condition. Perfect space for letting our energy out. Wi-Fi facility, libraries in each building block. Canteens, food services, water supply at every end possible, Medical services available 24 hours and emergency services as well.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Chandigarh University has strong placements, global exposure and industry ready learning.

content.Placements: Batch 2021 to 2025 has the highest placement record of around 90 to 95 percent. The highest package was around 1.7 crore per annum and the average package is around 8 to 10 LPA. Top recruiters are Microsoft, Cognizant, IBM etc. Top roles offered are Data Analyst and AI and ML.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure has developed a lot from previous times to the current time like including multipurpose rooms, Apple Labs, and IoT Labs. The facilities in the hostels are quite impressive with washing machines on each floor and the mess is clean too. The games and sports are organized every year. People from other universities even come to participate in these sports.

faqs.answer: Yes, Chandigarh University conducts Chandigarh University Common Entrance Test (CUCET) for admission to all of its UG and PG courses. This is a common entrance exam that is applicable for admission of candidates in every stream such as Management, Humanities, Science, Commerce, Engineering, etc. To get admission to any of the courses offered at Chandigarh University, students have to apply for this exam on the official website of CUCET and appear for the exam. This exam is conducted in an online mode in two phases. For admission to any of the courses, there are two decisive factors that are considered by the university for admission. These are eligibility criteria and CUCET scores.

highlights: Good Power Supply: The hostel has a 24*7 power supply with a supportive power backup for the smooth functioning of the regular tasks and activities.

Free Wi-Fi Internet Services: Hostels are provided with free Wi-Fi services with good speed. The internet services are easily accessible with login credentials provided to students staying in the hostel rooms.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the curriculum and placements, but lacks in infrastructure and teaching skills.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the course department and hostel is not up to date as there is much rush in the building every time. In hostels, there is no lift. There is a big line whenever we go to the mess. The quality of food is not up to the mark. It also provides us with Wi-Fi and medical facilities.

reviews.review_heading: No good return on investment in this university for all the students.
reviews.review_text: Wifi speed is not very good, but can be said to be okay. Labs are decent, classrooms are not good; benches in the last rows are broken in many classrooms. The library is decent and provides an environment for studies. If someone's faculty is good, then he or she will get good marks in practicals, and if someone's is bad, then better luck next time.

reviews.review_heading: Campus life & career-ready.
reviews.review_text: The hostel facilities are not that good personally. The rooms are small, and all of them are either 4 or 5-seater rooms with only coolers provided. The AC's are provided to only international students. The mess food is very bland. We have a dispensary with all facilities available. The classrooms are fully equipped, and libraries are well-built with proper infrastructure and Wi-Fi provided.

reviews.review_heading: Good placement and perfect study place.
reviews.review_text: Top class infrastructure, clean and clear buildings with labs for each case/condition. Perfect space for letting our energy out. Wi-Fi facility, libraries in each building block. Canteens, food services, water supply at every end possible, Medical services available 24 hours and emergency services as well.

reviews.review_heading: Chandigarh University has strong placements, global exposure and industry ready learning.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure has developed a lot from previous times to the current time like including multipurpose rooms, Apple Labs, and IoT Labs. The facilities in the hostels are quite impressive with washing machines on each floor and the mess is clean too. The games and sports are organized every year. People from other universities even come to participate in these sports.

reviews.review_heading: There are many cafe areas on the campus. Scholarship structure is also very good.
reviews.review_text: A fully Wi-Fi campus is provided. Hostels are good, and my department classes also have air conditioning. You have options for both attached and common washrooms. Great opportunity and all the hostels also have stocked shops from where you can buy daily use things.

reviews.review_heading: Indias No. 1 private university in 2023.
reviews.review_text: Good and well structured campus Wi-Fi is available. Good and decent classrooms well resource library with Wi-Fi. Good but not like it is okay, not that bad. We have a separate sports complex. Good and healthy mess food with tasty canteen food.

reviews.review_heading: Good campus life, decent placements, and nice infrastructure are available for CSE at CU.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of Chandigarh University is actually very good. The campus is fully Wi-Fi enabled. Classrooms are smart, and labs have proper systems. CSE labs are good and mostly updated. The central library is big and well-maintained with enough books and online resources. Hostel facilities are decent. Rooms are clean, and security is good. Mess food is average, sometimes good, and sometimes not so good. Many food courts are there, so students manage them. Medical facilities are available o...

reviews.review_heading: Amazing campus, great experience.
reviews.review_text: The hostel service is not good personally, as there are only 4 seater rooms with no AC option. The mess food I do not like at all. The campus is good no doubt and hostels are located inside the campus only. The course structure is also good. It includes appropriate time management.

reviews.review_heading: Great placements and excellent academics, highly recommend for engineering students.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure here is quite well-maintained and modern. The computer labs where I study have decent systems with the latest software and programming tools. We use them regularly for coding assignments. The classrooms have projectors and audio systems. The library is spacious with good books and computers. Wi-Fi is available throughout campus. Hostel facilities are good with proper rooms and maintenance. The mess food quality is average but the quantity is sufficient. Medical facilities with...

reviews.review_heading: Please do not take admission in this college. This college is full of enjoyment.
reviews.review_text: Classroom, Wi-Fi labs and library of the Chandigarh University are very bad. All bad types of words are used, and also hostel quality of food available in the mess and canteen is just like poison. Medicine and medical facilities from these names gave only paracetamol to the student and did not have any sport chance and games.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is well maintained good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The institute maintain well define hostel facilities. Wi-Fi facilities and good food for the students and even though the course and hostel are well maintained and eco friendly and greenery is everywhere in the campus and student enjoy the fun fountain area par.

reviews.review_heading: College is below average, so do not expect much more from this college.
reviews.review_text: If you are going for CSE, then do not expect much from the infrastructure and college life. There is a huge crowd in CSE, so the infrastructure gets compromised. Hostel facilities are 4/5. The mess food is a little above average. If you come from a middle-class family, you should go for a 5-seater non-AC.

reviews.review_heading: The place of setting future.
reviews.review_text: The food and hostel and its infrastructure are great. A new hostel work is going on and the rooms here are amazing as they have facilities like a bed, almirah, desk, chair and etc. The message food is amazing. Its enough for surviving the 4 years of BE here.

reviews.review_heading: I do not regret taking admission here, and it is very good.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, labs, and the library are all top-notch. It is very clean and very good. All facilities, hostels, and food availability are good. It is clean, and the medical facilities are also very well-maintained and good. Sports can be played every day. Every part of the campus is cleaned, including the washrooms. There is a canteen everywhere.

paragraphs: Chandigarh University offers different merit and need-based scholarships to students of UG and PG levels. CUCET aims to uphold Chandigarh University’s mission of offering accessible and affordable education. The test is designed to reduce financial barriers for students. With up to 100% scholarships and financial support through the test, it encourages academic brilliance, attracts motivated students, and fosters an inclusive environment conducive to learning and personal growth.

CU Mohali has committed up to INR 210 crores in scholarships, INR 170 crores for the CU Punjab campus and INR 40 crores for the CU Uttar Pradesh Campus. It provides a pathway to exceptional educational and career opportunities, rewarding high-performing students and granting access to diverse, competitive programs across disciplines. There are several scholarships for reserved category students, wards of defense personnel, and early bird admission scholarships along with teaching assistantships in the form of stipends offered at CU.

reviews_list.review_title: Good placements, infrastructure, faculty members, and best people.

review_content.Placements: 100% placements are offered. The placement committee works hard to ensure every student is placed. No forced opt-out like in a lot of IIMs and private colleges. Quality of placement with respect to marketing is great. You get exposure to good roles in good companies in both internships and final placements. Companies do trust and respect the MICAN edge.
review_content.Infrastructure: Hostels are a little old, no AC in rooms (but that also leads to people changing out in common places a lot instead of just staying in your AC room), and sometimes the wall falls if you close the door strongly. But beautiful campus you will wake up to peacocks and langoors. MICAN walks are to die for. The place is a lake in monsoon. New hostels are being constructed so let's see how that turns out.

review_summary.college_name: MICA Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Life opportunities and exposure at MICA.

content.Placements: At MICA, the whole batch was placed on time without any cap or anything. We saw a good rise in the average stipend for this year and it was the best as compared to the history of MICA. Though we are not allowed to share specific details I can just assure you that at MICA, you will get the best of the best marketing roles in the best of the best companies like HUL, ITC, Google, IBM, Amul, etc.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities that we get on campus are great, we have everything essential that is needed. Moreover, one thing that makes the place even better is the culture that mica holds. We have various events in place and best of the best cultural and marketing fest as well.

individual_reviews.course: Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) - Batch of 2016
individual_reviews.title: Our college provides excellent placements and wonderful teaching.

content.Placements: The placement process went quite smoothly and efficiently in our batch. Almost 90% of the batch got a job through the campus placement process. The top recruiting companies were ITC, Tata Group, Reliance Industries, Nestle, etc. The highest salary package offered was 12 LPA, and the average salary package offered is 6 LPA. The lowest salary package offered was 3.5 LPA. Almost 99% of the batch managed to get internships in similar organisations.
content.Infrastructure: Our college has a well-maintained infrastructure facility that consists of the college building, classrooms, laboratories, and canteen. The mess and canteen food are hygienic and affordable. The hostel facility is also maintained properly and all the rooms are neat and clean. There is an encouragement given to and special provisions for sports activities too.

individual_reviews.course: PGDM in Communications - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Good placements, infrastructure, faculty members, and best people.

content.Placements: 100% placements are offered. The placement committee works hard to ensure every student is placed. No forced opt-out like in a lot of IIMs and private colleges. Quality of placement with respect to marketing is great. You get exposure to good roles in good companies in both internships and final placements. Companies do trust and respect the MICAN edge.
content.Infrastructure: Hostels are a little old, no AC in rooms (but that also leads to people changing out in common places a lot instead of just staying in your AC room), and sometimes the wall falls if you close the door strongly. But beautiful campus you will wake up to peacocks and langoors. MICAN walks are to die for. The place is a lake in monsoon. New hostels are being constructed so let's see how that turns out.

individual_reviews.course: Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: I am very satisfied with the course.

content.Placements: There were 100% placements in MICA. About 88 companies participated in campus placements. The average salary package offered here was about 14 LPA. Companies like Lenskart, Aditya Birla, IBM, Mahindra Rise, Raymond, etc., hired students from here. For internships, the average stipend offered was Rs. 80,000 per month.
content.Infrastructure: In-campus residential facilities are provided to students, and the facilities are good here. Our campus is extremely good. It has been designed to provide an experience to students. Our campus has Wi-Fi facilities for students so that they can learn at their convenience.

individual_reviews.course: Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: The university provides great knowledge.

content.Placements: Above 80% of the students got placed in our course. In our course, the highest salary package offered is 58 LPA, the lowest salary package offered is 17 LPA and the average salary package offered is 43 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Google, IBM, ICICI Bank, Beiersdorf, BBH, Kotak Mahindra Bank, Casio, Intel, Cactus and Mahindra Rise. Top roles offered to the students are project manager, brand strategist, brand manager and cloud consultant.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is well-managed part of the institution that has been raised to give the best learning experience to the students. It is the perfect example of technology evolved to benefit the needs and comfort of the students. All the blocks are Wi-Fi enabled to help students learn not only through books and lectures but also through an open-source of knowledge.

reviews.review_heading: Life opportunities and exposure at MICA.
reviews.review_text: The facilities that we get on campus are great, we have everything essential that is needed. Moreover, one thing that makes the place even better is the culture that mica holds. We have various events in place and best of the best cultural and marketing fest as well.

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides excellent placements and wonderful teaching.
reviews.review_text: Our college has a well-maintained infrastructure facility that consists of the college building, classrooms, laboratories, and canteen. The mess and canteen food are hygienic and affordable. The hostel facility is also maintained properly and all the rooms are neat and clean. There is an encouragement given to and special provisions for sports activities too.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements, infrastructure, faculty members, and best people.
reviews.review_text: Hostels are a little old, no AC in rooms (but that also leads to people changing out in common places a lot instead of just staying in your AC room), and sometimes the wall falls if you close the door strongly. But beautiful campus you will wake up to peacocks and langoors. MICAN walks are to die for. The place is a lake in monsoon. New hostels are being constructed so let's see how that turns out.

reviews.review_heading: I am very satisfied with the course.
reviews.review_text: In-campus residential facilities are provided to students, and the facilities are good here. Our campus is extremely good. It has been designed to provide an experience to students. Our campus has Wi-Fi facilities for students so that they can learn at their convenience.

reviews.review_heading: The university provides great knowledge.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is well-managed part of the institution that has been raised to give the best learning experience to the students. It is the perfect example of technology evolved to benefit the needs and comfort of the students. All the blocks are Wi-Fi enabled to help students learn not only through books and lectures but also through an open-source of knowledge.

reviews.review_heading: MICA = 100% Placements With Best Packages.
reviews.review_text: The campus of MICA is very good. Institute provides all the facilities to the students. One can truly enjoy the environment of MICA. Quality of the facilities in the hostel at our time was good. I had never experienced any major problem on the campus in terms of facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Review of MICA- The School of Ideas.
reviews.review_text: MICA has a world-class pedagogy which ensures that students are equipped with a competitive skill set. This pedagogy is supported by robust infrastructure. Classrooms are equipped with high tech aids which ensures effective learning. The MICA campus is 24x7 Wi-Fi enabled. KEIC is the knowledge centre of MICA and provides around the clock resources for the community. Hostel culture at MICA is probably the best in India.

reviews.review_heading: MICA is a cultural college.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are well furnished, and we have 24hours library facility with a load of books. The hostels are very warming and like home. Mess food is one of the best in India. Moreover, Sports is a top priority here. The infrastructure is very nice as the hostels are made like courtyards.

reviews.review_heading: MICA's is great but some place its weaker than other IIM like that of finance.
reviews.review_text: Mica is known for its unique infrastructure and pedagogy. The culture here is set parallel to its infra. Campus is surrounded with lush green trees and around 1000+ trees are planted here. Wi-Fi facilities are up to the mark and library is known as Keic centre which is one of the best among indian b-schools. Mica is well known for its sports facilities and chotha canteen which sets apart its creative culture.

reviews.review_heading: This place helps you understand humanity over ruthless competition.
reviews.review_text: Hostels are meant to keep the students close to NIT, and you will value the way they were built if you spend some days there. The mess is the best one that you'd find in any college. Even a doctor visits the campus daily. The library is a blessing for students, and it is equipped with all the books that a student needs. The college is strong with its sports culture, and there are dedicated courts for volleyball, frisbee, football, lawn tennis, table tennis, basketball, and cricket, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Excellent course curriculum and fay.
reviews.review_text: The quality of infrastructure here is excellent. The library is open 24*7 and has a wide variety of books. The mess food is good. MiCA is a sports lover's paradise. Name a sport, and it's played here, starting from Tennis to football to basketball to chess, to name just a few.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied because of great placements, infrastructure and faculty members.
reviews.review_text: MICA is known for its creativity, so the infrastructure also reflects this. The infrastructure is well-built with all the latest facilities like Wi-Fi and projectors in classrooms, etc. We are not facing any issues regarding the infrastructure.

reviews.review_heading: One of it's kind campus with absolutely diverse and unique students.
reviews.review_text: Amazing. Truly one of its kind. The architecture, the graffiti, the greenness sets it apart. The graffiti leaves the visitors stunned and makes them go wow. The campus has a very homely feel to it. Classrooms are fully equipped with modern technology and the Audi is legendary.

reviews.review_heading: Amazing Campus Life at MICA.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are good here in terms of infrastructure. Classrooms are spacious. Auditorium is a little uncomfortable though. Hostel rooms are pretty comfortable too. Wi-Fi connectivity is fine. No major problems faced as such. Medical facilities could be better.

reviews.review_heading: The college provided the best summer internship opportunities in 2018.
reviews.review_text: MICA's landscape is breathtaking and beautiful. The campus has a lot of greenery and looks nothing short of a resort. All the blocks, fields and buildings in MICA have the top-notch modern infrastructure, facilities, furniture etc. They are up-to-date and high-fi. The campus is Wi-fi enabled and its connectivity is good.

college_info.intro:
IIM Sambalpur gives PG, doctoral, and MDP programmes to students in the field of Management. The programmes given at IIM Sambalpur are MBA, PhD, E-PhD, E-MBA, and MDP, etc. The duration of the course ranges from 2 years to 5 years. Out of all these, the MBA programme is the famous programme of IIM Sambalpur.
The MBA programme offered at the institute is a full-time, residential programme offered for a duration of two years. The IIM Sambalpur MBA curriculum incorporates a blended learning method which comprises a combination of online and traditional teaching methods. The institute also organises live projects, internships, and various other activities to expose students to the professional world. The MBA programme is also popular among students for its good placement numbers. In 2024, the highest package offered to the MBA students stood at INR 23.5 LPA. faqs.answer: The answer to this question of whether an average student can get into IIM can be both yes and no depending on the definition of an average student.Based on Academics (Class 10/ Class 12/ Graduation): While a student with average scores in Class 10, Class 12 and graduation with a good CAT score certainly has good chances of getting a call from IIM-A, chances are less for someone with an average CAT score.Based on student category (General or Reserved): While it is tough for a General category average student to grab a seat at IIM due to high score requirements, a reserved category student can get admission being at average scores as well.Based on past work experience, diversity and other factors: Gender and academic diversity is also a factor on which students are shortlisted at IIM. IIMs judge the past academic category based on the degree obtained by the students before MBA and then a weightage is allotted based on that. For Engineers, the percentage for scoring the highest marks is higher as compared with other streamsPerformance in selection rounds: Once you make it to the final selection rounds, i.e., AWT/PI process, it can be considered a fresh start. At this stage, students can forget their past average-ness but definitely require good grasp over the past subjects as academics-related questions are asked in the interview.Based on the above factors, it can be considered that while getting into top Management institutes, such as IIM is extremely tough, the past performance, CAT performance, student category and a lot of factors can be the reasons for a student to receive that final call.

IIM Sambalpur is known for its academic programmes, experienced faculties, and excellent placements. IIM Sambalpur usually records a 100% placement rate. The highest package stood at INR 23.5 LPA for the IIM Sambalpur placements 2024.

individual_reviews.title: My honest review about my college.

content.Placements: More than 90% of the students are offered internships at our college. I am currently pursuing my summer marketing internship at ElasticRun. Placements are very good for our batch and seniors as well. Almost 100% of the students got placed in our college. All the major MNCs and technical firms along with a string of FMCG companies visited our campus for placements. Campus placement is good as many companies come up with different roles for the batch.
content.Infrastructure: There is no hostel at the college as they are under construction. Canteen food is very cheap and hygienic. The overall fee is also very less and affordable for every section of society.

placement_data.title: IIM Sambalpur Placement Overview 2025
paragraphs: The highest package offered and secured during IIM Sambalpur placement 2025 for the MBA program stood at INR 48.6 LPA and INR 32.95 LPA , respectively. Average and median package received by the MBA batch of 2023-25 was INR 15.65 LPA and INR 15.02 LPA . Female students received average package of INR 15.43 LPA whereas it was INR 15.23 LPA for Male students. A total of 216 companies visited the campus out of which 144 were new recruiters . Companies such as Accenture, Amazon, KPMG and many more visit the campus during the placement drive 2025. The General Management followed by Finance, Sales & Marketing and Consulting emerged as the top domains in 2025 with placement distribution of 28%, 17%, 14% and 12%, respectively.

The MBA batch of 2023-25 comprised 314 students. Out of the total students, 59% were female students and 41% were male students. 43% of the MBA batch was in the Fresher category whereas the remaining 57% of the batch had some years of work experience. Other than this, 53% of the MBA students were from BTech background whereas 15%, 13%, 9% and 6% students came from Commerce, Science, Business Administration and Arts background.
