review_summary.college_name: IIM Jammu Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Integrated Program in Management (IPM) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: IIM Jammu review - The best place for holistic development.

content.Placements: 100% of the students of IPM get a social internship and a corporate internship in reputed companies. Companies such as The Leela, Microsoft, and Shopper Stop have been the prominent recruiters. The highest stipend stood at Rs. 50,000, while the average stood at Rs. 28,000. (Information according to the official placement reports, IPM Batch 2021-26. )
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is available throughout the campus, and we have a state-of-the-art library with e-library access as well. There's an infirmary on our campus where 24-hour nursing staff is available, and a doctor is available every weekday. We also have our own ambulance and wheelchair. The mess facilities are amazing as well because they are student-run, and our friends and our batch mates are a part of it. So, we are always heard, and it makes an impact.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: My review about this college.

content.Placements: The placements are good compared to several other B-schools. Currently, the average package is 23.2 LPA with a 100% placement rate. From semester 3 onwards students become eligible for the placement process. The prominent recruiters include Citi Bank, ICICI Bank, Amazon, Flipkart, Reliance, LG, Relax, Morgan Stanley, Media. Net, Loreal, etc., are the regular recruiting companies. The students get an opportunity to choose the domain according to their interests. The highest package goes to around 18 LPA and the average is 9.5 LPA. I am aspiring to become an entrepreneur and start my venture after getting the degree.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: It's a massive and wonderful experience there.

content.Placements: Over 91% of students are placed in our department. Many are placed in large recruitment agencies. The maximum salary offered will be 25 LPA, and the minimum salary will be 10 LPA. The average salary was around 17 LPA. Many big companies like TCS, Google, Infosys, HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, and Cognizant come to recruit students. Nearly 84% of students received internships in various industries. The top roles offered in my course are marketing manager, financial analyst, and human resources manager, etc.
content.Infrastructure: My college infrastructure is very wonderful. The course has state-of-the-art infrastructure such as classrooms with Wi-Fi, state-of-the-art laboratories, a well-equipped library, and access to online databases. The rooms have all the necessary facilities. Food is designed to keep you healthy. The college has adequate medical facilities and facilities for sports.

individual_reviews.course: Integrated Program in Management (IPM) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: IIM IN PARADISE: Indian Institute of Management, Jammu.

content.Placements: There is surety of 100% placement for the MBA as well as for the SIP during various courses. The placements are also in highly branded and value companies. However, the IPM programme which offers social and corporate internships provides an opportunity equal to the MBA course.
content.Infrastructure: The new Jagti campus is huge and highly oriented for students comfort and safety. Even though it is still in construction, basic facilities are well provided. Whereas, the CRC campus is cozy yet, a bit behind in infrastructure. Canal Road campus is totally IPM-oriented.

individual_reviews.course: Integrated Program in Management (IPM) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: A good college to experience real college life.

content.Placements: 100 percent of placements were done in IIM Jammu, and the highest package for the last batch was INR 64 lacs per annum, and the average package was INR 16.5 lacs per annum. The top recruiting companies were Aditya Birla Group, cognizant, ICICI Bank, Capgemini, Accenture, etc.
content.Infrastructure: In IIM Jammu, we have good infrastructure facilities that are well sufficient on both the permanent campus and the current campus. We have a library, basketball court, volleyball court, badminton court, and many indoor sports facilities. The food is just like the average hostel, and hostels are fine.

paragraphs: IIM Jammu admission 2025to itsflagship MBA/ PGPcourse is done through CAT. Indian Institute of Management (IIM), Jammu offers five courses in Management from the postgraduate level to the Doctoral level including two integrated courses. Apart from MBA-PGP, IIM Jammu also accepts CAT scores for admission to its Executive MBA and PhD courses. For IIM Jammu IPM admissions, students must appear for JIPMAT conducted by NTA.IIM Jammualso offers a dual degree programme in collaboration with IIT Jammu combining BTech and MBA. Go through the article to know about courses, selection criteria, eligibility and other admission related information for the institute.

Candidates seeking admission must meet the IIM Jammu eligibility criteria of the desired course and should have a valid score card of the entrance exam accepted for admission to the desired programme. However, candidates seeking admission to the Full-time PhD programme of IIM Jammu need not appear for any entrance exam if they have a postgraduate degree in management from any of the IIMs with a minimum 6.0 CGPA. The candidate can apply directly to the programme and appear for the personal interview round if shortlisted.
Admission Process 2025 for IIM Jammu is elaborated below:

1.Apply to the desired programme with relevant details and documents by visiting the official website of IIM Jammu, www.iimj.ac.in/. In the case of an MBA, candidates are only required to register at the official website of CAT, iimcat.ac.in.
2.Appear for the entrance exam required for the desired programme. The candidates need to meet the cut-off of that programme released by IIM Jammu.
3.After getting shortlisted on the basis of performance in the entrance exam, the candidates need to appear for a Personal Interview round.

4.A final Merit list for admission offers is prepared by IIM Jammu after all the selection rounds are over, taking into consideration various components such as academic profile, work experience, performance in the entrance exam, Gender and more.
5.The last step after receiving the admission offer is to pay the acceptance fee within the stipulated time to confirm the admission.

description: IIM Jammu cutoff 2024 is available on this page for MBA/PGDM courses. Candidates can refer to the exam-wise sections below to view the IIM Jammu CAT cutoff 2024 across different courses and categories. Further updates related to CAT 2025 are provided below:

IIM Jammu CAT cutoff 2024 is based on candidates' performance in the entrance exam, followed by other parameters, including academic background, quality of work experience etc. The institute releases two types of CAT cutoffs, namely the Qualifying CAT cutoff and the Final CAT cutoff. Securing a minimum qualifying cutoff means that the candidate is eligible to get an interview call for WAT/ PI. Also, the IIM Jammu final CAT cutoff is always higher than the qualifying cutoff for admission.

IIM Jammu admission to management courses is based on valid CAT scores. For IIM Jammu MBA admission, students need to meet both the overall CAT cutoff percentile and the sectional cutoffs. The Institute does not release CAT cutoffs in the public domain and is exclusively accessible only via account login to candidates who have appeared for the exam. However, candidates can refer to the table below to check out the IIM Jammu CAT cutoff year-wise percentile for admission to the management courses.

reviews.review_heading: IIM Jammu review - The best place for holistic development.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available throughout the campus, and we have a state-of-the-art library with e-library access as well. There's an infirmary on our campus where 24-hour nursing staff is available, and a doctor is available every weekday. We also have our own ambulance and wheelchair. The mess facilities are amazing as well because they are student-run, and our friends and our batch mates are a part of it. So, we are always heard, and it makes an impact.

reviews.review_heading: My review about this college.
reviews.review_text: The course here represented to us is new and also according to today's need for the student to go on further in their future. Individual air-conditioned rooms are allotted to students. The mess menu is managed by the mess committee and covers cuisines of different types. Food quality is very good as compared to what one usually gets in hostels. Almost every facility is there and is well-maintained the hostel has reasonable charges that must be affordable.

reviews.review_heading: It's a massive and wonderful experience there.
reviews.review_text: My college infrastructure is very wonderful. The course has state-of-the-art infrastructure such as classrooms with Wi-Fi, state-of-the-art laboratories, a well-equipped library, and access to online databases. The rooms have all the necessary facilities. Food is designed to keep you healthy. The college has adequate medical facilities and facilities for sports.

reviews.review_heading: IIM IN PARADISE: Indian Institute of Management, Jammu.
reviews.review_text: The new Jagti campus is huge and highly oriented for students comfort and safety. Even though it is still in construction, basic facilities are well provided. Whereas, the CRC campus is cozy yet, a bit behind in infrastructure. Canal Road campus is totally IPM-oriented.

reviews.review_heading: A good college to experience real college life.
reviews.review_text: In IIM Jammu, we have good infrastructure facilities that are well sufficient on both the permanent campus and the current campus. We have a library, basketball court, volleyball court, badminton court, and many indoor sports facilities. The food is just like the average hostel, and hostels are fine.

reviews.review_heading:
Life at a baby IIM - IIM Jammu 
.
reviews.review_text: The main campus of IIM Jammu which is located in Jagti, Jammu is not fully constructed and only MBA students stay there however IPM students stay in Canal Road Campus, Jammu. In Jagti, for MBA individual rooms are available with ACs however in CRC there are 3 to 4 girls allocated for one room. Wi-fi is provided 24/7 with optimism speed. Classrooms can easily accommodate 90 students, have well functioning projectors, charging point, speakers etc. The library is also open 24/7 where students can b...

reviews.review_heading: I love this institute and it is perhaps the best thing for me.
reviews.review_text: Once students start offline classes they will be getting into the new campus. It has all the facilities including Wi-Fi, laboratories, library, etc. It provides double-sharing hostel rooms. I have not get a chance to taste hostel's food, but seniors have never complained about it. Apart from these, it has a canteen and all other facilities.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good place to pursue an MBA. Our college has a lot of clubs and committees.
reviews.review_text: Currently, our college is operating on a temporary campus. Our college will shift to a permanent campus in 2022 or 2021. There are good infrastructure and very engaging facilities. Our college has all the needed amenities. It is a easily reachable place in Jammu, and we can reach the campus in 15 minutes from railway station and airport.

reviews.review_heading: Institute is good and has a good hostel life.
reviews.review_text: Sports and game facilities are awesome. There are various  sports competitions held. Infrastructure and facilities of course/department is superb. Currently IIM Jammu has a temporary campus, so permanent campus would be built in 4-5 years. Hostel and mess facilities are good.

reviews.review_heading: I am dissatisfied because of the online mode of teaching.
reviews.review_text: Since due to COVID situation we are not able to reach campus, but we have a Transit Campus right now, wherein 3 students are sharing a single room. The access to all the resources is made available, and also a hard copy of study materials reached our home for the first trimester.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with the institute till now.
reviews.review_text: Till now we haven't visited the campus. The support from the library and IT department are good. The gym was recently renovated, and we have a badminton court, cricket field and a basketball court. Accommodation is offered on double sharing basis.

reviews.review_heading: If you are not getting any new IIM and don't want to take a drop, then do join here.
reviews.review_text: The institute is currently running from a non-permanent campus in Jammu city. But we get every possible facility. The mess and hostel quality is also good. The hostel is on twin share. We get almost every necessary equipment to play on the campus.

reviews.review_heading: IIM Jammu is one of the best among young IIMs.
reviews.review_text: Currently, IIM Jammu is on the temporary campus, which is around 5 kilometres radius from airport, railway station and bus stand. Still, we have a quite good campus. Our college provides all the games to play, gym and double sharing rooms. The permanent campus is supposed to be ready by 2022, which is far better than older IIMs in term of technology, etc.

reviews.review_heading: IIM Jammu is the best institute of management in India.
reviews.review_text: Facilities available in our institute are very good. The library has around 37,000 business books, other knowledge books, E-books and all online access. Classrooms are well-designed in a professional manner. Air-conditioners and projectors are available in classrooms. The canteen is available in the centre of campus.

reviews.review_heading: This college has the potential to become one of the leading schools in our country in future.
reviews.review_text: All the required facilities are available in the hostel, including geysers, etc. The quality of the food served is also good. There are gyms, playgrounds and other facilities too. Medical facilities are also available, and various Intra Institute Events also take place.

review_content.Placements: Our college has had 100% placements in our college for the last three years. The highest salary package that was offered to us was 45 LPA, the lowest salary package was 5 LPA, and the average salary package was 3.25 LPA. The top recruiting companies in our college include Microsoft, Google, Big Data, Accenture, Infosys, etc. Almost every student from our course got an internship in their domain.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure in our college was fabulous. The facilities in our college, like labs, classrooms, and libraries, are the best. But as it is situated on the mountain, we have to face some issues regarding the mobile network and Wi-Fi. They are also not so good. The hostel was good and all the other facilities were excellent, but there was a little issue with the water supply as the college was situated in the mountains. There is also a little problem with accommodation outside the campus, as very little accommodation was available for a huge crowd of students, which resulted in increased charges for accommodation.

review_content.Placements: UPES is a good college, and it offers a lot of specializations in different branches. Placements in our college are quite low from 2018 onwards. UPES offers 45% placements for students. But the college fee is so much that the middle-class family can't afford to invest for their children.
review_content.Infrastructure: I am staying in a private hostel, which has a good ambience for study. The infrastructure of our college is good, and it offers many courses. There are 2 labs for automotive engineering where we learn about all the components of vehicles starting from chassis to powertrain. Wi-Fi speed is not so good. Labs have a good range of equipment. Our campus has 3-floors library with a good sitting space. Quite interesting books are available in the library, and we can utilise our quality time.

review_content.Placements: The placements are good on the campus. Almost 88% of the students got placed on the campus. The average salary package was around 4.5 LPA. Around 2-3 students get paid internship, and the rest of them have to manage their own. The college sends your name for an internship for two months, but it is not paid internship as you just get training in the different sectors but a few of them get paid. Overall, the internship placing is 100%.
review_content.Infrastructure: The whole campus is enabled with the Wi-Fi facility. The classrooms are well-designed. The greenery environment surrounding the campus is one of the best things. The labs are well-designed, and there are separate departments for each course. There is a medical facility within the campus which is 24-hours ready to serve you. There are two food courts in the college, which serves the quality food of Chinese and South Indian. There is a little rush in ATM as there is a sort of money many times in which I disappointment a little, and rest all the things are good.

reviews_list.batch_info: - Batch of 2018
reviews_list.review_title: Overall the development of the students is good whereas the placements are above average.

review_content.Placements: During the 3rd year, all the students will get the internship in reputed companies across the country, which gives industrial exposure to students. Moreover, it helps the students to understand and correlate the industrial problems and work with their studies. There are many reputed companies visited the campus for placements during the 7th semester, and around 50% student got placed in 7th semester itself. The rest of the students are placed during the 8th semester. There are 28 out of 37 students got placed during the campus placements whereas four students opted out from placement process and gone for higher studies.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Geo Science Engineering - Batch of 2021
reviews_list.review_title: Nice faculty and decent infrastructure.

review_content.Placements: The placements here at UPES are fine around 80 percent of the students in our senior batches are placed in well reputed companies. The highest package that is offered to a geo Science student is around 12 to 14 Lacs and the lowest is around 3 Lacs to a student.
review_content.Infrastructure: The college has its own Wi-Fi named UPESNET. The labs here have a separate department named as R&D department where are the labs are present. Here the canteen is fine with hygienic food and the classrooms are big enough for 70 students and we have a huge library of 3 floors.

reviews_list.batch_info: - Batch of 2018
reviews_list.review_title: Dissatisfied because of the faculty, placements, and the subjects were entirely different.

review_content.Placements: This college has fine placements, and the highest package is 8 LPA from our branch. Vedanta, Balaji constructions, SGX minerals, everyone got the internship, and it is not a paid internship. There is a placement cell, its actually good career service providers, and there is no senior batch as we are the first batch.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is good, but the college is not in according to the department wise. The labs are good, and there is a biggest playground. The food is good, and the hostels are well cleaned and maintained, I didn't feel any infrastructure issues, and there should be more labs. There are many labs with the good infrastructure, and I just thought there should be departments.

overview_faqs.question: What are the fee refund rules at UPES Dehradun?
overview_faqs.answer: In UPES Dehradun, fees once paid will be fully refunded, with a deduction of INR 1,000 for processing charges if a withdrawal request is made before the session starts. In case a withdrawal application is made after the commencement of classes, fees will be refunded after a deduction along with a deduction of INR 1000 towards processing charges. The fee shall be refunded within 90 days of the start of the academic session if the refund application is submitted before the start of the session.

Engineering students are offered good placement opportunities by market leaders. Also, the university provides scholarships to Engineering and various other course students.

review_summary.college_name: UPES Dehradun Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Applied Petroleum Engineering (Intelligent Petroleum Systems) - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely I am satisfied because of good culture, faculty, and good placement in 2025.

content.Placements: About 95 percent of students are placed in the year 2025, the highest package is about 35 LPA, the average is about 11 LPA, and the top recruiters for our branch are Cairn Oil & Gas, Vedanta Ltd, ONGC, Adani Gas, HP, Oil India Limited, GAIL, and many more.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure are good, we have a common library, the campus is divided into blocks in which classes are conducted, sports facilities are also good, the college hostel has a limited number of seats so I would prefer an off-campus hostel, but the food in the campus is good.

individual_reviews.course: MBA in Finance Management - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Knowledgeable faculty and support.

content.Placements: 99% are placed. 6 LPA is the lowest package, and 33 LPA is the highest, but placement records are good, and everyone is getting placements somewhere else, and students are also supportive. Zepto, blinkit, EY, KPMG ITC, Indigo, Aadani Airpot, ONGC and all are recruiting. 100% got internships. Manager and Consulting roles are offered. placements are also good.
content.Infrastructure: Everything has Wi-Fi, a good connection, good college life and a view. Hostel life is amazing and has to be seen, and the night view and jamming sessions are the point of attraction.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. (Hons.) in Computer Science and Engineering (Cyber Security and Digital Forensics) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: The college can improve on the placement records.

content.Placements: A smaller number of student placement records have been shown this year, and I heard about the fact that Microsoft banned this college from entering for placements due to an internal issue. The placements average at 7 to 10LPA, that too if you are qualified with a good amount of knowledge in the field.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities are fair, sports facilities can be improved, and there are frequent Wi-Fi problems. I went inside the on campus hostel and noticed the rooms are smaller but ventilated well with a good mess. There needs to be more events based on communities outside the college.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. (Hons.) in Computer Science and Engineering (Cloud Computing and Virtualization Technology) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Career prospects are strong, though classrooms can feel average.

content.Placements: UPES has excellent placement opportunities, especially in CSE. Around 90-95% students are placed with the highest package going above 50 LPA, and the average is 8 LPA. Opportunities are there, but for top performers. Core roles are limited, and many companies offer mass recruitment profiles.
content.Infrastructure: UPES has one of the best infrastructures among private universities in India, but classrooms should have AC. Hostel and cafeteria are decent, the view from hostel is epic. Wi-Fi-enabled labs are advanced, well-stocked libraries. Sometimes you feel crowded in hostel.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. (Hons.) in Computer Science and Engineering (Graphics and Gaming) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Good infrastructure, overcrowded for B.Tech students, and placement is average.

content.Placements: I am in second year so no one is placed in my batch. But the senior gets package which is well and good. The highest package is around 60 LPA in my course, and average is 12 LPA. Some top recruiting companies are TCS, Microsoft, Amazon, and others. Internship is mandatory in our course so everyone gets an internship.
content.Infrastructure: Our college has all the facilities like Wi-Fi, computers, and labs. I live off campus so I don't have an idea of the hostel on campus. In sports, we have basketball, football, volleyball, badminton, cricket, and many others. We also have tournaments and all to encourage students.

faqs.question: How to get seat in UPES Dehradun?
faqs.answer: Students can check below the steps to get a seat at UPES Dehradun:Log on to the official website.Complete your application form online.The selection criteria is entrance/merit-based.Upon selected, pay the specified fee to confirm and secure your seat.

faqs.question: Which entrance exam is conducted by UPES?
faqs.answer: UPES Dehradun conducts its own entrance exams, such as UPESMET, UPESMET UG, UPESPAT, etc. for providing admission to specific courses. See the table below to know more about the university-level exams conducted for popular UPES courses:Course NameIn-house ExamsMBAUPESMETBTech/ BTech (Hons)UPESEATBBAUPESMET UGBPharmaUPESPAT

faqs.question: Can I get direct admission in School of Health Sciences and Technology, UPES?
faqs.answer: To get admission in School of Health Sciences and Technology, UPES candidates might have to complete multi-step process. Check below the admission steps for UPES:Application:The mode of application is online. The application fee for BTech, BPharma, MSc, and BSc is  INR 1,350 each.Selection rounds:The university conducts its own entrance exams for providing admission to specific courses. Apart from these, UPES Dehradun also accepts national-level entrance exams like CUET UG, NEET, JEE Main, etc.Admission confirmation:After completion of the selection rounds, the shortlisted candidates are called for verification of the documents. Aspirants need to pay course fee to confirm their seat in the university.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility criteria for BBA in UPES?
faqs.answer: Candidates after completing Class 10 and Class 12 with at least 50% aggregate can apply for the BBA course. The university offers BBA in 27 specialisations through the UPES School of Business. Some of the BBA specialisations, include Finance Management, Operations Management, Marketing Management and Human Resource, etc.Additionally,UPES Dehradun admissionto BBA course will be based on national and university-level entrance exams like UPESMET UG, UGAT or CUET UG followed by a personal interview round. Candidates must qualify the PI round for BBA courses under School of Modern Media. As soon as the selection rounds are over, candidates are called for document verification round. Shortlisted aspirants need to pay a course fee to confirm their seat. The total tuition fee for BBA ranges between INR 5.41 Lacs and INR 13.41 Lacs as per an unofficial source.

faqs.question: What is the fees for BBA in UPES University Dehradun?
faqs.answer: Total tuition fee for BBA ranges between INR 1.5 Lacs and INR 14 Lacs as per unofficial source. The fee excludes other fee components like caution deposit, exam fee, etc. Aspirants are required to pay course fee after completion of all selection rounds to confirm their seats. Selection to BBA course will be based on national and university level entrance exams like UPESMET UG, UGAT or CUET UG followed by a personal interview round. For admission to Global BBA, candidates need to qualify PI round and submit Statement of Purpose. If a student is unable to pay fee within given time, his or her admission will be cancelled. Students also need to pay registration fee through online mode to apply for admission. The application fee for UPESMET UG is INR 1,350.

faqs.question: What is the fees of UPES MBA?
faqs.answer: UPES MBA fee is between INR 1.5 lakh and INR 15.7 lakh as per an unofficial source. The fee is calculated based on tuition fee and does not includes other components. Students are required to pay course fee after completion of all selection rounds to confirm their seats. The selection to MBA course will be based on national and university level entrance exams like CAT, MAT, XAT, CMAT, UPESMET, etc., followed by group discussion and personal interview round. In case a candidate is unable to pay fee within the specified time, his or her admission will stand cancelled. Aspirants will also need to pay a registration fee to apply for admission. The application fee for MBA course is INR 1,350. They can pay the registration fee via any of online payment mode.

hostel.description: University of Petroleum and Energy Studies has separate hostel for boys and girls with a capacity of more than 2000 students at Bidholi and Kandoli campuses. All the hostels have wi fi facility for learning.Common room has been provided in each hostel for relaxation and 24*7 power back up and solar power water heaters facility is available.The hostels have mess facility.Air conditioned hostels are also available. UPES has also tied up with private hostels for girls students in the city to offer appropriate accommodation outside the campus. All accommodation is on a triple sharing basis.
facilities: Library: UPES library has a seating capacity of more than 400 students and contains over 73,327 volumes of publications including books, standards, reports, proceedings, and more than 150 national and international journals. It also has a rich collection of online resources in terms of CDs, access to specialised portals on oil and gas and power-related information

Hotels: UPES has a separate hostel for boys and girls with a capacity of more than 2000 students at the Bidholi and Kandoli campuses. All the hostels have a Wi-Fi facility for learning. A common room has been provided in each hostel for relaxation and a 24*7 power backup and solar power water heaters facility is available

Cafeteria: The university has a multi-storied food court within the campus, has a number of food courts and cafeterias with a modern ambiance to provide nutritious and balanced meals, snacks, and beverages to students of both campuses
Sports Complex: UPES has a multipurpose playground for playing hockey, cricket, football, and other sports with world-class sports facilities and equipment

library.description: UPES’s library has a seating capacity of more than 400 students and contains over 73,327 volumes of publications including books, standards, reports, proceedings and more than 150 National and International journals in the fields of petroleum exploration, power, infrastructure, chemical, computer, electrical, electronic and mechanical engineering, information technology and management, etc. It also has a rich collection of online resources in terms of CDs, access to specialized portals on oil and gas and power related information. UPES has also acquired institutional memberships of the British Council Library, the American Centre Library, the AIMA Library, the Central Secretariat library and DELNET, IIP, WIHG Dehradun. As a part of collaboration IFP,France has gifted a large no. of books and Shell, a global oil major has also gifted a large number of technical books to the library.

individual_reviews.course: Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: A great learning and a transformative journey with Great Lakes Institute of Management.

content.Placements: 95% of the last batch was placed. The highest package is 30 LPA offered by PayPal, and the average package is 15 LPA. Top recruiting companies are JP Morgan, BNY Mellon, Deloitte, Gartner, Mastercard, Accenture, HSBC Bank, Wells Fargo, GEP, etc. 90% of students from the current batch get placed in on-campus internships, and the mass recruiters are JP Morgan, BNY, ICICI Bank, etc.
content.Infrastructure: The college consists of a state-of-the-art, LEED-certified, platinum-rated green campus. There are 24/7 Wi-Fi facilities throughout the campus. There are 4 hostel blocks for males and females, and 3 academic blocks. There is also an open-air amphitheater. The food quality is decent. There are 24/7 medical facilities available for minor accidents. All types of sports are played here.

individual_reviews.course: Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Great Lakes Institute of Management, Chennai - A great place for learning.

content.Placements: The college attracts placements in roles from various fields like finance, marketing, operation, and analytics and specializing in analytics. The top recruiting companies for our course are PayPal, JP Morgan Chase and Co, BNY Melon, Airtel, Make My Trip, Accenture, Deloitte, Infosys, Gartner, ICICI Bank, Axis Bank, etc.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is amazing. The campus is beautiful with so many facilities including two gyms, sports fields and courts, and clean and large hostel rooms. There is a dedicated staff member who takes care of all the cleaning and makes the campus student-friendly at all times.

individual_reviews.course: Post Graduate Program in Management (PGPM) - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Best institute for the placements.

content.Placements: Our college is one of the best colleges for placements in PGDM. Almost 80% of students get placements at our college. The highest package offered for our course was 29 LPA, and the lowest package offered was 5 LPA. The average package offered at our college was 9 lpa. The top recruiters were EY, Amazon, Microsoft, eBay, Intel, etc.
content.Infrastructure: At our college, students were given all types of facilities, and the quality of all the facilities provided was amazing. The college labs and classrooms were supplied with all the equipment. There is Wi-Fi connectivity in both the hostel and the college. Various sports facilities were offered at our college. The hostel facilities were also of good quality.

individual_reviews.course: Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Review of Great Lakes Institute of Management, Chennai.

content.Placements: Our college provides good placements. Many top companies visit our college to recruit students. They provide summer internship opportunities. The average salary package offered is 1.4 LPA. Top recruiting companies are KPMG, Deloitte, etc.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel facilities are good.
content.Faculty: Our teachers are good. They are Ph.D. holders. They are well-qualified. They have been educated at prestigious colleges and universities. They conduct mid-term and final exams. Our course is well structured. It provides practical knowledge rather than theoretical knowledge.

individual_reviews.course: Post Graduate Program in Management (PGPM) - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: If worked hard in study period, the ROI is good.

content.Placements: Our batch witnessed an excellent season of placements this year. Business and Strategy Consulting came up with the most job offering industry, followed by Technology Consulting. The highest domestic package offered was 33.26 Lacs per annum. The season saw participation from major recruiters like Accenture, ADP, Brain, Bristlecone, Deloitte, Cognizant, E&Y GDS, FedEx, HCL, Infosys, Incedo, Optum, Tiger Analytics, Zoom, and ZS Associates.
content.Infrastructure: Life at Great Lakes is awesome. Great Lakes is situated 40 km away from Chennai city. The event is conducted throughout the year by various clubs in the college. Library cards are provided to us through which we can access all the books in the library. We do have sports events in our college, like cricket tournament, volleyball etc. I got a four-sharing room with attached bathroom and food facilities included, with fees 6500 per head. Wi-Fi facility is provided. A gym, indoor games, table tennis, carrom, etc., are available. Daily maintenance of rooms is arranged.

reviews.review_heading: A great learning and a transformative journey with Great Lakes Institute of Management.
reviews.review_text: The college consists of a state-of-the-art, LEED-certified, platinum-rated green campus. There are 24/7 Wi-Fi facilities throughout the campus. There are 4 hostel blocks for males and females, and 3 academic blocks. There is also an open-air amphitheater. The food quality is decent. There are 24/7 medical facilities available for minor accidents. All types of sports are played here.

reviews.review_heading: Great Lakes Institute of Management, Chennai - A great place for learning.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is amazing. The campus is beautiful with so many facilities including two gyms, sports fields and courts, and clean and large hostel rooms. There is a dedicated staff member who takes care of all the cleaning and makes the campus student-friendly at all times.

reviews.review_heading: Best institute for the placements.
reviews.review_text: At our college, students were given all types of facilities, and the quality of all the facilities provided was amazing. The college labs and classrooms were supplied with all the equipment. There is Wi-Fi connectivity in both the hostel and the college. Various sports facilities were offered at our college. The hostel facilities were also of good quality.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Great Lakes Institute of Management, Chennai.
reviews.review_text: The hostel facilities are good.

reviews.review_heading: If worked hard in study period, the ROI is good.
reviews.review_text: Life at Great Lakes is awesome. Great Lakes is situated 40 km away from Chennai city. The event is conducted throughout the year by various clubs in the college. Library cards are provided to us through which we can access all the books in the library. We do have sports events in our college, like cricket tournament, volleyball etc. I got a four-sharing room with attached bathroom and food facilities included, with fees 6500 per head. Wi-Fi facility is provided. A gym, indoor games, table tennis...

reviews.review_heading: The return of investment from this college is not as good as it could be.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are technology embedded and Wi-Fi enabled. There are many recreational facilities along with health care facilities for students' access. The library consists of recourses for all domains. Students also have access to live databases, journals, and case studies from Harvard University. With fully-airconditioned hostel rooms, the hostels were well furnished and we were given a cupboard, bed, a table and chair. The hostels are well maintained and the food is well-prepared.

reviews.review_heading: Life of students at the college.
reviews.review_text: Yes Wi-Fi is available within college premises and the speed of Wi-Fi is also fine. Labs, classrooms and library are regularly cleaned and maintained. The quality of food at the college is also fine and they prepare different food at different days and special food on special occasions.

reviews.review_heading: Slightly dissatisfied about ROI.
reviews.review_text:
Sports facilities are good because it is students driven. 
Infrastructure is outstanding and was well maintained. Students are given Individual rooms with all the facilities. Also there are dual sharing rooms in the facility if interested can opt. Sodexo was taking care of food facilities in hostel and were maintained with multiple varieties of food items. Also 24/7 food will be available. Mostly college doesn't sleep.

reviews.review_heading: Great lakes ; Great life.
reviews.review_text: Great lakes is South Asia's first LEED platinum campus and the infrastructure is top-notch. All the classes are air-conditioned and well-equipped with individual laptop charges and other teaching aids. The Wi-Fi is accessible to students 24*7 for both laptop and mobile phones. The mess and canteen are good even though the food is vegetarian (You can pay for non-veg separately). Hostel life is amazing with air-conditioned rooms and furnished with good quality Godrej furniture. The campus and host...

reviews.review_heading: The college is a bit costly, but worth it.
reviews.review_text: Faculty members are very good, and in analytics, PKV sir is amazing and recently awarded in top 10 people in India in the analytics field. Dr Bhardhwaj is also an amazing professor in marking, and Dr Vaidehi is good in operation, and create interest in operation and supply chain management.

reviews.review_heading: Global mindset, Indian roots.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is better than many other campuses across India. It is a platinum campus. Campus is equipped with a gym, football field, badminton courts, tennis court, basketball ground, and many other things. Hostels are well maintained. You'll never feel bored in the campus.

reviews.review_heading: You need to know about GLIM.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is on par with any other top management colleges. It is the leed campus. You may search what leed campus means. The hostel is well-equipped with all the amenities and luxuries. One cannot have a better educational year if the stay is compromised.

reviews.review_heading: Awesome faculty and Good Placements.
reviews.review_text: Our campus is the first platinum-rated campus in India. We have top class infrastructure which includes centralized A/C classrooms, AC hostels to beat the heat. The entire campus is Wi-Fi connected and Library has all the relevant and necessary books for students.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college, but it requires time to provide better placements.
reviews.review_text: I would rate 5 stars to the infrastructure of the college. The campus is fully Wi-Fi enabled, and 24x7 water facility is available. The library is well-equipped with books as well as the digital subscription. Classrooms are generally in a semi-circular manner so that every student can have the right focus toward the teaching faculty members. The mess is good and is maintained by Sodexo, and there is a 24x7 shop for other eaters on the campus. Medical faculty is available for 24 hours, along with...

reviews.review_heading: Great Lakes is a great place to learn.
reviews.review_text: We have one of the best infrastructures among the top B-Schools in India and state of the art library facilities, along with fully digitalised and air-conditioned classrooms. Hostels are very spacious with 24x7 air-conditioners and Wi-Fi services, and they are very well maintained. The quality of the food served in the hostel is manageable, but can't expect more. We have excellent outdoor and indoor games facilities.

NIRF 2025 Rankings are out. As per the latest NIRF 2025 rankings, IIM Shillong ranks #38 under the category 'Management'.

The CAT 2026 registration is expected to start in the Aug, 2026 for admission to the MBA course.

A few more updates are given below:

college_info.intro: IIM Shillong is a popular programme is Post Graduate Programme in Management (PGPM). It is a two-year full-time programme which is offered the students with an MBA degree. The course curriculum is specifically designed for working executives. The students are taught skills so that they can become professional managers. MBA students learn strong conceptual fundamentals and several skills that help in management. After pursuing MBA degree students can become Management Consultant, Product Manager, HR Manager, Business Analyst, and others. IHM Shillong offers practical action-based learning experiences. Below are the IIM Shillong popular programmes:

The top recruiting sectors at the institute emerged as the Consulting and BFSI sector. Also, the major recruiting domains were Consulting and Sales and Marketing. individual_reviews.title: IIM Shillong College Review.

content.Placements: IIM Shillong was definitely worth a look. Around 60 to 75% of applicants get accepted. It was pretty good. When it comes to the average salary package, it ranges from about 11 to 25 LPA. They provide some solid vocational training, which is a great way to get hands on experience. Job prospects, you would be in good company with big names like Ford, HDFC Bank, Google, IBM, and Accenture looking to hire. Positions like Programme Executive and Project Manager were just a couple of the high level jobs.
content.Infrastructure: The amenities in the colleges campus housing include Wi-Fi, drinking water, lighting, fans, and beds. Plus, we had air conditioned classrooms and a well equipped central library where students could borrow books. The food quality at the mess was just average. Three canteens on campus serve some really tasty fast food. We also got a small sports field for volleyball, football, and cricket.

content.Placements: Adani Wilmar, Brain Company, and Case & Co. were the most common top recruiters from IIM Shillong. Mostly, 32% of students got placed in top companies, with the highest package being 52.5 LPA and the lowest package being 4.5 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: Food was high enough to meet hygienic and nutrition standards. Food was served according to the needed quantities. Fresh foods are cooked three times a day and cannot be reused. Also, there is no chance for hostellers to approach hotel food on weekdays.

individual_reviews.course: Post Graduate Program for Executives (Managing Business in Emerging Economies) - PGPEx (MBEE) - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: IIM Shillong is very good and provides many facilities.

content.Placements: IIM Shillong provides good placements. The TNP cell of IIM Shillong encourages students to learn new things that help their careers. They will conduct workshops based on job-oriented learning. The highest package is 30 LPA. The average package is 15 LPA. In IIM Shillong, almost all students got internship opportunities in the 2nd year. Companies like Amazon, Microsoft, Wipro, TCS, Tata, Accenture, Cognizant, etc., are top recruiters.
content.Infrastructure: Our institute has marvelous infrastructure and provides all facilities. Classrooms are big enough to accommodate a large number of students. They have a hostel for both boys and girls. In the hostel, there are good facilities with neat rooms and good food quality. The staff care about study very well.

courses_data.description: IIM Shillong offers Certificate courses in the stream of Management. The duration of these courses ranges from six to twelve months. The mode of study for IIM Shillong certificate courses is full-time.

faqs.question: Who is eligible for the IIM Shillong Certificate course?
faqs.answer: Candidates who has a bachelor's degree from an Indian university with a minimum of 50% marks, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university are eligible for the IIM Shillong certificate programme. Further, candidate with a minimum working experience of two years in the development sector, government organisation, NGO, Corporate etc., are prefered.

paragraphs: IIM Shillong placement cell for PGP and PGPEx works towards building new relationships and maintaining the existing ones with the corporate world. It helps the students to find better suited roles for them. As per the IIM Shillong placement report 2025, the highest package grabbed by PGP students was INR 71.5 LPA . The average and median package offered during IIM Shillong PGP placement 2025 were INR 26.44 LPA and INR 25 LPA , respectively. For the PGPEx program, the highest package recorded was INR 35 LPA. Additionally, the average and median package offered to PGPEx students during IIM Shillong placements 2025 was INR 24.28 LPA and INR 25 LPA, respectively.

hostel.description:
IIM Shillong provides separate accommodation facilities with both single and double occupancy rooms are available at the campus.
Dormitories are connected with a state of the art Wireless Mesh Network (WMN). There is also a common reading room, common recreation room equipped with table tennis, carom, and television facilities. Within the confines of the dormitories are a gymnasium, basketball and badminton court present inside the campus.
facilities: Modern, fully automated and tech-savvy libraries

library.description:
IIM Shillong library is fully automated and maintains a separate collection of reference books, textbooks, general books, working papers and other documents, whereas the non-book collection consists of video cassettes, compact discs, etc.
The library is also equipped with the latest E-Resources (E-Books, E-Journals, and Database) such as CMIE – Prowess, ISI-Emerging Markets, ProQuest, and EBSCO – Business Source Complete and has access to HBR cases with some special Collections of EXIM Bank, World Bank, and Harvard Business Review.
Various type of services that are available in Knowledge Centre apart from lending are the References Services, CAS (Current Awareness Services), SDI (Selective Dissemination of Information), Reprographic Services, Information Alert Services (E-Mail Services), Lest-you-miss (newspaper clippings) services, and ILL (inter-library loan) services and services related to newspaper clippings.

reviews.review_heading: IIM Shillong College Review.
reviews.review_text: The amenities in the colleges campus housing include Wi-Fi, drinking water, lighting, fans, and beds. Plus, we had air conditioned classrooms and a well equipped central library where students could borrow books. The food quality at the mess was just average. Three canteens on campus serve some really tasty fast food. We also got a small sports field for volleyball, football, and cricket.

reviews.review_heading: The best college for placements.
reviews.review_text: They are good at providing transportation facilities within or outside the college. Mobile phones should not be carried inside the classrooms, it should be switched off and kept in the Laboratories before entering into classrooms. Also it's one of the most technological updated college.

reviews.review_heading: Firstly preferred college by students.
reviews.review_text: The beautifully landscaped campus with ample space attracts students to choose this college for pursuing. Hostel rooms are so comfortable and very clean, sanitized by workers regularly and we would accessible to clean drinking water and purified water. Foods are so nutritious to eat in the hostel areas.

reviews.review_heading: Indian institute of management, Shillong.
reviews.review_text: Food was high enough to meet hygienic and nutrition standards. Food was served according to the needed quantities. Fresh foods are cooked three times a day and cannot be reused. Also, there is no chance for hostellers to approach hotel food on weekdays.

reviews.review_heading: IIM Shillong is very good and provides many facilities.
reviews.review_text: Our institute has marvelous infrastructure and provides all facilities. Classrooms are big enough to accommodate a large number of students. They have a hostel for both boys and girls. In the hostel, there are good facilities with neat rooms and good food quality. The staff care about study very well.

reviews.review_heading: Overall best College for PGPM Course.
reviews.review_text: Being a temporary university, it lacks various basic facilities like a sports center, computer lab, etc., but the university is well-located. All the basic requirements are nearby. We would transfer to the new campus this year. The hotel rooms are small and can accommodate two or three people. Mess food is not good.

reviews.review_heading: One of the best colleges and excellent infrastructure available.
reviews.review_text: Excellent infrastructure and facilities are available like Wi-Fi, labs, library, food, medical facilities are available, separate departments are available, sports and games are conducted, and cultural events are included. The mess and canteen are very hygienic. The food is also very decent.

reviews.review_heading: Our college has well-qualified faculty and placement opportunities for this course.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available at IIM Shillong for the PGPM course are very good. The college provides all the modern facilities to its students for their interactive learning and development. The college has a big campus with facilities like Wi-Fi, labs, library, canteen, classrooms, sports ground, etc., for the students. The food in the college canteen is good to eat. Hostel facilities are also of good quality.

reviews.review_heading: Review of IIM Shillong - Indian Institute of Management.
reviews.review_text: The academic buildings are not good. All classrooms and lecture halls are very good. The hostel facility is available on campus.

reviews.review_heading: Hard Reality of IIM Shillong 1 year course.
reviews.review_text: Facilities were not upto the mark, no proper infrastructure. Every time internet issues in the campus, no special tools were provided to faculty members for online teaching like good camera, sound system. Out of 1.15 hr session,  20 minutes wasted in connecting to the platform. Canteen food is the worst, rely on outside food if you have money to spend.

reviews.review_heading: Review of IIM Shillong - Indian Institute of Management.
reviews.review_text: Our campus is spread over 120 acres with access to high-speed internet and smart classrooms and a state-of-the-art library. Hostels are clean and hygienic with all the essential mess and cleaning services. Basketball court, badminton court and TT tables are also available here.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the life at IIM Shillong.
reviews.review_text: Being a temporary campus, it lacks in various basic amenities like Sports facilities, computer labs etc., but the campus is strategically located. All the basic requirements are available nearby. We would be shifting to the new campus this year. The hostel rooms are small and double or triple sharing. The mess food is not good.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with the college.
reviews.review_text: The campus is quite small, but you will fall in love with the small campus in 2 years. It is in a good location. All the basic amenities are available nearby. The Wi-Fi is fine. Everyone has their laptops so there are no labs. Classrooms are not semi-circular, but they are fine. Sports facilities are not good. The hostel rooms are small and sharing. The quality of food served is below average and the canteen rarely has any food.

reviews.review_heading: IIM-Shillong - The campus in clouds with  state-of-the-art infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: IIM Shillong has been running at a temporary campus from its start. However, the newly build campus has state-of-the-art infrastructure and will hopefully be available for the upcoming batch. The current campus is also fully equipped with all the necessary amenities. IIM-S is the only b-school in India to host a Golf Cup each year since its inception which shows how much the college gives importance to the holistic development of its participants.

reviews.review_heading: Good place and B-School to spend your 2 years.
reviews.review_text: Since we have not shifted to the permanent campus yet, the infrastructure was not at par with other Schools. Wi-fi worked but was a bit slow. The classrooms didn't have semi circular arrangement but smart boards were there in each class. Library was fine and was open at night also, except Saturday and Sunday. The hostel rooms were very small and were sharing for 1st years. 2nd year students had single rooms. The mess food was also not at par. Most of the students went out to eat. But since the c...

The infrastructure is also average, well-designed, and good for the students. However, a hostel isn't present for this, and meals are good in the canteen.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: The best university of my life is Manipal University.

content.Placements: The placement offered to us is awesome. In our college the last semester students are eligible for placement and top reputed companies from all over the world visited our college for placement activities. Companies like Amazon, Flipkart, TCS, Infotech, Cognizant, Wipro, HCL, etc., hire students with a good package of 18 Lacs per annum.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel of our college is excellent. We have both girls and boys hostels. The rooms in our hostel are spacious making it easy for living. The rooms are cleaned daily by the hostel staff and the food is prepared hygienically, ensuring tasty meals are served.

individual_reviews.course: MBA in Human Resources Management - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Good college with 100% placement record.

content.Placements: Placement of this college is great. This year was exception otherwise it has 100% placement score. The average package of PGDM is 11.5 LPA to 12.5 LPA. Many companies visit the college as per records. I am 100% sure that our batch will also get placed in 2020.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of college was so good. The quality of the furniture is also good. They have all facilities like Wi-Fi, labs, and an awesome library which is among the best in India. But the college needs auditorium. The seminar hall is small according to the crowd of college.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: It's a great college for those who scored 85-90% in academics with 9-11 LPA salary package post-MBA.

content.Placements: Placements in our college are quite decent. The average salary package offered is around 11 LPA, and in 2020, it is 10 LPA. The highest salary package offered is around 25 LPA, and the lowest salary package offered is around 8 LPA. Generally, 100% of the students got placed, but in 2020, around 90% of the students got placed. Roles offered are financial, marketing and IT consulting in reputed companies. Financial roles mainly include financial analyst, risk analyst and advisory roles. Marketing roles are mainly into the sales domain like area sales manager, territory sales manager, etc. IT roles involve cybersecurity consulting, pre-sales and consulting. Notable companies are Deloitte, EY, KPMG, Accenture, ITC, Wipro, Infosys, ICICI Bank, Jockey India, Magicbricks.Com, K12 Techno Services, Citi Group, HDFC Bank, Qualcomm, HSBC, Mahindra & Mahindra, ICICI Prudential, Berger Paints, etc.

TAPMI fee structure includes various components including, tuition fees, admission fees, alumni membership fees, other charges etc. Candidates interested in applying forMBAat TAPMI Manipal need to pay anapplication fee of INR 2000for a single course. reviews.review_heading: Review of T A Pai Management Institute, Manipal, MAHE
reviews.review_text: Textbooks are provided by the college. PPTs are provided by the faculty; computer labs, library, Wi-Fi in every classroom, a brand scan lab, and a lot of other resources such as E-Cell support are present, along with sporting facilities like a ground and a gym. One of the best, if not the best, hostels in Manipal is NIH, where IPM students stay.

reviews.review_heading: Good College and Infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The faculty is very good and nice, and they are very well-educated and knowledgeable. They explain in a very good manner. The infrastructure is also average, well-designed, and good for the students. However, a hostel isn't present for this, and meals are good in the canteen.

reviews.review_heading: The best university of my life is Manipal University.
reviews.review_text: The hostel of our college is excellent. We have both girls and boys hostels. The rooms in our hostel are spacious making it easy for living. The rooms are cleaned daily by the hostel staff and the food is prepared hygienically, ensuring tasty meals are served.

reviews.review_heading: Good college with 100% placement record.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of college was so good. The quality of the furniture is also good. They have all facilities like Wi-Fi, labs, and an awesome library which is among the best in India. But the college needs auditorium. The seminar hall is small according to the crowd of college.

reviews.review_heading: It's a great college for those who scored 85-90% in academics with 9-11 LPA salary package post-MBA.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is very good with Bloomberg labs. Classrooms are air-conditioned and well-equipped with projectors and whiteboards. The library at TAPMI is the 2nd largest in Karnataka with state-of-the-art facilities. The hostel is decent with air-conditioned rooms and attached bathrooms, and cleaning is done on alternative days. Overall the hostel is quite well-maintained. TAPMI hosts a 50-day long sports tournament and has 8 games. It has ground as well as several indoor fac...

reviews.review_heading: Overall development of a student with strong ethics.
reviews.review_text: Labs are open 24 hours. Bloomberg lab is there for Finance majors. Top notch digital infrastructure in classes libraries and labs. Quality of food and dining area can accommodate around 500 people at a time. Various vendors are there for choice of foods.

reviews.review_heading: Good faculty, with very big campus and infrastructure and good overall placement.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is well placed over the area of 17 hectare. With 5 hostel (3 Boys and 2 Girls) it offers a large area for student activities. TAPMi also fully Air conditioned Library which for students convenience opens till 4 Am in morning. This goes to show how committed TAPMI is regarding education. There is central Air conditioned Student centre where all the foods are sold. With 5 different shops to choose from, There is also a store in the campus for all your small and general needs.

reviews.review_heading: Review of T.A Pai Management Institute.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are equipped with air-conditioners, projector and individual charging ports. The campus is Wi-Fi enabled. The library is opened for 24 hours. There is a  Bloomberg lab, and also a student centre. Hostel facility with a single and double room. Hostels are equipped with air-conditioners. There is a 24 hours generator back up. Water facility and laundry services are available 24 hours. There is a general store, beauty parlour inside the campus. The food is provided by four different vend...

reviews.review_heading: It is an excellent college with strict disciplines and a lifetime opportunity and a wonderful place.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms were excellent with air-conditioned and projectors. The library is open most of the times and gives students abundance resources for the bank. Hostel facility is wonderful, and the view from hostels are awesome. All hostels have Wi-Fi facility, and for the food, students have a common canteen with all variety of food available to satiate their hunger. There is in campus doctor and sports ground as well. Colleges also host an event for indoor games.

reviews.review_heading: TAPMI was the beginning of a corporate journey.
reviews.review_text: There are world-class infrastructure and amenities for the students on the campus, both in the education centre as well as the hostel blocks, including Wi-Fi, labs, library etc. Quality of food in a mess was very good, but the medical and sports facilities to be improved.

reviews.review_heading: College provides quality education.
reviews.review_text: The college boasts of a 40-acre campus located in Manipal, Karnataka. The campus is surrounded by lush greenery and pleasant weather throughout the year. College is equipped with great infrastructure in terms of classrooms, board room, seminar halls, library, etc. The hostel and cafeteria are well-equipped with all essential and modern facility.

reviews.review_heading: The college provides quality education.
reviews.review_text: The entire campus is Wi-Fi enabled. There are two main computer labs and a few other computer rooms. The library timings are from 9 am to 4 am. There are five hostel blocks, i.e., three boys and two girls hostels. There is a centralised free laundry service.

reviews.review_heading: Review of T.A Pai Management Institute.
reviews.review_text: TAPMI has an amazing infrastructure, and the campus is spread over 13,000 square feet. There is a fully air-conditioned library, which has around 280 national and international subscribed periodicals. There are a students center and the mess, where we have around 5-6 amazing food vendors. The mess is open until 10 pm, and we also have a night canteen, which is open until 7 am in the morning. The hostel is also decent, and it provides you with all the basic requirements.

reviews.review_heading: I am absolutely satisfied with the experience at TAPMI.
reviews.review_text: The college has a top-class infrastructure with a lush green 42-acre campus. The campus is fully Wi-Fi enabled, and there is nothing to complain about the college. Classrooms are well-equipped with projectors and centralised air-conditioners. The library is probably one of the best in India with a humongous number of books, journals, magazines and E-resources, which a student will ever need. The hostel has both single and double sharing rooms, and they are allocated by the college randomly, but ...

reviews.review_heading: The college was beyond my expectations.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is as good as any other top B-schools. Facilities like campus Wi-Fi, well-equipped classrooms with double projectors, e-library can be accused remotely are provided. Facilities of the hostel are nice, but I think that it can be better. The service provider sometimes takes a lot of time to deliver simple tasks. The canteen is hygienic apart from the presence of flies.

individual_reviews.course: Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: In summary, students will be able to get opportunities that will help them advance in their career.

content.Placements: During the sip, 60% of the batch was placed. Recruiters included all established conglomerates, including Tata Motors and Adani. The roles offered range from sales and marketing roles to research roles as well. The average stipend was INR 50,000. Overall, the summer internship process was successful.
content.Infrastructure: All campuses have Wi-Fi connectivity. Good-quality classrooms with well-equipped monitors and other necessary equipment are there. Students can get sports facilities to play their desired sports. The campus has Bloomberg terminals, which the students can use to access data relating to the financial markets.

individual_reviews.course: Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Good college as it gives good exposure, ignites the competitiveness and caliber.

content.Placements: The college has managed to get 100% placements for both the abnormal years, hit by COVID-19. For the current year, the batch had an increased average placement scene, with a rise of about 2%. Placements with top companies in their industries, video different profiles and sectors.
content.Infrastructure: College has great facilities for classroom and rooms specifically made for purposes of sports, HR, etc. There are multiple hostel options, with multiple room options with single, double sharing. The mess and canteen facility is amazing, and has a gym facility too. There is a big amphitheatre with great greenery surrounding it completely. The classrooms have ample lot space with hybrid facilities and projectors. The location of the campus is amidst the Qutub Industrial area. Surrounding are plenty spaces for students to chill with their friends, and get to know the heart of India alot better.

individual_reviews.course: Post Graduate Diploma in Human Resource Management (PGDM HRM) - Batch of 2015
individual_reviews.title: I am highly satisfied with our campus and its infrastructure. I had many memories here.

content.Placements: I was one of the academically top students in our batch to passed out of our college. Companies were tied-up with our college for placements. The placement process was excruciating even for us. After sorting out some problems, companies like Axis Bank, ICICI Bank, Infosys, Accenture and Dell visited our college for placement drives, which took almost a month to conduct. The placement record is exceptional in IMI Delhi, which is nearly 100% placements for all specialisations. The average salary package offered in our college in placements is around 13 LPA-15 LPA.

individual_reviews.course: Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: Above average college but not a great ROI according to the fees.

content.Placements: 99% of students were placed in my course for 2018-20 batch. The highest CTC is 20.75 LPA and the average is 13.02 LPA. Top companies were RIL, RB, Nestle, Deloitte, Gartner, Google. 100% of students got an internship in my course. Top roles are General Manager, Consultant, Assistant Manager.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi- with average speed, Labs- good, classrooms- average and compact, Library- above average. Hostel facilities are quick and good. Mess food is manageable according to the standards. Medical facilities are timely available. Sports and games are open 24*7 for students at their disposal.

individual_reviews.course: Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: I am glad to be a part of this college.

content.Placements: Placements are above average in our college with 100% placement record. For further information about the average salary package and profiles offered, top recruiting companies, internships offered, etc., kindly refer to the official placement report, which is released by our college every year.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi facility, computer labs, classrooms and library are good. The library has a great collection of all types of books and is good for a bibliophile. A Bloomberg terminal is also available in our college for students to use. Hostels are good with tasty mess food.

placement_data.title: IMI Delhi Placement Overview 2025
paragraphs: IMI Delhi has released the placement report for its PGDM, PDM HRM and PGDM B&FS batch passed out in 2025. The overall highest and average package secured by the batch 2025 stood at INR 40.31 LPA and INR 17.91 LPA. The overall median salary offered stood at 16.61 LPA. The students of the PGDM BFS batch 2025 secured the average salary of INR 20.90 LPA. The average salary for PGDM HRM batch 2025 was INR 16.32 LPA.

Earlier, more than 175 companies participated during IMI placements 2024, of which over 70 were new recruiters . The students of the batch 2024 received 2 international offers from the recruiters. The highest package made during IMI Delhi placements 2024 was INR 70.95 LPA . The average and median packages recorded during placement 2024 was INR 16.71 LPA and INR 16.60 LPA . The students received job offers across many sectors like BFSI, E-Commerce, Consulting, etc. In PGDM (B&FS), Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance emerged as the top sectors.

Some of the job roles offered to the students of the 2024 batch include - Area Sales Manager, Consumer Care Division, Associate Lead, HR, Associate Lead, Financial Advisory, Product Manager, Research Consultant, Strategic Advisor Financial Services, etc. Additionally, IMI Delhi also released the summer placement report for batch 2023-25. According to the report, the highest and average stipend offered stood at INR 3.50 lakh and INR 78,800 for 2 months , respectively.

reviews.review_heading: In summary, students will be able to get opportunities that will help them advance in their career.
reviews.review_text:
All campuses have Wi-Fi connectivity. 
Good-quality classrooms with well-equipped monitors and other necessary equipment are there. Students can get sports facilities to play their desired sports. The campus has Bloomberg terminals, which the students can use to access data relating to the financial markets.

reviews.review_heading: Good college as it gives good exposure, ignites the competitiveness and caliber.
reviews.review_text: College has great facilities for classroom and rooms specifically made for purposes of sports, HR, etc. There are multiple hostel options, with multiple room options with single, double sharing. The mess and canteen facility is amazing, and has a gym facility too. There is a big amphitheatre with great greenery surrounding it completely. The classrooms have ample lot space with hybrid facilities and projectors. The location of the campus is amidst the Qutub Industrial area. Surrounding are plent...

reviews.review_heading: I am highly satisfied with our campus and its infrastructure. I had many memories here.
reviews.review_text: Though the admissions in the hostels situated inside our campus are filled quickly, it becomes difficult to secure admission on time. However, hostels available nearby our college are really spacious and helpful to reach the college on time. The campus area is fairly huge and crowded with students throughout the year. There are two tennis courts, and both of them are cemented. The building was newly constructed. You will also find all the latest amenities inside the campus or within a walkable d...

reviews.review_heading: Above average college but not a great ROI according to the fees.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi- with average speed, Labs- good, classrooms- average and compact, Library- above average. Hostel facilities are quick and good. Mess food is manageable according to the standards. Medical facilities are timely available. Sports and games are open 24*7 for students at their disposal.

reviews.review_heading: I am glad to be a part of this college.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi facility, computer labs, classrooms and library are good. The library has a great collection of all types of books and is good for a bibliophile. A Bloomberg terminal is also available in our college for students to use. Hostels are good with tasty mess food.

reviews.review_heading: The course curriculum is in accordance with the current trends in the industry.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of both the college and the hostel is great. All the basic amenities are available and proper hygiene is maintained in hostels. The Classrooms are spacious and are kept in good conditions and the library is best in class with a diverse variety of books.

reviews.review_heading: The professors at IMI were industry stalwarts with years of experience.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure and campus at IMI is well-equipped with all the required essential equipments to aid us in the learning process. We have a lot of fun on campus and learning becomes a very smooth and fun process because of the infrastructure facilities.

reviews.review_heading: A good place for knowledge enrichment. Guest lectures give us current knowledge of industry.
reviews.review_text: The Infrastructure is something that a lot of people complain about. The campus area is not so big but it has good connectivity of Wi-Fi, library with a lot of books, rich in content and most importantly it has a Bloomberg terminal to learn a lot about economy and finance.

reviews.review_heading: It is one of the premier B-Schools.
reviews.review_text: Our entire college premises are Wi-Fi enabled. There are full-fledged computer labs, and classrooms and computer lab have mics and projectors. A lot of sports are played by students, and various tournaments are conducted round the year.

reviews.review_heading: I am highly satisfied with our college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is very nice. Classrooms and labs are air-conditioned and well furnished. There are nice sports, medical and canteen facilities. Hostels are available on the campus, and hostels rooms are well furnished and air-conditioned. The mess is also available in our college, and it provides nice food.

reviews.review_heading: Great college experience and the course covers a holistic approach towards management.
reviews.review_text: The college hostels are very comfortable with good mess services outsources by Team Sodexo. The amphitheatre is the prettiest & the catch of the college life. The library is flooded with books.

reviews.review_heading: Review of IMI Delhi - International Management Institute.
reviews.review_text: The college provides 1st-year hostel outside campus, but there is a bus arrangement. The college provides 2nd-year hostel on the campus. The campus is not huge, but campus life is superb. You will never get missed out in a busy schedule where most of your time will be devoted to the college. The college provides a good library.

reviews.review_heading: A place to be if you care about holistic development.
reviews.review_text: The facilities provided to a student here is good, Wi-Fi connectivity inside the campus is fast and rarely there is any downtime. The library hosts different kinds of books which help for the holistic development of the student. Sports and games are available both for indoors and outdoors.

reviews.review_heading: 100 percent of the students got internships.
reviews.review_text:
We have facilities such as Wi-Fi, computer labs, air-conditioned classrooms, a library, and a good mess area on our campus.
Even all the hostel rooms are air-conditioned. 
The food is catered by Sodexo and the quality and hygiene is maintained correctly by them.

reviews.review_heading: Excellent environment for growth, very helping faculties and seniors, friendly peers, awesome campus
reviews.review_text: Barring the campus size ( which gets compensated by the prime location factor) all the other facilities which you want is being provided here. From having Sodexo as mess caterers to on campus gym to on campus doctor to RPG canteen and what not, the campus consists of every facilities you could imagine.

faculty_reviews.verified_reviews_info: The Verified badge indicates that the reviewer's details have been verified by Shiksha, and reviewers are bona fide students of this college. These reviews and ratings have been given by students. Shiksha does not endorse the same. Out of 222 published reviews , 213 reviews are verified.

The placement committee of our college was very committed to getting good companies on campus, so I can say that the options available to us were great.
